english: Mii lies in the cultivated plain of Chikugo around Kurume, where cotton weaving became a livelihood for rural households. Kurume kasuri, patterned cloth made from threads dyed before weaving, is traditionally credited to Inoue Den at the end of the eighteenth century. Its production spread through villages in Mii and neighbouring districts. Indigo and careful preparation of the threads gave the cloth its distinctive designs, making it a celebrated product of the region.
simp_chinese: 御井位于筑后久留米附近的耕作平原，棉织是当地农家的生计之一。久留米絣先将纱线染色再织出花纹，传统认为这门技艺由井上传于十八世纪末创出。织造逐渐传遍御井及邻郡村庄；蓝靛与细致的纱线处理赋予布匹独特图案，使它成为地方名产。

english: Mikasa lies in northern Chikuzen, where Dazaifu served as a centre of government for Kyushu. The scholar and courtier Sugawara no Michizane was exiled here in 901 and died in the district. His grave became the site of Dazaifu Tenmangū, a shrine dedicated to his spirit. War damaged the shrine during the sixteenth century; in 1591 Kobayakawa Takakage rebuilt its main sanctuary, helping restore a place of learning and devotion.
simp_chinese: 御笠位于筑前北部，大宰府曾是九州的行政中心。学者兼朝臣菅原道真于901年被贬至此，死后墓所成为祭祀其神灵的太宰府天满宫。十六世纪战乱使神社受损；1591年，小早川隆景重建本殿，恢复了这处与学问和信仰密切相连的圣地。

english: Mikasuki was a Native town near Lake Miccosukee, in the wooded country of northern Florida. Its people were part of the communities of Creek origin who moved into Florida and became associated with the Seminole. In 1818, during the First Seminole War, an American army under Andrew Jackson entered Spanish Florida and attacked the Mikasuki settlements. The town was taken and destroyed as the campaign pushed farther into the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 米卡苏基是佛罗里达北部林地区域、米科苏基湖附近的一座原住民村镇。居民来自迁入佛罗里达的克里克社群，后来与塞米诺尔人建立了联系。1818年第一次塞米诺尔战争期间，安德鲁·杰克逊率领的美军进入西属佛罗里达，袭击米卡苏基聚落。村镇被攻占并摧毁，军队继续向半岛深处进发。

english: Mike lies on the northern coast of Buzen, near the mouth of the Nakatsu River. After Toyotomi Hideyoshi's conquest of Kyushu, Kuroda Kanbei entered Buzen and began building Nakatsu Castle by the water. Some local warrior families resisted his rule and their strongholds were attacked. Following the Battle of Sekigahara, the Kuroda moved to Chikuzen and the Hosokawa took over, completing the castle and developing its town.
simp_chinese: 三毛位于丰前北岸，靠近中津川河口。丰臣秀吉征服九州后，黑田官兵卫进入丰前，在水边开始修筑中津城。一些地方武家抵抗其统治，他们的据点因而遭到进攻。关原之战后，黑田氏转封筑前，细川氏继而入主，完成城堡并建设城下町。

sources.title: 86684 1 定留遺跡赤松地区発掘調査報告書.pdf

english: Miketo lies in the country west of Lake Tanganyika, near the course of the Lukuga River. The Lukuga carries water from the great lake toward the Lualaba and the Congo basin, crossing a landscape of wooded hills and valleys. Its outlet and channels have changed with the level of the lake, joining the waters of the Tanganyika basin to the river country farther west.
simp_chinese: 米克托位于坦噶尼喀湖以西、卢库加河附近。卢库加河穿过林木覆盖的丘陵与河谷，将大湖的水带向卢阿拉巴河及刚果盆地。湖水出口和河道随湖面高度变化，把坦噶尼喀湖盆与更西方的河流地区连接起来。

english: Mikhailovka lies in the country of the upper Sosna, south of the old Novosil lands. In the sixteenth century watchmen from Novosil and Mtsensk guarded river crossings on this exposed frontier. A fort was built at Livny, where the Livenka enters the Sosna, in 1586. Its garrison formed part of the southern defence against raids, while messages between frontier posts carried news of approaching forces.
simp_chinese: 米哈伊洛夫卡位于索斯纳河上游地区，在古老的诺沃西利土地以南。十六世纪，来自诺沃西利和姆岑斯克的哨兵守卫这片暴露边境上的河流渡口。1586年，利文卡河汇入索斯纳河的地方建起利夫内堡垒。其驻军是南方防御的一部分，边境哨所之间传递敌军来临的消息。

english: Mikhalkino lies among the islands and channels of the Kolyma delta, where the river spreads out before reaching the East Siberian Sea. The low-lying ground is shaped by seasonal floods and by the branching waterways that carry fresh water north. Lakes and marshes lie alongside the channels, while winter ice binds together much of the delta in a landscape open to the Arctic weather.
simp_chinese: 米哈尔基诺位于科雷马河三角洲的岛屿与河汊之间。大河在注入东西伯利亚海之前分散开来，季节性洪水与向北输送淡水的分汊河道塑造着低洼地面。湖泊和沼泽沿河汊分布，冬季冰层将三角洲许多水域连接起来，整片土地暴露在北极气候之下。

english:
Mikhaylov stands on the steep left bank of the Pronya, on the southern approaches to the Ryazan lands. Its wooden walls and ditch guarded a frontier exposed to raids from the steppe. The town became a home to soldiers and craftsmen whose work sustained the fortress as well as the surrounding settlement.

A chronicle records the building of Mikhaylov as a defensive town in 1551, under the direction of the voivodes Vorotynsky and Golovin. Streltsy, gunners and Cossacks served in its garrison, while carpenters, smiths and coachmen supplied other needs. Suburbs grew around the fort, many bearing the names of their inhabitants' occupations. The service population also farmed and traded; as the frontier moved farther south, the town's role gradually changed from a military outpost to a local centre of the Ryazan countryside.
simp_chinese:
米哈伊洛夫坐落在普罗尼亚河陡峭的左岸，扼守梁赞地区南方进路。木墙和壕沟保护着这处易受草原袭击的边境。城镇也是军人与工匠的家园，他们既维持堡垒运作，也支撑周围聚落。

编年史记载，1551年总督沃罗滕斯基与戈洛文主持修建米哈伊洛夫防御城。射击军、炮手和哥萨克在此驻防，木匠、铁匠与驿夫承担其他工作。城堡周围逐渐形成居民区，许多以居民的职业命名。服役人员也从事耕作和贸易；随着边境向南推进，城镇逐渐从军事前哨转变为梁赞乡村的地方中心。

english: Mikhaylovka lies on the Medveditsa, a tributary of the Don, amid the lands of the Don Cossacks. In 1762 Colonel Mikhail Sebryakov received land here for his service. His family established settlements on the former lands of Kobylyanskaya, including a Mikhaylovka and a later Novo-Mikhaylovka on the left bank of the Medveditsa. Maps of the late eighteenth century show the latter as Mikhail Sebryakov's sloboda. Its name preserves that of the officer whose family shaped settlement along this stretch of river.
simp_chinese: 米哈伊洛夫卡位于顿河支流梅德韦季察河畔，处在顿河哥萨克人的土地上。1762年，米哈伊尔·谢布里亚科夫上校因服役获得此地土地。他的家族在原科贝良斯卡娅的土地上建立聚落，包括米哈伊洛夫卡和后来位于梅德韦季察河左岸的新米哈伊洛夫卡。十八世纪末的地图将后者标为米哈伊尔·谢布里亚科夫的斯洛博达。地名保存了这位军官的名字，他的家族曾影响这段河岸的定居格局。

english: Mikhaylovka lies in the lower Volga country, close to the Akhtuba and the floodplain that separates it from the main river. The seasonal rise of the waters filled channels and meadows, while dry steppe stretched beyond the river's reach. Along the Akhtuba, boats could carry salt from the lakes east of the river towards the Volga. Settlements and pasture grounds occupied the narrow transition between the watered valley and the open Caspian lowland.
simp_chinese: 米哈伊洛夫卡位于伏尔加河下游地区，靠近阿赫图巴河以及将它与主河道分开的泛滥平原。季节性涨水注满河汊和草甸，河水所及之处以外则是干燥草原。船只沿阿赫图巴河运送东部盐湖的盐，前往伏尔加河。聚落与牧场分布在水草丰盈的河谷和开阔里海低地之间狭长的过渡地带。

english: Mikhlaf al-Hubayshiyya is a historic district of villages around Damt in Yemen's central highlands. Its western edge includes Damt, known for its sulphurous springs, while the district extends eastward among the upland settlements. Al-Qaima in Hubayshiyya was the ancestral home of the al-Hubayshi family, whose jurists and judges served Yemeni communities from the early Islamic centuries. The district belonged to the country associated with Rada, and its villages formed part of the intricate local divisions of the highlands.
simp_chinese: 胡比希亚是也门中部高地代姆特周围由村落组成的历史地区。以硫磺泉闻名的代姆特位于其西缘，地区向东延伸，涵盖多处高地聚落。胡比希亚的凯伊马是胡比希家族的祖居地，这一家族的法学家和法官自伊斯兰教早期数世纪起便为也门社群服务。此地属于与拉达相联系的地域，其村庄构成高地复杂地方区划的一部分。

english: Miki lies in the eastern Sanuki plain, between the hills overlooking the Inland Sea and the mountains on the border with Awa. The old Nankaidō road is thought to have crossed the district from east to west, near the later Nagao road. Traces of the ancient grid of fields survive in place names such as Nijō and Sanjō. The plain's ordered divisions recall an early landscape of cultivation and provincial administration.
simp_chinese: 三木位于赞岐东部平原，北侧丘陵面向濑户内海，南侧山地与阿波相接。古代南海道据认为东西横穿此郡，路线接近后来的长尾街道。二条、三条等地名保留着古代方格田地的痕迹，显示这片平原早期耕作和地方行政的布局。

english:
Mikindani lies on a sheltered bay on the southern Tanzanian coast. Its Swahili community stood between the Indian Ocean and the wooded hinterland north of the Rovuma River. Archaeological remains and stone tombs recall a long history of settlement, while the harbour offered a place for vessels moving along the coast. Goods and people passed between the bay, neighbouring communities and the wider maritime world.

The later city of Mtwara lies here.
simp_chinese:
米金达尼位于坦桑尼亚南部海岸的一处避风海湾。这里的斯瓦希里社群处在印度洋与罗武马河以北林地腹地之间。考古遗迹和石造墓葬见证了悠久的聚落历史，港湾则为沿海航行的船只提供停靠之地。货物与人口往返于海湾、邻近社群和更广阔的海上世界之间。

后来的姆特瓦拉即位于此地。

english: Mikiwam is a lake among the wooded hills north of the Ottawa River. Its Algonquin name means a house or dwelling. A mikiwam was made with a frame of poles, often covered with sheets of birchbark sewn together with spruce roots. The bark could be rolled up and carried when a family moved, while the frame was left for future use. This lake country formed part of the wider Algonquin homeland, where families moved between hunting grounds and summer gatherings.
simp_chinese: 米基瓦姆湖位于渥太华河以北的林木丘陵中，湖名在阿尔冈昆语中意为房屋或住所。米基瓦姆以木杆搭成骨架，常用云杉根缝合的桦树皮覆盖。家庭迁往别处时，树皮可以卷起带走，骨架则留待日后使用。这片湖区属于更广阔的阿尔冈昆人家园，家庭在猎地与夏季聚会地点之间往来。

english: Mikkeli lies in the lake country of Savo in eastern Finland. The 1323 Treaty of Nöteborg placed the Savilahti parish under Swedish rule; the locality had acquired the name Mikkeli, after the archangel Michael, by the early sixteenth century. In January 1597 more than two hundred peasant rebels were killed at the Kenkävero parsonage during the Cudgel War. The district again lay near fighting in 1789, when Swedish forces defeated a Russian attack at Porrassalmi south of the settlement. Finland passed under Russian rule in 1809, and Mikkeli received its town charter in 1838, just beyond the period represented here. Before its formal establishment as a town, the parish served a countryside of farms, forests and lakes.
simp_chinese: 米凯利位于芬兰东部的萨沃湖区。1323年的诺特堡条约将萨维拉赫蒂教区划入瑞典统治；至迟到十六世纪初，当地已以大天使米迦勒之名称为米凯利。1597年1月，棍棒战争期间，二百多名农民起事者在肯凯韦罗牧师住宅被杀。1789年，当地南面的波拉斯萨尔米再次发生战斗，瑞典军队击退俄军进攻。1809年芬兰转归俄国，米凯利于1838年获得城市特许，略晚于这里所述的时代。在正式成为城镇之前，教区服务于农庄、森林和湖泊组成的乡村。

english:
The Mikkwa, or Little Red River, rises in the Birch Mountains and winds through forested lowlands to join the Peace River. Its Cree name refers to the red colour of its waters. Near the Peace, the river meanders across flat ground, leaving oxbow lakes. Moose and caribou inhabit the surrounding country, and the river is associated with the hunting lands of the Little Red River Cree.

In 1798 or 1799, John Thomson of the North West Company built a fort on the Peace opposite the mouth of the Mikkwa. By 1805 it had been abandoned and lay in ruins. It belonged to a period when fur traders were establishing posts along the Peace River and seeking to draw northern hunters into their trade.
simp_chinese:
米夸河又称小红河，发源于伯奇山脉，蜿蜒穿过森林低地，汇入和平河。它的克里语名称指河水的红色。在靠近和平河的平坦地带，河道曲折，留下许多牛轭湖。周围有驼鹿和驯鹿出没，河流也长期与小红河克里人的猎地相联系。

1798年或1799年，西北公司的约翰·汤姆森在和平河北岸、米夸河口对面建起一座堡垒。这座商站存在的时间并不长：到1805年，它已被废弃，化为废墟。当时毛皮商人正沿和平河设立据点，试图吸引北方内陆的猎人参与贸易。

english: Mikshino stood near the road between Bezhetsk and Torzhok, within the old Stuchevo church district. War and the famine of 1601–1602 devastated its earlier inhabitants. In the latter half of the seventeenth century Karelians from the Lake Ladoga region resettled the deserted land, adding their language and customs to the Tver countryside. In 1768 a wooden Trinity church was brought to Mikshino from Znamenskoye, giving the village a church of its own.
simp_chinese: 米克希诺位于别热茨克与托尔若克之间的道路附近，属于古老的斯图切沃教堂辖区。战争与1601—1602年的饥荒使原先的居民遭到重创。十七世纪后半叶，来自拉多加湖地区的卡累利阿人重新定居于荒废的土地，将自己的语言与习俗带入特维尔乡村。1768年，一座木造圣三一教堂从兹纳缅斯科耶迁来，村庄因此有了自己的教堂。

english: Miksiw Sipisis lies near Eagle Creek in the grasslands of western Saskatchewan. The creek begins at Eaglehill Lake and follows a valley cut by glacial water before turning east across flatter prairie. It eventually joins the North Saskatchewan River, carrying drainage from the country around Rosetown and Biggar toward the larger waterway. The shallow valley and scattered wetlands interrupt the open prairie.
simp_chinese: 米克休西比靠近萨斯喀彻温西部草原上的鹰溪。溪流发源于鹰丘湖，沿冰川水流切出的谷地行进，随后转向东方穿过较平坦的草原。它最终汇入北萨斯喀彻温河，将罗斯敦与比格一带的水带向大河。浅谷和零散湿地为开阔草原增添起伏。

english: Mikulino lies among lakes east of Vitebsk, beside the lake that bears its name. It was the centre of a district whose lands included Liozno. In 1555 King Sigismund granted the district to Hryhoriy Valovich; through his daughter's marriage it passed to the Ogiński family. At the division of the family estates in 1625, Lew Samuel Ogiński received Mikulino and Liozno, linking the two places in the fortunes of this Lithuanian princely house.
simp_chinese: 米库利诺位于维捷布斯克以东的湖泊地带，坐落在同名湖畔。它曾是一个辖区的中心，辖地包括廖兹诺。1555年，齐格蒙特国王将这一地区赐予赫雷霍里·沃洛维奇；通过其女儿的婚姻，领地转入奥金斯基家族。1625年家族分割产业时，列夫·萨穆埃尔·奥金斯基获得米库利诺和廖兹诺，使两地与这个立陶宛亲王家族的命运相连。

english:
Mikulin stood on the Shosha as the centre of a small principality within the lands of Tver. Its fortified position lay near the borders of Tver, Novgorod and Moscow, and its princes played an active part in the struggles of the fourteenth century. Mikhail Alexandrovich used Mikulin as a base in his contest for the throne of Tver, which he first obtained in 1365. Under his patronage a stone cathedral dedicated to the Archangel Michael rose within the fortress.

Mikhail's descendants continued to rule the appanage. Prince Fyodor Fyodorovich struck silver coins bearing his name and those of the grand princes of Tver, expressing both his own authority and his connection to the senior dynasty. In 1485 Mikulin passed into the expanding Moscow state with the other lands of Tver. Its former political importance diminished, but the cathedral and earthworks preserved the memory of the princely town on the Shosha.
simp_chinese:
米库林位于绍沙河畔，是特维尔土地上一个小公国的中心。这座设防城镇靠近特维尔、诺夫哥罗德和莫斯科的边界，其王公积极参与十四世纪的权力斗争。米哈伊尔·亚历山德罗维奇以米库林为基地争夺特维尔大公位，并于1365年首次取得该位。在他的支持下，堡垒内建起了一座供奉总领天使米迦勒的石造主教座堂。

米哈伊尔的后代继续统治这片分封领地。费奥多尔·费奥多罗维奇亲王铸造银币，上面既有自己的名字，也有特维尔大公的名字，体现了他的权力及与宗主王朝的联系。1485年，米库林与特维尔其他土地一起并入不断扩张的莫斯科国家。它昔日的政治地位逐渐衰退，但主教座堂和土垒保留了这座绍沙河畔王公城镇的记忆。

english: The Mikuni Mountains rise along the boundary between the inland country of Shinano and the lands to its north and east. Their ridges form part of the watershed between the Shinano and Tone river systems. Snow falls heavily on their northern slopes, while the southern side faces the drier winter weather of the Pacific coast. Passes through the range offer routes across a formidable barrier of peaks and deep valleys.
simp_chinese: 三国山脉耸立于信浓内陆与北方、东方地区之间，其山脊构成信浓川和利根川水系的部分分水岭。山脉北坡冬季降雪丰厚，南侧则面向太平洋一侧较干燥的冬季气候。山间隘口为穿越高峰与深谷组成的屏障提供了道路。

english: Mila lies west of Constantine in northeastern Algeria, on a hill between valleys. Known in antiquity as Milev, it was a Roman town and a Christian bishopric. Its old town retains traces of Byzantine walls, while the mosque of Sidi Ghanem recalls the early Islamic period. Medieval geographers described Mila as a small town on the route between Constantine and Béjaïa, in a region of grain and fruit cultivation.
simp_chinese: 米拉位于阿尔及利亚东北部君士坦丁以西，坐落在两条河谷之间的山丘上。古代称为米莱夫的它曾是罗马城镇和基督教主教座地。老城保留着拜占庭城墙的痕迹，西迪加奈姆清真寺则让人想起伊斯兰时代早期。中世纪地理学家将米拉描述为君士坦丁与贝贾亚之间道路上的小城，周围地区出产谷物和水果。

english: The Milanesia coast lies beneath the wooded Otway ranges on the southeastern Australian shore. Cliffs and beaches face the waters of Bass Strait, while streams descend through steep forested valleys. The coast belongs to Gadubanud country, whose people maintained connections between the forested interior and the sea.
simp_chinese: 米兰尼西亚海岸位于澳大利亚东南岸林木覆盖的奥特韦山地下方。峭壁和海滩面向巴斯海峡，溪流穿过陡峭森林河谷流下。这段海岸属于加杜巴努德人的土地，当地人维系森林内陆与海洋之间的联系。

english: Milange lies in the hilly country south of the Ruo River, with Mount Tumbine rising to the east and the much larger Mulanje massif to the north. Streams descending from Mulanje feed the Ruo, which flows west to join the Shire. Its waters link these wooded uplands with the lower river valley and, farther south, the Zambezi. The mountain slopes and valleys give this part of the country a varied landscape.
simp_chinese: 米兰杰位于鲁奥河南岸的丘陵地带，东有通比内山，北面则是更为高大的穆兰杰山群。自穆兰杰山流下的溪流汇入鲁奥河，河水向西注入希雷河，将这片林木覆盖的高地与下游河谷乃至更南方的赞比西河联系起来。山坡和河谷共同构成了这一带多样的地貌。

english:
Milas lies in the inland plain of ancient Caria, beneath hills rich in marble. The ancient city of Mylasa was a centre of Carian rule and left behind temples, tombs and finely worked stone monuments. Above the plain, the fortress of Beçin became a seat of the Menteşe dynasty, whose rulers controlled a principality extending toward the Aegean coast.

In 1375 Ahmed Gazi of Menteşe founded a madrasa within Beçin. Its stone portal opened onto a courtyard, and the patron's tomb lay inside the building. Mosques, baths and houses grew around the fortress, making the hill a political and religious centre for the dynasty. Ottoman rule later replaced that of the Menteşe rulers, but their buildings remained above Milas as witnesses to an age of local principalities.
simp_chinese:
米拉斯位于古代卡里亚的内陆平原，背靠盛产大理石的山丘。古城米拉萨曾是卡里亚统治中心，留下神庙、墓葬和精雕石碑。平原上方的贝钦堡垒后来成为门泰谢王朝的驻地，其公国向爱琴海岸延伸。

1375年，门泰谢的艾哈迈德加齐在贝钦堡内创建经学院。石造门廊通向庭院，捐建者的陵墓位于建筑内。清真寺、浴场和住宅围绕堡垒发展，使山丘成为王朝的政治与宗教中心。奥斯曼统治后来取代门泰谢统治者，但他们的建筑仍立于米拉斯上方，见证地方公国时代。

english: Mile lies among the hills and cultivated valleys of southeastern Yunnan. Under the Yuan and Ming it was a subordinate prefecture of Guangxi, governed by hereditary local officials. In the early Ming its chief Ang Pude offered horses and valuables to the court and retained his office. During the Chenghua reign, the Ming replaced hereditary rule in Mile with appointed officials. The change brought a new administration to a district whose communities had long been governed by local chiefs.
simp_chinese: 弥勒位于云南东南部，山岭之间分布着耕作的河谷。元明时期，弥勒州属广西府一带，由世袭土官治理。明初，土官昻普德向朝廷进献马匹与财物，继续统领州事。成化年间，明朝在弥勒推行改土归流，以朝廷派遣的官员取代世袭土官，改变了当地长期以来的治理方式。

english: Milford Haven is a deep, branching natural harbour on the coast of Pembrokeshire, sheltered from the Atlantic by headlands and islands. Its waters have served as an anchorage and a staging place for voyages to Ireland. In 1485 Henry Tudor landed at Mill Bay near the entrance with an army from France, beginning the campaign that won him the English crown. Centuries later Sir William Hamilton founded a new town on the haven in 1790 and encouraged whaling families from Nantucket to establish a fleet there.
simp_chinese: 米尔福德港是彭布罗克郡海岸深入陆地、分支众多的天然港湾，岬角与岛屿为它遮挡大西洋风浪。港湾既是锚地，也是前往爱尔兰航程的集结处。1485年，亨利·都铎率军从法国来到港口入口附近的米尔湾，开始了夺取英格兰王位的征程。数百年后，威廉·汉密尔顿爵士于1790年在港湾建立新镇，鼓励楠塔基特的捕鲸家庭在此组建船队。

english: Mili lies at the southern end of the Ratak chain, its coral islets bordering a large lagoon. In 1788 canoes came out to the Scarborough and Charlotte and islanders traded with their crews. In 1824 the mutinous whaler Globe reached Mili; fighting among the mutineers and with islanders left only two of those stranded ashore alive to be rescued.
simp_chinese: 米里位于拉塔克岛链南端，珊瑚小岛围绕大潟湖。1788年，独木舟驶向斯卡伯勒号和夏洛特号，岛民与船员交易。1824年，发生哗变的捕鲸船环球号抵达米里；哗变者内部以及他们与岛民的冲突，使留在岸上的人中仅两名幸存者后来获救。

english: Mili is a coral atoll in the southeastern Marshall Islands. In 1788 the British ships Scarborough and Charlotte encountered islanders here while travelling toward China. A canoe came alongside and trade followed, adding a brief written record to an older Marshallese maritime world.
simp_chinese: 米利是马绍尔群岛东南部的一座珊瑚环礁。1788年，英国“斯卡伯勒”号和“夏洛特”号驶往中国途中在这里遇见岛民。独木舟驶近船只，双方随后交易，为更古老的马绍尔海洋世界留下一则简短文字记载。

english: Miliana stands on a rocky shelf beneath Mount Zaccar, overlooking the Chelif valley. The Roman settlement of Zucchabar preceded the medieval town, rebuilt by Buluggin ibn Ziri in the tenth century. Its springs and channels watered gardens and orchards, while the wooded mountain rose behind the town. The shrine of Sidi Ahmed Benyoucef became a focus of local religious life and pilgrimage. Oruç Reis took Miliana in 1517, bringing it into the expanding Ottoman sphere. In 1835 Emir Abd al-Qadir made the town one of the centres of his resistance to French occupation.
simp_chinese: 米利亚纳坐落在扎卡尔山下的岩台上，俯瞰谢利夫河谷。罗马时期的祖卡巴尔先于这座中古城镇存在，布卢金·伊本·齐里于十世纪重建此城。泉水和水渠灌溉着园圃与果园，林木覆盖的山岭则耸立在城后。西迪·艾哈迈德·本优素福的陵祠成为当地宗教生活与朝圣的重要中心。1517年，奥鲁奇·雷斯夺取米利亚纳，使它进入不断扩张的奥斯曼势力范围。1835年，埃米尔阿卜杜勒卡迪尔将此城作为抵抗法国占领的中心之一。

english:
Milicz lies on the Barycz in Lower Silesia. Its castle is mentioned in 1136, and the inhabitants received town privileges in 1245. The district belonged to the duchy of Oleśnica from 1313; in 1358 the bishops of Wrocław sold their Milicz estates to Duke Konrad, whose successors built a Gothic castle. Hussite forces attacked the town in 1432.

In 1494 King Vladislas granted Milicz to Sigismund Kurzbach, and the Maltzan family acquired the Milicz lordship in 1590. A Protestant Church of Grace was completed in 1714 following permission granted under the Convention of Altranstädt. Prussia conquered the town during the First Silesian War in 1742.
simp_chinese:
米利奇位于下西里西亚巴雷奇河畔。当地城堡见于1136年的记载，居民于1245年获得城镇特权。1313年起地区属于奥莱希尼察公国；1358年弗罗茨瓦夫主教将米利奇地产售予康拉德公爵，其继承者修建了哥特式城堡。1432年胡斯派军队袭击城镇。

1494年国王弗拉迪斯拉夫将米利奇授予西吉斯蒙德·库尔茨巴赫，1590年马尔察恩家族取得米利奇领地。依据《阿尔特兰施泰特协定》取得的许可，当地新教徒于1714年建成一座恩典教堂。1742年，普鲁士在第一次西里西亚战争中占领米利奇。

english: Yurruwi, known as Milingimbi, is one of the Crocodile Islands off Arnhem Land. The islands and surrounding seas are Yolŋu country, including that of the Yan-nhangu people. Makassan fishers came seasonally to these shores to gather trepang, working and trading with local people.
simp_chinese: 尤鲁维又称米林金比，是阿纳姆地外鳄鱼群岛中的一座岛。岛群及周围海域属于雍古人的土地，包括扬南古人的地区。望加锡渔民季节性来到这些海岸采集海参，与当地人共同工作和贸易。

english: Split Rock rises above the Sweetwater valley in central Wyoming, a granite height with a conspicuous notch in its summit. The cleft formed where a band of darker rock intruded into the granite and weathered away. Farther south, the Sweetwater flows east from the Wind River Mountains toward the North Platte. Fur traders including Jedediah Smith knew the valley as a route across the country toward South Pass.
simp_chinese: 裂石山耸立在怀俄明中部的斯威特沃特河谷上方，花岗岩山顶有一道醒目的缺口。较暗的岩脉侵入花岗岩，随后风化剥落，留下这道裂口。南面的斯威特沃特河从温德河山脉向东流向北普拉特河；杰戴代亚·史密斯等毛皮商人熟悉这条通往南山口方向的河谷路线。

english:
Milkovo lies in the valley of the Kamchatka River, where the Imcherek joins the greater waterway. The valley has long been home to Itelmen communities, whose settlements included Iromlin and Kirgen. Wooded ground and rivers distinguish this interior part of the peninsula from the volcanic ridges that rise on either side.

In 1698 Cossacks built the Upper Kamchatka fort in the river valley. Several decades later the Russian authorities sought to establish farming on the peninsula. In 1743 five peasant families brought from the Lena country settled on the Imcherek near the fort. Their village became known as Milkovo, and the small river acquired the name Milkovushka. The settlers lived close to the Itelmen population of the valley, exchanging goods and knowledge with their neighbours.
simp_chinese:
米尔科沃位于堪察加河谷，伊姆切列克河在此汇入较大的河流。河谷长久以来是伊捷尔缅人的家园，他们的聚落包括伊罗姆林和基尔根。半岛内陆这片地区有林地与河流，与两侧耸起的火山山脊形成鲜明对照。

1698年，哥萨克在河谷建造上堪察加堡。数十年后，俄国当局试图在半岛发展农业。1743年，从勒拿河地区迁来的五户农民在堡垒附近的伊姆切列克河畔定居。他们的村庄称为米尔科沃，小河也获得了米尔科武什卡的名称。移民与河谷中的伊捷尔缅居民比邻而居，同邻人交换物品与知识。

english:
The Illapel River runs through a valley in the semi-arid country of northern Chile, joining the Choapa before it reaches the Pacific. Diaguita communities lived along the river for centuries, making pottery with a shared local tradition and establishing settlements on its terraces. Rock engravings also mark the landscape around the valley, including examples at Cuz Cuz and Limahuida attributed to earlier inhabitants.

Under Inca rule, settlements occupied ground already used by Diaguita communities, and pottery acquired new forms and decorative motifs, including designs previously unknown in the valley. The Inca road passed through the mountains of the district; Spanish expeditions later followed it southwards. In 1754 the colonial authorities approved the foundation of a villa in the Cuz-Cuz valley, which developed into Illapel.
simp_chinese:
伊亚佩尔河流经智利北部半干旱地区的一座河谷，汇入乔阿帕河后流向太平洋。迪亚吉塔社群在河畔生活了数百年，在河阶建立聚落，并制作具有共同地方传统的陶器。河谷周围的岩刻也为这片土地留下了印记，其中库斯库斯和利马维达的岩刻被认为出自更早的居民。

印加统治时期，聚落占据了迪亚吉塔社群原先使用的土地，陶器也出现了新的形制和装饰纹样，其中有些此前并未见于河谷。印加大道穿过当地山地，西班牙远征队后来沿路南行。1754年，殖民当局批准在库斯库斯河谷建立城镇，后来发展为伊亚佩尔。

english:
Millau lies at the meeting of the Tarn and Dourbie in Rouergue. A consular charter of 1187 established a municipal government responsible for taxation and justice; the town passed to the French crown in 1271. Its medieval bridge across the Tarn carried a route connecting northern and southern France.

In 1361, during the Hundred Years' War, Millau came under English rule. Peace in the fifteenth century encouraged economic recovery, and Louis XI confirmed its attachment to the crown in 1476. Leatherworking and lambskin gloves formed part of the town's long craft tradition, while its municipal consuls continued to shape local affairs.
simp_chinese:
米约位于鲁埃格的塔恩河与杜尔比河汇合处。1187年的执政官特许状设立负责赋税和司法的市政机构；1271年城镇转归法国王室。中世纪横跨塔恩河的桥梁承载了连接法国南北的道路。

百年战争期间，米约于1361年转入英方统治。15世纪和平促进经济恢复，路易十一在1476年确认其归属王室。皮革加工和羔羊皮手套是当地长期的手工业传统，市政执政官则继续处理地方事务。

english: Millcayac was a Huarpe language spoken around Mendoza and in lands to its south. Its speakers lived east of the Andes, where river water sustained agriculture in an otherwise dry region. The Jesuit Luis de Valdivia published a grammar, vocabulary and religious texts in Millcayac in 1607, seeking to assist missionary work among Huarpe people. Many had been taken across the mountains to work in Chile under Spanish rule.
simp_chinese: 米尔卡亚克语是门多萨及其以南地区瓦尔佩人所使用的语言。说这种语言的人生活在安第斯山脉以东，河水滋养着这片干旱地区的农业。1607年，耶稣会士路易斯·德巴尔迪维亚出版米尔卡亚克语的语法、词汇和宗教文本，以帮助对瓦尔佩人进行传教。西班牙统治下，许多人被带过群山，到智利劳动。

english: Millka is an archaeological site on a mountain above the Sarhua country in the highlands of Ayacucho. Its elevated position overlooks a landscape of steep valleys and rocky slopes in the southern Peruvian Andes. Communities in this region lived through the expansion of the Inca state and the later arrival of Spanish rule. The site is one of the traces of settlement left in the mountains around Sarhua.
simp_chinese: 米尔卡是阿亚库乔高地萨尔瓦地区上方山顶的一处考古遗址。高处俯瞰秘鲁南部安第斯山脉陡峭河谷与多岩山坡构成的景观。这一地区的社群经历了印加国家扩张和后来的西班牙统治。遗址是萨尔瓦周围山地留存的聚落痕迹之一。

english: Mille Lacs is a broad lake in central Minnesota, surrounded by forests, wetlands and smaller lakes. The Dakota called it Mde Wakan, Spirit Lake, and held it to be a place of religious and cultural importance. The Ojibwe name Misi-zaaga’igan describes a lake that spreads widely. Its outlet, the Rum River, flows south toward the Mississippi. Dakota and Ojibwe communities have both made their homes around its shores, drawing on fish, game and wild rice.
simp_chinese: 千湖是明尼苏达中部的一片大湖，周围有森林、湿地和较小的湖泊。达科他人称它为姆德瓦坎，即圣灵湖，将其视为宗教和文化上的重要地点。奥吉布瓦语名称米西扎加伊甘描述了广阔铺展的湖面。湖水经拉姆河向南流往密西西比河。达科他与奥吉布瓦社群都曾在湖岸居住，利用鱼类、猎物和野米。

english: Millerovo began as an estate on the upper Glubokaya, a tributary of the Seversky Donets. In 1786 the Don Cossack officer Ivan Miller received land here and established a farmstead known as Millerov-Glubokinsky. The river valley is cut by gullies, with open steppe beyond its banks. By 1803 the estate had seventeen households of peasant settlers from Ukrainian lands, illustrating the growth of landed settlements in the Don Cossack country during the late eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 米列罗沃最初是格卢博卡亚河上游的一处庄园，河流是北顿涅茨河的支流。1786年，顿河哥萨克军官伊万·米列尔获赐此地，在此建立名为米列罗夫—格卢博金斯基的农庄。河谷被沟壑切割，岸外是开阔草原。到1803年，庄园已有来自乌克兰地区的十七户农民，反映了十八世纪末顿河哥萨克地区土地聚落的增长。

english: Millewa is an Aboriginal name recorded for the Murray River, whose lower course reaches the great lakes of southern Australia. The river connects inland floodplains with Lake Alexandrina and the waters of the Coorong. These lands and waters are central to Ngarrindjeri country, with wetlands, fish and river channels sustaining communities along the lower Murray.
simp_chinese: 米勒瓦是默里河的原住民记录名称，河流下游抵达澳大利亚南部的大湖。默里河将内陆泛滥平原与亚历山德里娜湖及库隆水域相连。这些土地与水域是恩加林杰里地区的核心，湿地、鱼类和河道养育着默里河下游社群。

english: Millinocket takes its name from an Abenaki expression meaning “land of many islands,” referring to the islands of the Penobscot River. The surrounding lakes and forests belong to the homeland of the Penobscot people. In 1829 Betsy and Thomas Fowler and their family settled near Shad Pond and cleared land for a farm; other families followed in 1837.
simp_chinese: 米利诺基特的名字来自阿贝纳基语，意为“众岛之地”，指的是佩诺布斯科特河中的岛屿。周围的湖泊与森林属于佩诺布斯科特人的家园。1829年，贝齐和托马斯·福勒一家在沙德塘附近定居，开垦土地建立农场；1837年又有其他家庭来到这里。

english: Millioke lies by the western shore of Lake Michigan, where the Milwaukee River reaches the lake. Potawatomi, Menominee and other Indigenous peoples lived in the surrounding country, and French traders and missionaries passed through in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. Alexis Laframboise established a trading post in 1785. In the 1830s, American settlers laid out rival communities on the river's banks; their growth followed the 1833 Treaty of Chicago, under which Indigenous peoples ceded land in the region.
simp_chinese: 米利奥克位于密歇根湖西岸，密尔沃基河在此入湖。波塔瓦托米人、梅诺米尼人及其他原住民居住在周围地区，法国商人与传教士于十七、十八世纪经过这里。1785年，亚历克西·拉弗兰布瓦兹设立了一处贸易站。1830年代，美国移民在河流两岸规划相互竞争的聚落；这些聚落的增长发生在1833年芝加哥条约之后，当时原住民依据条约割让了这一地区的土地。

english: Milne Bay cuts into the southeastern tip of New Guinea, where mainland shores face the islands of the Massim region. Local communities maintained maritime exchange routes before European contact. In 1606 Luis Váez de Torres’s expedition surveyed parts of this southeastern coast.
simp_chinese: 米尔恩湾深入新几内亚东南端，大陆海岸面向马西姆地区的岛屿。与欧洲人接触之前，当地社群已维持海上交换路线。1606年，路易斯·瓦埃斯·德·托雷斯的船队测绘了东南岸部分地区。

english:
A volcanic island in the southwestern Cyclades, Milos supplied obsidian for sharp stone tools across the early Aegean. Its Bronze Age settlement at Phylakopi flourished on the northeastern coast, leaving painted walls and pottery that show connections with Crete and other islands. In 416 BC Athens besieged Melos, killed its adult men and enslaved its women and children after the city resisted incorporation into its empire.

After the Fourth Crusade, Milos became part of Marco Sanudo's Duchy of Naxos. Ottoman authority followed in the 16th century; three locally elected magistrates managed the island's everyday affairs under an Ottoman governor and judge. Russian forces occupied the island for three years from 1771 during the Russo-Turkish War, before it returned again to Ottoman hands.
simp_chinese:
米洛斯是基克拉泽斯群岛西南部的一座火山岛，早期爱琴海各地制作锋利石器所用的黑曜石便来自这里。岛东北岸的青铜时代聚落菲拉科皮曾经繁荣，留下的壁画和陶器显示出与克里特及其他岛屿的联系。公元前416年，米洛斯拒绝加入雅典的帝国，雅典军队围攻并攻陷城市，杀害成年男子，奴役妇女和儿童。

第四次十字军东征后，米洛斯成为马尔科·萨努多纳克索斯公国的一部分。16世纪岛屿转入奥斯曼统治，由三名民选地方官在奥斯曼总督和法官之下管理日常事务。1771年俄土战争期间，俄军占领该岛三年，随后奥斯曼人收复了它。

english: The Milpo mountains rise in the highlands north of Cajamarca, where ridges and valleys shape the northern Peruvian Andes. Cold uplands stand above inhabited basins and the routes between Cajamarca and the Marañón country. This was a region of ancient highland communities before the Incas extended their authority northwards and incorporated its roads and settlements into their empire.
simp_chinese: 米尔波山脉耸立在卡哈马卡以北的高地，山脊和河谷塑造了秘鲁北部安第斯的地貌。寒冷高地俯瞰有人居住的盆地，以及卡哈马卡与马拉尼翁地区之间的道路。印加人将权力向北扩展、把当地道路和聚落纳入帝国之前，这里已是古老高地社群的家园。

english:
Miltenberg occupies a narrow strip between the Main and the wooded slopes of the Odenwald. It grew around a Mainz toll station protected by the Mildenburg, and received town status in 1237. Its staple right required passing merchants to offer goods locally, encouraging inns and warehouses. By the fourteenth century its walls enclosed an area that remained roughly the town's extent until the nineteenth century.

The Main route and the road between Nuremberg and Frankfurt helped make Miltenberg a significant member of the Mainz league of nine towns. During the Peasants' War of 1525, local official Friedrich Weygand supported the peasants and was executed. The town remained under Electoral Mainz until 1803; subsequent territorial changes placed it successively under Leiningen, Baden and Hesse-Darmstadt before it became Bavarian in 1816.
simp_chinese:
米尔滕贝格位于美因河与奥登瓦尔德林木坡地之间的狭长地带。它围绕美因茨的一处河岸关税站发展，由米尔登堡保护，并于1237年获得城镇地位。货物堆栈权要求过往商人在当地出售商品，促进了旅店和仓库的兴建。到14世纪，城墙围合的范围大体维持至19世纪。

美因河水路和纽伦堡至法兰克福的道路，使米尔滕贝格成为美因茨九城联盟的重要成员。1525年农民战争期间，当地官员弗里德里希·魏甘德支持农民，随后遭处决。城镇直到1803年都属于美因茨选侯领地；此后先后转属莱宁根、巴登和黑森-达姆施塔特，1816年归入巴伐利亚。

english: Milwat lies near Basohli in the foothills of the western Himalaya. In the late seventeenth century Basohli became a centre of painting under its local rajas. Raja Kirpal Pal patronised artists whose works used vivid colour and expressive faces. Among the subjects of the Basohli painters was the Rasamanjari, a poetic text on love and its moods.
simp_chinese: 密瓦特位于喜马拉雅西部山麓，靠近巴索利。十七世纪末，巴索利在当地拉贾统治下成为绘画中心。基尔帕尔·帕尔王赞助的画师使用鲜明色彩和富有表现力的面容；他们描绘的题材之一是讲述爱情及其情绪的诗作《拉萨曼贾里》。

english: The coast near Milyakburra faces the channels and islands of the Groote Eylandt archipelago in the Gulf of Carpentaria. These waters are part of Anindilyakwa country. From the eighteenth century, Makassan visitors sailed seasonally to northern Australia to gather and process trepang, trading with Aboriginal communities.
simp_chinese: 米利亚克布拉附近海岸面向卡奔塔利亚湾格鲁特岛群的水道与岛屿，是阿宁迪利亚夸人的海域。自18世纪起，望加锡访客季节性驶往澳大利亚北部，采集、加工海参并与原住民社群贸易。

english: The steppe around Milyutinskaya lies along the Gnilaya, amid the rivers and floodplains between the Don and the Donets. The Gnilaya, Berezovaya and Rossosh cross open country once used by the nomadic peoples of the southern steppe. Settlement in these valleys grew in the later eighteenth century as the Don frontier changed. The Cossack stanitsa of Milyutinskaya itself was founded only after the period of the old frontier.
simp_chinese: 米柳京斯卡亚周围的草原沿格尼拉亚河展开，位于顿河与顿涅茨河之间的河流和泛滥平原地带。格尼拉亚河、别廖佐瓦亚河与罗索希河穿过开阔地带，南方草原的游牧民族曾在此活动。随着顿河边疆变化，这些河谷的定居活动在十八世纪后期增加。米柳京斯卡亚哥萨克村社本身则直到旧边疆时代之后才建立。

english:
Mima lies in Awa on Shikoku, around the middle Yoshino River. Settlements and fields occupy the river plain and smaller valleys, with mountain slopes rising on either side. During the Sengoku period Iwakura and Waki castles became strongholds of the Miyoshi family, whose power extended across parts of Shikoku and the Kansai region.

After the Hachisuka family took control of Awa, Waki Castle served as one of its regional strongholds until the early Edo restriction on castles. Wakimachi continued to prosper as a commercial centre, gathering indigo for shipment along the Yoshino. In the Edo period the plains produced rice, barley and indigo leaves, while mountain communities cut timber and made charcoal and paper.
simp_chinese:
美马位于四国阿波的吉野川中游地区。村落与农田分布在河边平原和较小谷地，两侧山坡向上延伸。战国时期，岩仓城和脇城成为三好氏的据点，该家族的势力连接四国部分地区与关西。

蜂须贺氏进入阿波后，脇城成为地方据点之一，直至江户初期一国一城令下废城。脇町此后仍作为商业中心繁荣，集散的蓝染原料经吉野川水运。江户时期，平原盛行水稻、麦与蓝叶种植，山间居民则采伐木材、生产薪炭并造纸。

english: Mimbara is the recorded name of the northernmost Ngadjuri group in southern Australia. Ngadjuri country reaches through the inland hills towards the southern Flinders Ranges, north of the Adelaide Plains. Gum woodland, rocky ridges and seasonal creeks form the country of communities whose relationships extended to their Nukunu and other neighbours.
simp_chinese: 明巴拉是南澳大利亚最北部恩加朱里人群的记录名称。恩加朱里地区穿过阿德莱德平原以北的内陆丘陵，延伸至南弗林德斯山脉。桉树林、岩石山脊和季节性溪流构成当地土地，社群与努库努人及其他邻居保持联系。

english:
Mimizan belongs to the coastal Landes country of Gascony, where Atlantic shores, sandy ground and inland waters shaped settlement and production. Communities combined farming, livestock and the use of woodland or heath resources, adapting to soils and water conditions that differed from the more fertile river valleys farther inland. Roads and paths linked local settlements with markets and religious places. Coastal weather and shifting sand could make land use demanding, requiring practical experience and collective maintenance.

Around 1010 monks from Saint-Sever founded a priory at Mimizan, which became the centre of a church-protected refuge. It also served pilgrims travelling along the coast towards Santiago de Compostela. During the early modern period, fishing and other coastal activities complemented inland livelihoods. The later expansion of pine forests would transform much of the Landes, while earlier communities used a varied landscape of cultivation, grazing and open ground.
simp_chinese:
米米藏属于加斯科涅沿海朗德地区，大西洋海岸、沙地与内陆水域，塑造聚居和生产。社区结合耕作、牲畜及林地或荒原资源，适应不同于较远肥沃河谷的水土条件。道路、小径联系地方聚落、市场和宗教场所。沿海天气与流沙可能使土地利用艰难，需要实际经验和共同维护。居民通过家庭劳动及社区关系，在多样资源之间安排生计，并应对环境不断变化。

约1010年，来自圣塞韦尔的修士在米米藏建立修院，后来这里成为教会保护的避难地中心，也为沿海前往圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉的朝圣者提供落脚处。近代早期，捕鱼等沿海活动补充内陆生计。后来松林扩展改变了朗德的许多地方，较早的社群则利用由耕地、牧场和开阔土地组成的多样景观。

english:
Minab stands in the fertile coastal country near the site of Old Hormuz, the mainland port that once served Kerman and Sistan. The old harbour lay on a creek connected with the Minab River, amid a region of date palms. Merchants brought goods through it from the interior to ships bound across the Indian Ocean. Its rulers also held ports on the Arabian shore, including Qalhat and Julfar.

Marco Polo visited Hormuz twice in the late thirteenth century and remarked on its flourishing trade and oppressive climate. Repeated incursions into southeastern Persia led its ruler Ayaz to transfer his people and possessions to the island of Jarun, where a new Hormuz rose. The neighbouring fortress of Minab remained important: the king of Hormuz took refuge there in 1318, and Timur's son Sultan Muhammad captured it in 1397.

The fortunes of the mainland settlement remained closely tied to the island kingdom and the struggle for its maritime revenues. After the Portuguese took island Hormuz, Minab was listed among its mainland dependencies. It sheltered Portuguese and Iranian families during the Ottoman attack on Hormuz in 1552 and came under Safavid control in 1602. In 1621 English East India Company representatives negotiated there with Imam Quli Khan, agreeing to assist Shah Abbas in the campaign against the Portuguese on Hormuz and Qeshm.
simp_chinese:
米纳卜位于肥沃的海岸地区，附近是旧霍尔木兹遗址。这座大陆港口曾为克尔曼和锡斯坦服务，港湾坐落在与米纳卜河相通的水道旁，周围遍布椰枣林。商人将内陆货物运到这里，再装船驶往印度洋各地。霍尔木兹统治者还占有阿拉伯海岸的盖勒哈特和朱勒法尔等港口。

马可·波罗十三世纪末两次到访霍尔木兹，记述其繁盛的贸易和酷热的气候。伊朗东南部屡遭入侵后，统治者阿亚兹将居民与财物迁往杰伦岛，建立新霍尔木兹。邻近的米纳卜堡仍具重要地位：1318年霍尔木兹国王曾在此避难，1397年帖木儿之子苏丹·穆罕默德攻占此堡。

大陆聚落的命运仍与岛上王国及其海上收入的争夺紧密相连。葡萄牙占领岛上霍尔木兹后，米纳卜被列为其大陆属地之一。1552年奥斯曼舰队进攻霍尔木兹时，葡萄牙与伊朗家庭曾在此避难；1602年米纳卜归于萨法维控制。1621年英国东印度公司代表在此与伊玛目·古里汗谈判，同意协助阿拔斯沙阿在霍尔木兹和格什姆岛驱逐葡萄牙人。

english: The inland Abashiri country lies north of the Akan mountains, along rivers flowing toward Lake Abashiri and the Sea of Okhotsk. Ainu settlements occupied this wooded region, whose river valleys offered a passage between the interior and the coast. Between 1808 and 1810 a route was opened from Shiranuka on the Pacific side, across the Akan district and down the Abashiri River toward the northern shore.
simp_chinese: 网尻地区位于阿寒山地以北的内陆，河流流向网走湖和鄂霍次克海。森林覆盖的地域中有阿伊努聚落，河谷为内陆与海岸之间提供通路。1808年至1810年，一条道路从太平洋一侧的白糠穿过阿寒地区，沿网走川通往北岸。

english: Minamiaizu lies in the mountain valleys of southern Aizu, where forests and high ridges surround limited cultivated land. Snowy winters shape travel and the agricultural year. In the Edo period the area belonged to Aizu Domain, whose government organised taxation, roads and local obligations, while villages kept their own institutions and cooperative work. Routes through the passes carried travellers and goods toward central Japan.
simp_chinese: 南会津位于会津南部山谷，森林与高山环绕有限的耕地。多雪的冬季影响交通与农业时序。江户时代此地属会津藩，藩政组织赋税、道路和地方义务，村庄则保有自身机构与合作劳动。越过山口的道路把货物与旅人送往日本中部。

english: The upper Tokachi country lies among the mountains of central Ezo, where the Sahoro River flows toward the Tokachi plain. Ainu from Tokachi and the Kamikawa basin met in the mountains to hunt and maintained routes across the watershed. Paths near the headwaters of the Sorachi and Sahoro offered passage between the Furano basin and Tokachi, joining communities on opposite sides of the high country.
simp_chinese: 十胜上游地区位于虾夷地中部群山之间，佐幌川从这里流向十胜平原。十胜与上川盆地的阿伊努人曾在山中会合狩猎，也保持越过分水岭的道路。空知川与佐幌川源头附近的路径连接富良野盆地和十胜，使山地两侧的社区得以往来。

english: Southern Matsuura encompasses the Gotō Islands off western Kyushu, where Fukue was a final Japanese stopping place for embassies sailing to Tang China. Ships waited for favourable winds, took on provisions and repaired their vessels before crossing the East China Sea. Temples on the island preserve memories of these journeys: the monk Kūkai is said to have stopped in Gotō on his way to China in 804. The islands remained a meeting place of sea routes and religious traditions.
simp_chinese: 南松浦包括九州西部的五岛列岛。福江岛曾是遣唐使横渡东海前最后的日本寄泊地，船只在此候风、补给并修理。岛上寺院保存着相关记忆：相传僧人空海于804年前往唐朝时曾停留五岛。这些岛屿的历史交织着海上航路与宗教传统。

english: The Mogami River winds through the inland valleys of Dewa, carrying the waters of the southern Mogami country toward the Sea of Japan. At Ōishida, the river also brought together poets. In 1689, on his journey through the north, Matsuo Bashō and his companion Sora joined local poets Takano Ichiei and Takakuwa Sensui to compose a thirty-six-verse linked poem. The surviving scroll is known as the Mogami River kasen.
simp_chinese: 最上川蜿蜒穿过出羽内陆河谷，将最上南部的水流带向日本海。在大石田，这条河也聚集了诗人。1689年，松尾芭蕉游历北方时，与旅伴曾良及当地俳人高野一荣、高桑川水共同创作了一首三十六句的连句。留存至今的卷轴又称《最上川歌仙》。

english: Southern Morokata lies in the inland country of Hyūga, along the approaches from the Miyazaki plain toward Satsuma. At Takaoka, Mukasa Castle guarded a region that had formed part of the great Shimazu estate in the Middle Ages. Control of the fortress changed during the struggles between the Itō and Shimazu families, before it returned to Shimazu hands. Its history reflects the long contest for authority across southern Kyushu.
simp_chinese: 南诸县位于日向内陆，地处宫崎平原通往萨摩的道路上。高冈的穆佐城守卫着这一地区；中世纪时，此地曾属于广阔的岛津庄。伊东氏与岛津氏争斗期间，城堡几易其主，最终回到岛津氏手中，其历史反映了九州南部漫长的权力争夺。

english: Southern Muro lies on the rugged Kumano coast of Kii, where mountains meet the open Pacific. At Hana no Iwaya, a great rock facing the sea is revered as the burial place of Izanami, mother of the gods in Japanese myth. Flowers offered in her honour are said to have given the shrine its name. Instead of a conventional sanctuary, the rock itself forms the sacred object around which worship is conducted.
simp_chinese: 南牟娄位于纪伊崎岖的熊野海岸，山地在此逼近太平洋。花之窟一块面海的巨岩被奉为日本神话中众神之母伊奘冉尊的葬所。人们为祭祀她而献花，据说神社因此得名。这里没有通常的正殿，岩石本身便是祭拜的神体。

english: The middle Tokachi River country is a landscape of broad river valleys and wooded plains. Ainu settlements stood beside the Tokachi and its tributaries, near salmon fisheries and deer hunting grounds; their inhabitants also grew small quantities of millet. The winding Toshibetsu River joins the Tokachi in this district, its name recalling a rope-like course. In 1800 Minagawa Shūdayū traveled through the interior and recorded the Ainu communities along the river.
simp_chinese: 十胜川中游拥有宽阔河谷与林木覆盖的平原。阿伊努聚落分布在十胜川及其支流沿岸，附近有鲑鱼渔场和猎鹿场，居民也少量种植粟和稗。蜿蜒的利别川在此汇入十胜川，其名称形容河道如绳索曲折。1800年，皆川周太夫踏查内陆，记录了沿河阿伊努社区的居住情况。

english: The Uonuma valley lies among the mountains of southern Echigo, watered by the Uono River. Sakado Castle stood above the valley as the stronghold of the Ueda Nagao family. Uesugi Kagekatsu spent his childhood there with Higuchi Kanetsugu, later known as Naoe Kanetsugu, who became one of his closest retainers. After Uesugi Kenshin died in 1578, Kagekatsu fought a succession struggle against Kagetora, whose supporters held Kabasawa Castle across the river.
simp_chinese: 鱼沼谷地位于越后南部群山之间，鱼野川流经其间。坂户城俯瞰河谷，是上田长尾家的据点。上杉景胜与后来改名直江兼续的樋口兼续幼年在此度过，后者成为景胜的重要家臣。1578年上杉谦信去世后，景胜与景虎争夺继承权；景虎一方占据了隔河相望的桦泽城。

english: Minang country encompasses the southern coast of Western Australia around King George Sound, Albany and Denmark. Bays and wooded country form part of the homeland of this Noongar people. In 1826 a British military party established a post at King George Sound, beginning a period of direct and lasting colonial presence in a region with a much longer Indigenous history.
simp_chinese: 米南人的土地涵盖西澳大利亚南部海岸的乔治王湾、奥尔巴尼和丹麦镇一带。海湾与林地共同构成这一努恩加族群的家园。1826年，英国军队在乔治王湾设立据点，殖民势力开始在这个已有悠久原住民历史的地区长期存在。

english: The shallow Minas Basin lies at the eastern end of the Bay of Fundy, joined to it by the narrow Minas Passage. Its immense tides uncover broad mudflats and salt marshes, then flood them again within hours. On the southern shore at Grand-Pré, Acadian farmers began in the seventeenth century to drain marshland behind dikes fitted with wooden sluices. The basin became a centre of Acadian settlement until British authorities began deporting its inhabitants in 1755.
simp_chinese: 浅水的米纳斯盆地位于芬迪湾东端，狭窄的米纳斯水道将两者连接起来。巨大的潮汐露出宽阔泥滩和盐沼，数小时后又将其淹没。十七世纪，南岸大普雷的阿卡迪亚农民开始修筑带木制水闸的堤坝，将沼泽排水变为农田。盆地成为阿卡迪亚人的聚居中心，直到1755年英国当局开始驱逐这里的居民。

english: The Sierra de las Minas stretches across eastern Guatemala between the Motagua and Polochic valleys. Clouds gather around its high ridges and sustain extensive forests, while streams descend toward the drier country below. Deposits of jadeite occur along the Motagua, on the range's southern side. Before the Spanish conquest, stoneworkers extracted and shaped the precious mineral; jade from the valley travelled to Maya cities in the lowlands and beyond.
simp_chinese: 米纳斯山脉横贯危地马拉东部，位于莫塔瓜河谷与波洛奇克河谷之间。云雾聚集在高岭周围，滋养广阔森林；溪流则流向下方较干燥的地区。山脉南侧的莫塔瓜河沿岸蕴藏硬玉。西班牙征服之前，石匠在这里开采、加工这种珍贵矿石；河谷出产的玉石流往低地玛雅城邦及更远的地方。

english: The North Platte River crosses western Nebraska through a broad valley bordered by bluffs and grasslands. Near Minatare its waters flow eastward from the Rocky Mountains toward the junction with the South Platte. The river valley formed part of the hunting country of Plains peoples, offering a route through the drier high plains. The name Minatare recalls the Hidatsa, also known historically as the Minnetaree.
simp_chinese: 北普拉特河穿过内布拉斯加西部的宽阔河谷，两侧分布着崖地和草原。米纳塔雷附近的河水从落基山脉向东流去，前往与南普拉特河的汇合处。河谷是平原民族狩猎地区的一部分，也是穿越较干旱高平原的一条通道。米纳塔雷之名让人想起希达察人，他们在历史上也被称为米内塔里。

english: Minbya lies on the Lemro River in the lowlands of central Arakan. The river runs south through fertile plains towards the Bay of Bengal, east of the old royal centre of Mrauk U. A fortified river position in this area formed part of the approaches to the capital, supporting both defence and movement along the Lemro. The surrounding country combines rice-growing land with waterways and low wooded hills, linked to the sea by the broad river system.
simp_chinese: 敏比亚位于若开中部低地的伦苗河畔。河流在旧都妙乌以东向南穿过肥沃平原，流往孟加拉湾。这一地区的沿河防御据点构成通往都城的门户之一，既协助保护都城，也支持伦苗河上的贸易与舟船往来。周围稻田、水道和低矮林丘交错，宽阔河网将当地与海洋相连。

english: The mountains of central Mindanao rise above the plateaus and valleys of the island's interior. The Lanao–Bukidnon highlands include the Kitanglad and Kalatungan ranges, as well as the heights of Piapayungan and Butig farther west. Forests cover many of these slopes, while rivers descend from the high country toward the surrounding lowlands and coasts.
simp_chinese: 棉兰老岛中部的山地耸立在内陆高原与河谷之上。拉瑙—布基农高地包括基唐拉德山脉和卡拉通安山脉，西面还有皮亚帕永安与布蒂格的高地。森林覆盖着许多山坡，河流从高地流向四周的低地与海岸。

english:
Minden stands on the Weser just north of the Porta Westfalica, where the river emerges from the hills onto the North German Plain. Its old town occupies the western bank near a long-used crossing. A bishop's seat from around 800, it became the centre of a prince-bishopric and developed substantial fortifications in the later Middle Ages.

The Peace of Westphalia in 1648 ended the prince-bishopric and transferred its territory to Brandenburg-Prussia. Minden subsequently served as a centre of the combined lands of Minden-Ravensberg. Its position on the Weser made it valuable to successive rulers, who maintained it as a fortified town and garrison. The cathedral and the division between upper and lower town preserve the imprint of its long history as both an ecclesiastical centre and a river crossing.
simp_chinese:
明登坐落在威悉河畔，位于威斯特伐利亚门以北，河流在此穿过丘陵进入北德平原。旧城位于西岸，靠近一处长期使用的渡河地点。约800年起，明登成为主教驻地，后来发展为主教亲王领的中心，并在中世纪晚期建起坚固的防御工事。

1648年的威斯特伐利亚和约终结了主教亲王领，将其领地交给勃兰登堡-普鲁士。此后，明登成为合并的明登-拉文斯贝格领地的中心。威悉河畔的位置使它受到历代统治者重视，城镇长期设防并驻有军队。大教堂和上下城的分布，留下了它作为教会中心与渡河地点的历史痕迹。

english: Mindon lies west of the Irrawaddy in the foothills of the Arakan Mountains. The wooded range separates the river basin of central Burma from the coastal lands of Arakan on the Bay of Bengal. Streams descend from the hills towards the river plain, and villages occupy the valleys between the ridges. To the east the country opens towards Thayet and the Irrawaddy, while the higher mountains form a difficult barrier to the west.
simp_chinese: 敏东位于伊洛瓦底江以西，坐落在若开山脉的山麓。森林覆盖的山脉隔开缅甸中部河谷与孟加拉湾沿岸的若开地区。溪流从山间流向河流平原，村落分布在山岭之间的谷地。东面的土地逐渐开阔，通往德耶和伊洛瓦底江；西面更高的山地则形成难以穿越的屏障。

english: The Mindoro Strait lies between Mindoro and the Palawan island chain in the Philippines. Together with the Panay Strait it connects the South China Sea with the deep Sulu Sea basin. Islands and shallows border the passage, while currents carry water between the seas on either side of the long Palawan chain.
simp_chinese: 民都洛海峡位于菲律宾的民都洛岛与巴拉望岛链之间，与班乃海峡共同连接南海和深邃的苏禄海盆地。岛屿与浅滩分布在水道边缘，海流穿过通道，在漫长巴拉望岛链两侧的海域之间输送海水。

english:
Mindouli lies in the Niari basin, a region of hills and valleys rich in copper-bearing ores. The deposits around Mindouli and neighbouring Boko-Songho supported a long tradition of mining and metalworking. Copper from this country circulated far beyond the mines, linking its producers with communities across west-central Africa.

Between the fifteenth and seventeenth centuries, metalworkers around Mindouli smelted copper in decorated pottery vessels. Archaeologists distinguish their pottery from the vessels used around Boko-Songho, evidence of different communities working within the same copper-producing region. These practices changed over time, but the mines remained an important source of metal for the surrounding country. The traces left by furnaces, vessels and pieces of slag show how extraction and smelting were organised near the deposits.
simp_chinese:
明杜利位于尼阿里盆地，周围丘陵与河谷蕴藏着丰富的铜矿。明杜利和邻近博科松戈的矿床支撑了悠久的采矿与金属加工传统。这里出产的铜流通到远离矿区的地方，将生产者与中西部非洲各地的社群联系起来。

15至17世纪，明杜利一带的工匠用装饰陶器冶炼铜。考古学家发现，他们的陶器与博科松戈地区所用器皿不同，显示同一铜产区内存在不同的工匠社群。冶炼方式随时间改变，但这些矿床仍是周边地区的重要金属来源。炉灶、陶器与矿渣留下的痕迹，显示人们如何在矿床附近组织开采与冶炼。

english: Mindu lies in the wooded western slopes of the Andes, between the Quito highlands and the forests descending towards the Pacific. This was part of the country of the Yumbo, whose paths carried people and goods between the coast and the mountains. During the colonial era Yumbo communities retained a measure of autonomy in this difficult terrain, continuing exchange across the western slopes.
simp_chinese: 明杜位于安第斯山脉森林覆盖的西坡，介于基多高地与向太平洋下降的森林之间。这里属于永博人的土地，他们沿道路往来于海岸与山地之间，运送货物。殖民时期，永博社群在这片交通艰难的地区保持了一定自主性，继续进行跨越西坡的交换。

english: Minduso lies in the uplands of Bukidnon, in the interior of Mindanao. Local accounts remember it as a Manobo settlement associated with Datu Andarol and his family, amid country once covered in forest. Bukidnon communities took their names from the watersheds they inhabited and looked to their datus to settle disputes and uphold customary law. Their highland home lay far from the better-known ports of Mindanao's coasts.
simp_chinese: 敏杜索位于棉兰老岛内陆的布基农高地。当地记忆将它描述为与达图安达罗尔家族有关的马诺博聚落，周围曾是森林覆盖的土地。布基农各社群以所居流域为名，由达图调解争端、维护习惯法。这些高地居民的家园远离棉兰老沿岸较为人熟知的港口。

english: Mineami lies in the west-central Ohio country, where the Mad River and the Great Miami River drain rolling prairie and river woods. The Miami people, called Myaamia by themselves, lived here with Shawnee and Wyandot neighbours, growing corn on the river terraces and hunting deer and bear in the woods. Their trading town of Pickawillany stood on the Great Miami, and in 1752 a force of Ojibwe and Ottawa warriors, backed by French officers, destroyed it after its chief had welcomed British traders. The Miami later formed a confederacy against American expansion, but their defeat at Fallen Timbers in 1794 led to the Treaty of Greenville in 1795, which opened much of western Ohio to settlement.
simp_chinese: 米尼阿米位于俄亥俄州中西部，麦德河与大迈阿密河排水的起伏草原和河岸林地在此展开。迈阿密人自称穆亚米亚，与肖尼人、怀恩多人为邻，在河阶上种植玉米，在林中猎捕鹿和熊。他们的贸易城镇皮克维拉尼位于大迈阿密河畔，1752年，因首领接待英国商人，法国军官支持的奥吉布瓦与渥太华武士攻毁了这座城镇。迈阿密人此后组成联盟抵抗美国扩张，1794年的倒木之战中落败，次年签订的格林维尔条约使俄亥俄西部大片土地向定居者开放。

english: Minehead lies on the Somerset coast beneath the wooded heights of Exmoor, facing the Bristol Channel. Its harbour supported fishing and trade, and in 1543 the town had more ships and sailors available for Henry VIII's service than any port on the channel except Bristol. In 1685 local men joined the Duke of Monmouth's rebellion; after its defeat at Sedgemoor, six were brought back to Minehead and hanged.
simp_chinese: 迈恩黑德位于萨默塞特海岸，埃克斯穆尔林木覆盖的高地之下，面向布里斯托尔海峡。港口支持渔业和贸易；1543年，镇上可供亨利八世役使的船只和水手数量，在海峡各港中仅次于布里斯托尔。1685年，当地人加入蒙茅斯公爵的叛乱；塞奇穆尔战败后，六名叛乱者被押回迈恩黑德绞死。

english: Minenga lies near the southwestern edge of the Kafue Flats, where the Kafue River spreads into a broad floodplain near Namwala. In the rains, shallow water covers much of the plain; as the dry season advances, the flood recedes, leaving black clay soils around the lagoons and permanent swamps.
simp_chinese: 米嫩加靠近卡富埃平原的西南缘，卡富埃河在纳姆瓦拉附近漫入广阔的洪泛平原。雨季时浅水覆盖平原的大部分地区；随着旱季到来，洪水退去，在泻湖和常年沼泽周围留下黑色黏土。

english:
Mingan lies at the mouth of its river on the north shore of the Gulf of St. Lawrence, facing an archipelago of islands. Innu families of Ekuanitshit came here from their inland hunting grounds in summer to fish for salmon, hunt whales and meet one another. The islands were also used for seal hunting. With the arrival of Europeans, the summer gatherings became occasions for the exchange of furs.

The Mingan seigneury was granted in 1661, and Louis Jolliet built a trading post on an island in the harbour in 1679. In later years the North West Company and the Hudson's Bay Company operated posts at Mingan. The Innu continued to visit the coast seasonally, bringing pelts from the interior to trade before returning to their hunting grounds.
simp_chinese:
明根位于同名河流的河口，地处圣劳伦斯湾北岸，面向一片群岛。埃夸尼希特的因努家庭夏季从内陆猎场来到这里，捕捞鲑鱼、猎鲸并相互会面；群岛也是猎取海豹的地方。欧洲人到来后，夏季聚会又成为交换毛皮的时机。

1661年明根领地获授，1679年路易·若利埃在港内一座岛上建立贸易站。后来西北公司和哈得孙湾公司都在明根经营商站，使这里成为沿岸毛皮贸易的据点。因努人继续按季节到访海岸，从内陆带来毛皮交换，然后返回各自的猎场。

english: Along the north shore of the Gulf of St. Lawrence, the Mingan Islands form a chain of limestone islands and reefs opposite Anticosti. Wind and water have carved their rock into striking pillars, while the surrounding waters provided fish and sea mammals to the Innu and to later visitors. Basque crews came for cod and whales; in 1679 Louis Jolliet and Jacques de Lalande received the islands as a seigneury, intending to fish and trade along this coast.
simp_chinese: 圣劳伦斯湾北岸，明根群岛是一串与安蒂科斯蒂岛相望的石灰岩岛屿和礁石。风浪将岩石雕成奇特的石柱，周围水域的鱼类和海兽则供养因努人及后来的访客。巴斯克船队曾来此捕鳕和捕鲸；1679年，路易·若利埃与雅克·德·拉朗德获封群岛领地，打算沿岸捕鱼并开展贸易。

english: Minggang stands near the upper Huai River north of Xinyang. The river comes from the mountains to the west and, in the old geographical account of Xinyang, receives the Minggang River before bending east toward Luoshan. During the Ming and Qing this district belonged to Xinyang Prefecture. Nearby settlements grew along the river and the routes across the plain, in a landscape marking the approach to the hills farther south.
simp_chinese: 明港位于信阳以北、淮河上游附近。淮水从西面的山中流来，地方地理记载称，它在这里接纳明港河，随后向东转入罗山。明清时期，这一带属于信阳州；河流和平原道路附近分布着聚落，向南则渐渐进入丘陵地区。

english: Minghe was a rural district in the mountain country of Chuzhou. At the beginning of the Ming it belonged to Qingtian; in 1452 the court carved Jingning County from five districts of Minghe and neighbouring lands. Officials cited the remoteness of the valleys and the gathering of miners when proposing the new county.
simp_chinese: 鸣鹤是处州山地中的一乡。明初它隶属青田；1452年，朝廷从鸣鹤乡五都及邻近地区划地设景宁县。官员奏请设县时，提到山谷险远、矿工聚集等缘由。

english: Mingin stands on the right bank of the Chindwin River in western Burma. Here the river turns through a broad bend among wooded hills before continuing south towards the Irrawaddy. Upstream, the Myittha joins the Chindwin at Kalewa after flowing out of the Chin country. The river valley narrows in places where forested slopes descend to the water, while strips of level land along the banks provide room for settlements and cultivation.
simp_chinese: 敏金位于缅甸西部钦敦江右岸。河水在林木覆盖的丘陵间形成大弯，随后继续南流，最终汇入伊洛瓦底江。上游的敏达河从钦山地区流出，在格礼瓦注入钦敦江。河谷有些地方狭窄，林坡直达水边；岸边较平坦的地带则容纳村落与耕地。

english: Mingin country lies in the southern Gulf of Carpentaria region, among the rivers and plains inland from the coast. Seasonal waterways cross grassland and woodland toward the shallow gulf. The Mingin are one of several Aboriginal peoples whose distinct countries meet in this river and coastal landscape.
simp_chinese: 明金人的土地位于卡奔塔利亚湾南部地区，在海岸内陆的河流与平原之间。季节性水道穿过草地和林地，流向浅海湾。明金人是这一河流和海岸地区各自土地相接的几个原住民族之一。

english: Mingsha lies on the south bank of the Yellow River, where the old road passes beneath Niushou Mountain. Its name, meaning singing sands, was explained by a Tang geographer as the sound made by people and horses moving across the sand. It served at different times as the seat of a county and a Zhou. The old Yongshou Pagoda of Anqing Temple stood near the river; bricks record its rebuilding in 1570, preserving a Buddhist landmark beside the shifting waters.
simp_chinese: 鸣沙位于黄河南岸，旧路从牛首山下经过。唐代地理书解释其名时说，人马经过沙地，沙随行而发声，故称鸣沙。这里历代曾设县、置州，临河安庆寺内的永寿塔也是古老地标；塔砖记载它曾于1570年重建，屹立在不断变迁的河水旁。

english: Mingshan lies east of Yazhou beneath Meng Mountain, whose damp slopes have long been famous for tea. Tea from the mountain was sent to the imperial court as tribute from the Tang through the Qing. The gardens, temples and paths around the summits formed a landscape where cultivation and religious tradition met, while the leaves were prized for the delicate liquor they produced.
simp_chinese: 名山位于雅州以东，蒙山湿润的山坡自古以茶闻名。自唐至清，蒙山茶历代被列为贡品。山顶附近的茶园、寺院和道路交织在一起，种茶与宗教传统相伴；采下的茶叶则以冲泡出的清雅滋味受到珍视。

english: Mingshui was a county of the northern plain, named for the Ming River that flowed west of its earlier seat. Under the Yuan, the county administration moved to the town of Weizhou, and during the Zhizheng reign Mingshui was absorbed into that prefecture. Its name preserves the memory of a landscape in which rivers and their changing courses helped define local districts.
simp_chinese: 洺水是华北平原上的旧县，因早期县治以西的洺河得名。元初县治迁往威州，至正年间洺水县并入威州。这一名称保留了河流及其变化的水道对地方区划的影响。

english: Mingtong lies on the Qian River among the wooded mountains of the Daba range. Its salt wells gave the settlement its name and drew merchants into the hills. Brine was boiled here for salt over many centuries, with production particularly active under the Ming and Qing. Local legend tells of hunters who discovered a salty spring after following a spotted dove into a cave, giving one well its name, the Spotted Dove Well.
simp_chinese: 明通坐落在大巴山林木繁茂的山间，前河从旁流过。当地盐井赋予市镇以名称，也将商人吸引到山中。这里煎卤制盐的历史绵延数百年，明清时期尤其兴盛。当地传说称，猎人追随一只白斑鸠进入岩穴，发现流出的泉水味咸，于是开始煎盐，斑鸠井因此得名。

english:
Minguannan was a Lenape settlement in the White Clay Creek country, west of the Delaware River. Early colonists also recorded it as Opasiskunk. In 1683 the Lenape chief of the district sold a large tract of land in the area to William Penn; the chief is thought to have lived in the village. Minguannan remained inhabited into the early eighteenth century as colonial farms spread through the creek valley.

The later city of Dover lies nearby.
simp_chinese:
明关南是特拉华河以西白泥溪地区的一座莱纳佩人聚落，早期殖民者也把它记为奥帕西斯昆克。1683年，当地莱纳佩首领将这一带大片土地卖给威廉·佩恩；这位首领被认为曾居住在村中。随着殖民农场在溪谷扩展，明关南仍有人居住，直至十八世纪初。

后来的多佛位于此地附近。

english: Míngxī lies among the hills of western Fújiàn. An old post station stood here by the Sòng period, and the Míng established a patrol office at the settlement in 1453. In 1470 lands were taken from Qīngliú, Nínghuà, Jiānglè, and Shā County to form Guīhuà County, with its seat at Míngxī.
simp_chinese: 明溪位于福建西部山地。宋代这里已有驿站，明景泰四年（1453年）设巡检司。成化六年（1470年），朝廷从清流、宁化、将乐和沙县划地设归化县，县治设在明溪。

english: Mingyi lay along the lower Anning River, south of Dechang and north of the river's meeting with the Yalong. Mountains rise on both sides of the narrow valley, through which the Anning flows towards the Jinsha. In the Song period the surrounding country was known as Mingyi and lay within the sphere of the Dali kingdom. Its river corridor connected the uplands of Jianchang with the warmer country to the south.
simp_chinese: 明夷位于安宁河下游，在德昌以南、安宁河汇入雅砻江之处以北。狭长河谷两侧山岭高耸，安宁河沿谷南流，最终汇入金沙江水系。宋代这一带称明夷，属于大理国势力范围；河谷通道连接建昌高地与南方较温暖的地区。

english: Mingying was a native prefecture in the hill country of southwestern Guangxi. It was one of the small hereditary jurisdictions attached to Taiping prefecture, alongside Longying, Quanming and other native states. Local chiefs held the office of prefect by inheritance, forming part of a mosaic of authorities through which the Ming and Qing governed the mountainous country near the Vietnamese frontier.
simp_chinese: 茗盈是广西西南山地的土州，与龙英、全茗等地同为太平府属下的世袭辖区。土官世代担任知州，这些地方首领共同构成了明清时期越南边境附近山地的治理网络。

english: The Minichinas Hills rise in the parkland east of the South Saskatchewan River, amid a landscape of low, rolling uplands and lakes. Their name comes from a Cree word for a small pond. The hills form part of the transition between prairie and northern woodland, a region whose many hollows and waters give the open country a varied character. They lie east of the river and south of the woodland around Prince Albert.
simp_chinese: 米尼奇纳斯丘陵位于南萨斯喀彻温河以东的林草地带，低缓起伏的高地与湖泊交错分布。丘陵得名于克里语中“小池塘”一词。这里是草原与北方林地之间的过渡地带，众多洼地和水域使开阔的原野呈现多样面貌；丘陵位于河流以东、阿尔伯特亲王城附近林地以南。

english: Minicoy, called Maliku by its inhabitants, is a long coral island north of the Maldives. Its people speak a language closely related to Maldivian and have long looked to the sea for fishing and travel. The island was connected with the Maldivian sultanate before coming under the Ali Rajas of Kannur by the sixteenth century. Its position between the Maldives and the Indian coast placed it within a maritime world of shifting allegiances and trade. In 1824 the Arakkal ruler acknowledged the East India Company’s suzerainty over Maliku.
simp_chinese: 米尼科伊被居民称为马利库，是马尔代夫以北的一座狭长珊瑚岛。岛民的语言与马尔代夫语关系密切，长期依靠海洋捕鱼和航行。此岛曾与马尔代夫苏丹国相连，到十六世纪已归坎努尔的阿里拉贾统治。它位于马尔代夫与印度海岸之间，处于联盟和贸易不断变化的海洋世界。1824年，阿拉卡尔统治者承认东印度公司对马利库的宗主权。

english: Minicoy, known locally as Maliku, lies on the southernmost atoll of the Laccadive chain. The Nine Degree Channel separates it from the islands to the north, while the Maldives lie to the south. Islam reached the island around the twelfth century, and Minicoy remained culturally and politically connected to the Maldives until the sixteenth century. Later ruled by the Ali Rajas of Kannur, it came under the East India Company's suzerainty; the ruling family formally acknowledged that position in 1824.
simp_chinese: 米尼科伊当地称为马利库，坐落在拉克代夫岛链最南端的环礁上。九度海峡将它与北面的岛屿分开，南方则是马尔代夫。伊斯兰教约在十二世纪传入，米尼科伊在十六世纪以前与马尔代夫保持文化和政治联系。此岛后来由坎努尔的阿里拉贾家族统治，并处于东印度公司的宗主权之下；1824年，该家族正式承认了这一关系。

english: Minii’yohe is a recorded name for the North Platte River, which flows from the Rocky Mountains through Wyoming and western Nebraska. Its broad valley crosses dry high plains, bordered by bluffs and grasslands. The river joins the South Platte farther east, their combined waters forming the Platte. Indigenous peoples traveled through this valley and along its tributaries, using a passage between the mountains and the central Plains.
simp_chinese: 米尼约赫是北普拉特河的一个记载名称。这条河从落基山脉流经怀俄明和内布拉斯加西部，宽阔河谷穿过干燥高平原，两侧是崖地与草原。它在更东处与南普拉特河汇合，形成普拉特河。原住民族沿河谷及支流旅行，利用这条山地与中央平原之间的通道。

english:
Minisink is the name of a district in the upper Delaware valley, a homeland of the Munsee-speaking Lenape. The river winds between wooded hills and fertile flats, with islands that gave the region its name. Dutch and Huguenot settlers came from the Hudson valley in the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries, establishing farms among older Indigenous communities.

The valley became a contested frontier during the wars between Britain and France. In 1779, during the American Revolution, the Mohawk leader Joseph Brant led Indigenous warriors and Loyalists in a raid on the Minisink settlements. American militia pursued them up the Delaware, but Brant's force defeated the pursuers at Minisink Ford on 22 July. The battle left many militiamen dead and brought the wider war into the river valley.
simp_chinese:
米尼辛克是特拉华河上游谷地一片地区的名称，也是说蒙西语的莱纳佩人的故土。河流在林木丘陵与肥沃平地之间蜿蜒，河中的岛屿赋予地区以名称。十七世纪末至十八世纪初，荷兰人和胡格诺派定居者从哈得孙河谷来到此地，在更早的原住民社群之间建立农场。

英法战争期间，河谷成为双方争夺的边疆。1779年美国革命期间，莫霍克领袖约瑟夫·布兰特率原住民战士和保王派袭击米尼辛克聚落。美国民兵沿特拉华河追击，但布兰特的部队于7月22日在米尼辛克渡口击败追兵。战斗造成许多民兵死亡，也将更广泛的战争带入河谷。

english: Minisose, the Missouri River, carries the waters of the northern Plains eastward from the Rocky Mountain country. Along this stretch it receives rivers descending from the plains to the north and the Yellowstone basin to the south. Its muddy waters gave rise to the Dakota name Minisose. For generations the Missouri linked villages and hunting grounds across a vast region, long before American explorers traveled upstream in the early nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 米尼索塞即密苏里河，它将北部平原的水流从落基山地区向东输送。在这一河段，大河接纳北方平原与南方黄石河流域的支流。浑浊的河水使它获得了达科他语名称米尼索塞。早在十九世纪初美国探险者溯流而上之前，密苏里河便世代连接着广大地域中的村落与猎场。

english: The Miniss River flows through the forests of the northern interior to Miniss Bay on Lake St. Joseph. From the lake, the Albany River carries water east towards James Bay. This is a country of connected lakes, rivers and portages, where Indigenous travellers moved between seasonal fishing and hunting places. The Albany formed part of a wider network of water routes linking inland communities with the bay.
simp_chinese: 米尼斯河穿过北方内陆森林，流入圣约瑟夫湖的米尼斯湾。湖水经奥尔巴尼河向东流往詹姆斯湾。这里的湖泊、河流与搬运路线相连，原住民旅人往返于季节性渔场和猎场之间。奥尔巴尼河是更广阔水道网络的一部分，将内陆社群与海湾联系起来。

english: Ministik lies near the coast of Hudson Bay, in the low wet country east of the Shagamu River. Ministick Creek is one of the streams that cross this coastal plain to reach the bay. Tidal flats, marshes and shallow ponds fringe the shore, providing feeding and resting places for migrating shorebirds and waterfowl. Inland, the wet lowlands give way to the northern forest.
simp_chinese: 米尼斯蒂克位于哈得孙湾沿岸、沙加穆河以东的低洼湿地。米尼斯蒂克溪是穿过海岸平原注入海湾的溪流之一。潮滩、沼泽与浅水池塘沿岸分布，为迁徙的滨鸟和水禽提供觅食及休憩之处；湿润低地向内陆延伸，逐渐过渡到北方森林。

english: Minizuahe lies near the lower Swift Current Creek in southwestern Saskatchewan. The creek rises in the Cypress Hills and runs northeast through coulees and prairie valleys toward the South Saskatchewan River. Métis bison hunters called the stream Rivière au Courant, the River of the Current. Its winding valley crosses a dry part of the plains where streams cut deeply into the grass-covered land.
simp_chinese: 米尼祖阿赫位于萨斯喀彻温西南部，靠近斯威夫特卡伦特溪下游。溪流发源于赛普里斯丘陵，向东北穿过沟壑与草原河谷，流向南萨斯喀彻温河。梅蒂野牛猎人称这条溪为“急流河”。蜿蜒的河谷穿过干燥平原，溪水在草地覆盖的地面上切出深沟。

english: The waters around Croker Island lie off the Cobourg Peninsula in northern Australia. The island and its shores are connected to Iwaidja-speaking communities, whose country includes the peninsula and nearby islands. Reefs, tidal channels and sheltered bays border the Arafura Sea.
simp_chinese: 克罗克岛周围水域位于澳大利亚北部科堡半岛外。岛屿及海岸与讲伊瓦伊贾语的社群相联系，他们的土地包括半岛和邻近岛屿。礁石、潮汐水道和受庇护的海湾分布在阿拉弗拉海边缘。

english: Minkaniciciw lies near Lake Oskélanéo, in the forested headwaters of the Saint-Maurice. The Oskélanéo River flows north from the lake towards Lake Bureau. Atikamekw families travelled and hunted in this upper river country, where lakes, rapids and portages linked the watersheds of the interior.
simp_chinese: 明卡尼西西位于奥斯凯拉内奥湖附近、圣莫里斯河源区的森林中。奥斯凯拉内奥河从湖中向北流往比罗湖。阿蒂卡梅克家庭在上游地区行旅、狩猎；内陆各流域之间由湖泊、急流和陆上搬运路线相连。

english: Minna began as a Gbagyi settlement on Paida hill, in the country north of the Niger. A local explanation connects its name with Gbagyi words concerning fire and remembers a custom of putting out and spreading fire at a yearly observance. Gbagyi communities lived among the hills of this region, where village rulers and elders held authority. The settlement's hilltop position was characteristic of the older pattern of habitation in the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 明纳最初是尼日尔河北方派达山上的一处格巴吉人聚落。当地对地名的一种解释将它与格巴吉语中有关火的词联系起来，并记得每年仪式上熄火和传火的习俗。格巴吉社群生活在这一地区的丘陵间，由村庄首领与长老掌管事务。山顶聚落体现了周围地区较早的居住方式。

english:
Minnetonka, the Dakota name for “big water,” lies amid the lakes and oak savanna west of the upper Mississippi. Its many bays and islands formed a rich hunting and fishing country for the Dakota. People gathered wild rice and made maple sugar around the lake, while trails through the surrounding country connected communities and places of exchange. Dakota and Ojibwe traders travelled through the area on a route between Mille Lacs and Shakopee.

The later city of Minneapolis lies here.
simp_chinese:
明尼通卡在达科他语中意为“大水”，位于密西西比河上游以西湖泊与橡树稀树草原之间。湖中海湾和岛屿众多，是达科他人的狩猎、捕鱼之地。人们在湖畔采收野米、制作枫糖，周围道路则连接社群与交换地点。达科他和奥吉布瓦商人曾穿过这一带，往来于米尔拉克湖与沙科皮之间。

后来的明尼阿波利斯即位于此地。

english: Minnewaukan is a Dakota name meaning “spirit water” or “sacred water,” associated with the broad lake now called Devils Lake in North Dakota. The lake lies in a closed prairie basin, and its shores shift as water levels rise and fall. Its Dakota name reflects a sacred relationship with the water; the English name arose from a rendering of the word for spirit as “devil.” The surrounding wetlands and grasslands have long supported waterbirds, game and human communities.
simp_chinese: 明尼沃坎是达科他语名称，意为“灵水”或“圣水”，与北达科他的大湖魔鬼湖有关。湖泊位于封闭的草原盆地中，湖岸随水位涨落而变化。达科他语名称反映人们与湖水的神圣关系；英语湖名则源于将表示灵力的词译作“魔鬼”。周围湿地和草原长期以来养育着水鸟、猎物与人类社群。

english: Lake Minnewawa lies among the forests and wetlands of central Minnesota, near the larger waters of Big Sandy Lake. Its outlet joins the Sandy River, which carries the water onward toward the Mississippi. Wild rice grows in the shallows, particularly along parts of the eastern and northwestern shores. The lakes, marshes and connecting streams form a varied landscape within the upper Mississippi country, where forest and water meet.
simp_chinese: 明尼瓦瓦湖位于明尼苏达中部的森林与湿地之间，靠近更大的大桑迪湖。湖水从出口汇入桑迪河，继续流向密西西比河。野米生长在浅水中，尤以湖东岸与西北岸部分地段为多。湖泊、沼泽和相连溪流构成密西西比河上游的一片多样地景，森林在此与水域相接。

english: Mino lies in western Iwami around Masuda, where the Masuda family held the mountain castle of Nanao. A town grew between the castle and the family's residence below. In the fifteenth century Masuda Kanetaka invited the painter Sesshū, who is associated with gardens at local temples as well as portraits of his patron. These works reflect the cultural life that flourished under the regional lords of Iwami.
simp_chinese: 美浓位于石见西部益田一带，并非同名的美浓国。益田氏在此占据七尾山城，城池与山下居馆之间逐渐形成城镇。十五世纪，益田兼尧邀请画僧雪舟来访；当地寺院庭园以及为兼尧所作的肖像都与雪舟有关，展现石见地方领主庇护下的文化生活。

sources.title: 2770 1 暁音寺発掘調査概要報告書.pdf

english: Minochi lies in the valleys of northern Shinano, home to the temple of Zenkōji. Its revered image of Amida Buddha drew worshippers from far beyond the surrounding mountains, and a town grew up along the approach to the temple. After a fire destroyed the main hall in 1700, donations were collected throughout Japan for its rebuilding. The hall completed in 1707 gave the pilgrims a new setting for a devotion that crossed the boundaries of Buddhist sects.
simp_chinese: 水内位于信浓北部的河谷，是善光寺所在地。寺中供奉的阿弥陀佛像吸引远越群山而来的信众，通往寺院的参道旁也逐渐形成町镇。1700年大火烧毁正殿后，寺院在日本各地募集重建资金；1707年落成的新殿，为超越佛教宗派界限的信仰提供了新的场所。

english: Kamo lies in central Mino beside the Kiso River, where the Nakasendō reached the post town of Ōta. Just east of the town, travellers faced the Ōta ferry, celebrated as one of the highway's most difficult crossings. The river's swift current and high water could leave people waiting on its banks. Inns and boatmen served the travellers passing between the eastern provinces and Kyoto through this important crossing.
simp_chinese: 加茂位于美浓中部木曾川畔，中山道在此经过太田宿。镇东的太田渡口以道路上的险阻著称，水流湍急，涨水时旅人只能滞留岸边。旅店与船户为往返东国和京都的人们服务，使这里成为重要的渡河地点。

english:
Minong, the Good Place, is the Ojibwe name for the long island in Lake Superior later called Isle Royale. Forested ridges rise above a deeply indented shore, and the island forms part of the traditional country of the North Shore Ojibwe. Long before European arrival, people dug pits along Minong Ridge to extract native copper, using stone hammers to free the metal and fashioning it into tools and ornaments.

In 1669–70 the Jesuit Claude Dablon recorded accounts of an island called Menong, famous for its copper. Ojibwe people continued to travel to the island for its resources. At Indian Point near McCargoe Cove, the remains of an eighteenth-century camp include glass beads, gunflints and iron alongside older forms of material, evidence of life on the island during the era of the fur trade.
simp_chinese:
米农意为“美好的地方”，是苏必利尔湖中这座狭长岛屿的奥吉布瓦语名称；后来欧洲人称之为罗亚尔岛。森林覆盖的山脊高出曲折海岸，岛屿属于北岸奥吉布瓦人的传统土地。欧洲人到来很久以前，人们就在米农山脊挖坑开采天然铜，用石锤将金属从岩石中敲出，再制成工具和饰物。

1669至1670年间，耶稣会士克洛德·达布隆记下了一座以铜闻名、名叫梅农的岛屿。奥吉布瓦人继续来到岛上获取资源。麦卡戈湾附近印第安角的一处十八世纪营地遗存中，玻璃珠、枪燧石和铁器与较早形式的器物并存，见证了毛皮贸易时代岛上的生活。

english: Mǐnqīng lies inland from Fúzhōu in eastern Fújiàn. During the late Táng, the governor Wáng Hóng separated land from Hòuguān to establish Méixī here. The district later became Mǐnqīng County, with its settlement known as Méichéng. Its history reaches back further still, when the area belonged to the territory administered from the ancient seat of Yě.
simp_chinese: 闽清位于福州以西的福建内陆。唐贞元年间，福建观察使王翃从侯官划地设置梅溪场，后来发展为闽清县，县城亦称梅城。这里的历史更可追溯至古代冶县管辖福建的时期。

english: Minsin is a settlement in the upper Chindwin country, where the river winds between the forested ranges of northwestern Burma. Its waters join those of the Irrawaddy far downstream. The river valley offers a route through a landscape otherwise broken by hills and streams, while the forests along its course shelter a remarkable variety of birds and other wildlife.
simp_chinese: 敏辛位于钦敦江上游地区，江水在缅甸西北部覆有森林的山岭之间蜿蜒，向南流去，在远方汇入伊洛瓦底江。河谷为群山和溪流切割的土地提供了一条通道，沿江森林则庇护着种类繁多的鸟类和其他野生动物。

english:
Minsk stands on the Svislach, where the Nyamiha once joined it, amid the lands between the Dvina and the Dnieper. It is first mentioned in 1067, when a battle was fought on the Nyamiha, and it became the centre of a principality formed from the lands of Polotsk. The Mongols did not reach it, and it later joined the Grand Duchy of Lithuania peacefully, its local elite keeping high rank. In 1441 Casimir IV listed Minsk among the towns with privileges, and in 1499 Alexander Jagiellon granted it Magdeburg law.

A fire in 1547 led to a partial redesign of the streets, and the market moved from in front of the castle to the present Freedom Square, a few hundred metres south. After the Union of Lublin in 1569, Minsk district had two seats in the Sejm. In 1591 the city received its arms, showing the Virgin carried up to heaven by angels. Minsk was an Orthodox centre, but after the Union of Brest Catholic and Uniate institutions grew. The war with Muscovy in 1654–67 left it with only about 2,000 people and 300 houses. Russia annexed Minsk in 1793 as the capital of a new governorate, and in 1812 Marshal Davout's corps occupied it as a supply base.
simp_chinese:
明斯克位于斯维斯拉奇河畔，涅米加河曾在此汇入，处在德维纳河与第聂伯河之间的土地上。它最早见于1067年的记载，当时涅米加河上发生了一场战斗，它后来成为由波洛茨克土地分出的一个公国的中心。蒙古人没有到达这里，它后来和平地并入立陶宛大公国，当地贵族保有较高的地位。1441年卡齐米日四世把明斯克列入享有特权的城镇，1499年亚历山大·雅盖隆授予其马格德堡法权。

1547年的一场大火使街道有所重新规划，集市从城堡前迁到几百米以南的今自由广场一带。1569年卢布林合并之后，明斯克地区在议会中拥有两个席位。1591年城市获得市徽，图案是被天使托向天空的圣母。明斯克是东正教的中心，但布列斯特合并之后，天主教和乌尼亚特教会的机构日益增多。1654至1667年同莫斯科国的战争使它只剩下大约两千名居民和三百座房屋。1793年俄国吞并明斯克，使它成为新设一省的首府；1812年达武元帅的军团占领此城，把它作为补给基地。

english: Menhti lies in the western part of the Tanana Athabascan homeland in interior Alaska. Along a great bend of the Tanana River, the Minto Flats spread into a broad expanse of wetlands, lakes and streams. The Minto people used this country before sustained outside contact, moving between seasonal places for fishing and hunting. Their camps along the waterways formed part of a landscape extending beyond any single village.
simp_chinese: 明托位于阿拉斯加内陆塔纳纳阿萨巴斯卡人传统家园的西部。塔纳纳河在此形成一个大弯，明托平原的湿地、湖泊和溪流随之向外铺展。持续的外来接触发生之前，明托人便已利用这片土地，在季节性的渔猎地点之间迁移。沿水道分布的营地共同构成一片广阔的生活地区，并不限于单个村落。

english: Minto Reef is a mostly submerged atoll reef in the eastern Carolines. Its broad coral rim encloses a lagoon, with shallow passages through the reef rather than a deep entrance. It lies in the wider oceanic setting of Oroluk and Pohnpei, islands known to Micronesian navigators before European vessels crossed these waters.
simp_chinese: 明托礁是东加罗林群岛一处大部分沉在水下的环礁。宽阔的珊瑚礁缘围住潟湖，礁盘上有浅水通道，却没有深水入口。它处于奥罗鲁克和波纳佩所属的海域；欧洲船只穿越这些水域之前，密克罗尼西亚航行者已熟悉这些岛屿。

english: Minto Reef lies among the low coral formations west of Pohnpei in the Caroline Islands. The reef and nearby Oroluk atoll sit in open Pacific water, far from the high islands. Island communities navigated this region before European vessels began charting its scattered reefs.
simp_chinese: 明托礁位于加罗林群岛波纳佩以西的低矮珊瑚地貌之间。礁体和附近奥罗卢克环礁坐落在开阔太平洋中，远离高岛。欧洲船只开始绘制零散礁体海图之前，岛屿社群已在这一地区航行。

english: Minudasht lies where the eastern Gorgan plain meets the forested foothills of the Alborz. The surrounding country was historically known as Kabudjama, a frontier district between Astarabad and the lands farther east. During the Mongol period its local ruler Nosrat al-Din was appointed governor of the wider province. In Safavid times groups of Qizilbash known as Hajilar settled in the area, giving their name to its principal settlement.
simp_chinese: 米努达什特位于戈尔甘平原东部与厄尔布尔士山脉森林丘陵的交接处。周围地区历史上称为卡布德贾马，是阿斯塔拉巴德与更东部土地之间的边境地带。蒙古统治时期，当地领主努斯拉特丁曾被任命为整个行省的总督。萨法维时代，被称为哈吉拉尔的奇兹尔巴什人迁居此地，并将部族名称赋予主要聚落。

english: Minungo is a name associated with communities of the Lunda-Chokwe cultural world in northeastern Angola. Their country lies among the rivers and uplands west of the Kasai. From the seventeenth century, Lunda rulers built a network of political relationships extending across much of the upper Kasai basin. By the end of that century, Lunda outposts in eastern Angola were involved in the regional copper trade, linking communities of the interior to wider exchange networks.
simp_chinese: 米农戈是安哥拉东北部隆达－乔奎文化圈中一些社区的名称。他们的土地位于卡赛河以西的河流与高地之间。自十七世纪起，隆达统治者建立起横跨卡赛河上游流域广大地区的政治关系网络。到该世纪末，隆达在安哥拉东部的据点已参与区域铜贸易，使内陆社区与更广泛的交换网络相连。

english:
Minusinsk stands where the Minusa enters a navigable branch of the Yenisei, in a basin of steppe and forest-steppe north of the Sayan Mountains. Fertile land, pasture and routes along the river helped the settlement become a centre for the surrounding southern Siberian country. Its position also placed it near roads leading to the mines and ironworks of the region.

The village of Minusinskaya was established around 1739, as Russian settlement expanded into the basin and industrial works were being built nearby. Peasants and other workers came to the district to work on those enterprises. The village became Minusinskoye in 1780, and in 1822 it received town status and became the centre of a district in the newly formed Yenisei province. River transport and roads through the basin supported its growing role among the settlements of the upper Yenisei.
simp_chinese:
米努辛斯克坐落在米努萨河注入叶尼塞河可航行支流之处，位于萨彦山以北草原和森林草原交错的盆地。肥沃土地、牧场和沿河道路帮助聚落成为西伯利亚南部周边地区的中心；附近道路也通往当地矿山和铁厂。

约1739年，随着俄国聚落向盆地扩展、附近工业设施兴建，米努辛斯卡亚村庄建立。农民及其他劳工来到当地为这些企业工作。1780年村庄称作米努辛斯科耶；1822年它获得城市地位，成为新设叶尼塞省的一个区中心。河运和盆地内道路支持了它在叶尼塞河上游聚落中日益增长的作用。

english:
Mǐn County, named in 592 when Yuánfēng County was renamed, was one of the two counties that divided the walled capital of Fúzhōu on the lower Mǐn River. Under the Yuán the city was a route seat, and visitors such as Marco Polo, who called it Fugiu, and Odoric of Pordenone, who remembered its enormous chickens, passed through. Chén Yǒudìng, a Fúqīng man risen from soldier to governor of Fújiàn, held the province for the Yuán until the armies of Zhū Yuánzhāng defeated him in 1368 and sent him to Nánjīng, where he was executed.

The Míng made Fúzhōu a provincial capital and rebuilt its walls in 1371. In 1392 thirty-six Fújiàn families began to settle in the Ryukyu Kingdom, and Zhèng Hé's fleets gathered at Tàipíng harbor near Chánglè before crossing to the Indian Ocean. The maritime trade office moved to Fúzhōu in 1474, and the Róuyuǎn Post Station housed Ryukyuan envoys and merchants. Japanese pirates struck the prefecture hard under the Jiājìng emperor until Qī Jìguāng campaigned in Fújiàn. In the Qīng, Gěng Jīngzhōng's revolt of 1674–1676 and the coastal evacuation that lasted until 1684 disrupted the city before its Ryukyu and Japan trade recovered.
simp_chinese:
闽县得名于隋开皇十二年（592年）原丰县改名，与侯官县分辖福建省会福州城，地处闽江下游。元代福州为路治，马可·波罗称它为Fugiu，鄂多立克也到过这里，记下当地特大的鸡。福清人陈友定由兵卒升至福建行省平章政事，替元朝控制全省，1368年败于朱元璋，被押往南京处决。

明代福州是福建首府，城墙于洪武四年（1371年）重筑。洪武二十五年（1392年）闽人三十六姓迁居琉球，郑和船队则以长乐太平港为基地，由此出发前往西洋。成化十年（1474年），福建市舶司迁到福州，柔远驿专门接待琉球使者与商人。嘉靖年间倭患严重，戚继光入闽平倭。清代，耿精忠于1674—1676年在福州起兵，随后的迁界禁海政策一直持续到1684年，之后福州与琉球、日本的贸易才逐渐恢复。

english: Minya stands on the western bank of the Nile in Middle Egypt, surrounded by the cultivated valley and facing the desert cliffs across the river. In the early Islamic period it became known as Minyat Ibn Khasib, after a governor associated with its growth. The medieval traveller Ibn Battuta praised the town when he journeyed through Upper Egypt. Its riverfront linked the city to the settlements and fields that lined the Nile.
