Inland, seasonal streams and the Pangani connect the coast with the foothills of the Usambara Mountains, while the sea forms part of the maritime world of the Swahili towns.
simp_chinese: 姆夸贾位于东非海岸、潘加尼河以南，印度洋在这里与草地和海岸林地相接。海岸隔着狭窄水道面向桑给巴尔群岛。内陆的季节性溪流与潘加尼河把海岸连接到乌桑巴拉山麓；海上则是斯瓦希里城镇共同的航海世界。

english:
Mladá Boleslav stands above the Jizera in central Bohemia, on the site of a stronghold founded by Duke Boleslaus II. A settlement grew below it on the road from Prague toward Lusatia, and in 1334 the market was moved beside the castle and raised to the rank of a town. During the Hussite Wars its inhabitants supported the Taborites.

In the late fifteenth century the Unity of the Brethren settled in a deserted monastery, beginning a period of prosperity. The town became a centre of the Brethren, with a bishop, a Renaissance church and a printing house. In 1518 Mikuláš Klaudyán printed the first map of Bohemia here. The town also had a Jewish community, recorded from 1471; Emperor Rudolf II raised Mladá Boleslav to the status of a royal city in 1600.
simp_chinese:
姆拉达博莱斯拉夫位于波希米亚中部伊泽拉河上方，其旧址曾是博莱斯拉夫二世公爵建立的堡寨。堡下聚落处于从布拉格通往卢萨蒂亚的道路上，逐渐发展起来。1334年，集市迁至城堡前，并升格为城镇。胡斯战争期间，当地居民支持塔博尔派。

十五世纪末，兄弟会在一座废弃修道院定居，城镇由此迎来繁荣时期。这里成为兄弟会的重要中心，设有主教驻地、文艺复兴式教堂和印刷所。1518年，米库拉什·克劳迪扬在此印出第一幅波希米亚地图。当地还有犹太社群，自1471年起见于记载；1600年，皇帝鲁道夫二世将姆拉达博莱斯拉夫升为王室城市。

english: Mlungo lies near Kundabwika Falls on the Kalungwishi River. Rising on the Kasama–Mporokoso plateau, the Kalungwishi passes a series of waterfalls before reaching Lake Mweru. Rock paintings near Kundabwika bear witness to earlier inhabitants of the river country. The Kalungwishi is one of Mweru's largest tributaries after the Luapula.
simp_chinese: 姆伦戈靠近卡伦圭希河上的昆达布维卡瀑布。卡伦圭希河发源于卡萨马—姆波罗科索高原，穿过一系列瀑布后流入姆韦鲁湖；除卢阿普拉河外，它是该湖最大的支流之一。昆达布维卡附近还有岩画，留下了久远居民在这片河流地带活动的痕迹。

english: Mnihaha lies near Lake Poinsett and the upper Big Sioux River in eastern Dakota country. The area between the lake and the Oakwood Lakes was used as a summer hunting ground by Sioux communities. Lake Poinsett drains toward the Big Sioux, whose wooded course runs south across the prairie. The lakes and river occupy low ground left by the glaciers that shaped this part of the plains.
simp_chinese: 姆尼哈哈位于达科他东部，靠近波因塞特湖与大苏河北段。波因塞特湖与奥克伍德湖群之间曾是苏族社群的夏季猎场。湖水通向大苏河，河道林木繁茂，向南穿过草原。湖泊与河流位于平原上的低地中，这片地形由冰川塑造。

english: Mnisaton lies near the Boyne River on the southern Manitoba plain. The river flows east from the Pembina Hills across the Red River lowlands, passing the site later called Carman. Early French-speaking travellers knew it as the Rivière aux Îlets-de-Bois, and Alexander Henry mentioned it in his journals around 1800. Its waters enter the Morris River before reaching the Red River.
simp_chinese: 姆尼萨顿位于马尼托巴南部平原，靠近博因河。河水从彭比纳丘陵向东流过红河低地，经过后来称为卡曼的地方。早期法语旅行者称它为“林岛河”，亚历山大·亨利在1800年前后的日记中曾提及此河。博因河水汇入莫里斯河，随后流向红河。

english: Mnitaknka lies in the grasslands near the Little White River of southern Dakota country. Rising farther west, the river turns northeast through Todd country and joins the White River. Its valley cuts through deposits of sandstone, siltstone and clay, and tributary creeks gather water from the surrounding plains. The Little White is the largest tributary of the White River, which continues east toward the Missouri.
simp_chinese: 姆尼坦卡位于达科他南部草原，靠近小白河。河流发源于更西方，转向东北流过托德地区后汇入白河。河谷切穿砂岩、粉砂岩和黏土沉积，支流溪涧汇集周围平原的水。小白河是白河最大的支流，后者继续东流，通向密苏里河。

english:
Mo o ti is remembered as an Otomi name associated with the country around Guanajuato. The settlement that grew in its steep ravines became one of the great silver centres of New Spain. Its mines drew workers and merchants into a difficult mountain landscape, where buildings rose along narrow, winding streets.

Silver discoveries in the mid-sixteenth century led to the development of mines including Rayas and Mellado and the great Veta Madre. Santiago de Marfil was founded in 1556 as one of the outposts protecting the mining settlement. Mining brought wealth but also depended on arduous underground labour. By the eighteenth century the Valenciana mine was among the most important workings in the district, and its owner received the title of Count of Valenciana in 1780.

The later city of Guanajuato lies here.
simp_chinese:
莫奥蒂是与瓜纳华托一带有关的奥托米语旧名。后来在陡峭峡谷中发展的聚落成为新西班牙最重要的银矿中心之一。矿山吸引工人和商人进入崎岖的山区，建筑沿狭窄蜿蜒的街道而起。

十六世纪中叶发现的银矿促成了拉亚斯、梅亚多等矿山及巨大主矿脉的开发。1556年建立的圣地亚哥·德·马尔菲尔是保护矿区的前哨之一。采矿带来财富，也依赖艰苦的地下劳动。十八世纪，瓦伦西亚纳矿成为该地区最重要的矿场之一，其所有者于1780年获授瓦伦西亚纳伯爵称号。

后来的瓜纳华托即位于此地。

english: Mo’ohta’vo’ohnaaeva is a Cheyenne name for the Black Hills, a forested mountain region rising from the northern Plains. Its name refers to black rock. The northern and western hills formed part of the country of Cheyenne bands whose movements also extended toward the Powder River and Tongue River valleys. Dark wooded slopes and high ridges distinguish the hills from the surrounding grasslands.
simp_chinese: 莫奥塔沃霍纳埃瓦是夏延人对黑山的称呼，意为“黑岩之地”。这片森林覆盖的山地耸立于北部平原之上，深色山坡与高耸山脊在周围草地中格外醒目。黑山北部与西部是夏延诸支群活动地域的一部分，他们的行程也延伸至保德河和通河流域。

english: The Moadokado were Northern Paiute people associated with Summit Lake and the surrounding desert of the northern Great Basin. The lake, set among dry valleys and mountains, provided fish in a country where open water was scarce. People also gathered wild plants and hunted animals in the uplands. The name Moadokado has been translated as wild onion eaters, while another name for the community refers to eating fish from the lake.
simp_chinese: 莫阿多卡多是与萨米特湖及其周围大盆地北部沙漠有关的北派尤特人。湖泊位于干燥谷地与群山之间，在地表水稀少的地区提供鱼类；人们也在高地采集野生植物和狩猎。莫阿多卡多一名被译为“食野葱者”，这个社群的另一个名称则指食用湖中鱼类。

english: Moala is a volcanic island in eastern Fiji, west of the main chain of the Lau Islands. Its high ground rises behind the shores of the Koro Sea, and together with Matuku and Totoya it forms the Moala group. William Bligh saw the island during his open-boat voyage through Fiji in 1789, after the mutiny on the Bounty, and encountered it again on his later voyage.
simp_chinese: 莫阿拉是斐济东部的一座火山岛，位于劳群岛主链以西。高地在科罗海海岸后方升起；它与马图库、托托亚组成莫阿拉群岛。1789年，“邦蒂”号发生叛变后，威廉·布莱在小艇穿越斐济时望见此岛，后来的航行中又再次遇见。

english: Moala rises above the reefs and coastal waters of the western Lau group. The island is volcanic rather than a low atoll, with cultivated land and villages on its slopes and shores. Across the surrounding passages lie Totoya and Matuku, the other principal islands of the Moala group, while Lakeba and the main chain of Lau stand farther east.
simp_chinese: 莫阿拉从西劳群岛的礁区与沿岸海域中升起。这座岛是火山岛，而非低矮环礁，山坡与海岸分布着耕地和村落。隔着周边水道是莫阿拉群岛的另外两座主要岛屿托托亚和马图库，莱凯巴与劳群岛主链则位于更远的东方。

english: East of Kasongo, the Lwama and its tributaries drain a country of forest and savanna towards the Lualaba. The Lwama reaches the great river south of Kasongo, while other streams, including the Musukuyi and Lulindi, cross the same broad region. The Lualaba itself flows northwards through this part of the Congo basin, carrying the waters of the eastern highlands into the vast river system of central Africa.
simp_chinese: 卡松戈以东，卢瓦马河及其支流流经森林和稀树草原，汇入卢阿拉巴河。卢瓦马河在卡松戈以南注入大河，穆苏库伊河和卢林迪河等溪流也穿过这一带。卢阿拉巴河向北流过刚果盆地，将东部高地的水送入中非广阔的河网。

english: Moana Mpafu lies in the country of the Lubilash, between the river valleys of the Kasai basin and the Lomami to the east. The Lubilash runs northward and joins the Lubi to form the Sankuru, which in turn reaches the Kasai. Sandstone and older clay beds underlie parts of this landscape, crossed by numerous streams on their way towards the larger rivers.
simp_chinese: 莫阿纳姆帕富位于卢比拉什河流域，处在开赛河水系的河谷与东面的洛马米河之间。卢比拉什河向北流，与卢比河汇合成桑库鲁河，后者又流入开赛河。这片土地的部分地区以砂岩和较古老的黏土层为基底，众多溪流穿行其间，流向较大的河道。

english: Moana Muafi lies near Kaniama in the upper Lomami country. The rivers around Kaniama include the Lomami, with the Seya and Dilenge falls, and the Lwembe, with the Kai falls. The wider country is home to the Bene Mutombo Mukulu, whose royal office passes among the Bene Ngandu, Basonge and Bene Kabeya clans.
simp_chinese: 莫阿纳穆阿菲靠近卡尼亚马，位于洛马米河上游地区。卡尼亚马周围的河流包括洛马米河及其塞亚、迪伦盖瀑布，还有拥有卡伊瀑布的卢文贝河。这片广大地区是贝内·穆通博·穆库卢人的家园，其王位由贝内·恩甘杜、巴松盖和贝内·卡贝亚诸氏族轮流继承。

english: Moana Mussumba lies near the lower Lukuga, where the river approaches the Lualaba after leaving Lake Tanganyika. The valleys of the lower Lukuga and Lualaba were routes through the country of the Hemba. Around 1800, during the reign of Ilunga Sungu, Luba forces crossed the Lualaba and raided eastward as far as the Tanganyika shore.
simp_chinese: 莫阿纳穆松巴靠近卢库加河下游；这条河从坦噶尼喀湖流出，在此附近接近卢阿拉巴河。卢库加河下游和卢阿拉巴河的河谷是通往亨巴人地区的交通路线。约1800年，伊隆加·松古在位期间，卢巴军队越过卢阿拉巴河，向东袭击，远达坦噶尼喀湖岸。

english: The Moanunts were a Ute people of central Utah, associated with the upper Sevier and Sanpete country. Their homeland lay among valleys and plateaus where families hunted and gathered according to the seasons. Other Ute groups lived around Utah Lake and the Sevier River, while Southern Paiute communities were neighbours farther south. In the eastern Great Basin, spring fishing and gatherings brought people together before families dispersed in summer to harvest plants and hunt.
simp_chinese: 莫安恩茨人是犹他中部的尤特人，与塞维尔河上游和圣皮特地区有关。他们的家园位于谷地与高原之间，家庭随季节狩猎、采集。其他尤特群体居住在犹他湖和塞维尔河一带，更南方则有南派尤特邻人。在大盆地东部，春季捕鱼和聚会使人们汇聚，夏季家庭再分散前往各处采集植物和狩猎。

english: The Moapa Valley follows the Muddy River through the desert of the lower Colorado basin. Springs feed the river, creating a green corridor amid the arid hills. Southern Paiute communities used the valley's water to grow maize, beans and squash, while also hunting and gathering in the surrounding country. In the early nineteenth century the Old Spanish Trail brought traders through the wider region, adding new contacts and dangers to a homeland long occupied by the Moapa people.
simp_chinese: 莫阿帕谷地沿马迪河分布，位于科罗拉多河下游流域的沙漠中。泉水汇入河流，在干旱丘陵间形成一条绿色走廊。南派尤特社群利用谷地的水种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，也在周围地区狩猎、采集。十九世纪初，旧西班牙小径使商人经过这一广大地区，给莫阿帕人长期居住的家园带来新的接触和危险。

sources.title: Moapa Band of Paiutes Hazard Mitigation Plan 04-15-2015 Final.pdf

english: Mobaye lies on the Ubangi near a stretch of rapids, in a river country inhabited by fishing and trading communities. Markets along the upper Ubangi brought people from both banks together to exchange food, fish, iron, and other goods. The Sango language began as a speech of river people around Mobaye and became a means of communication in trade along the river.
simp_chinese: 莫巴耶位于乌班吉河一段急流附近，河流地区居住着捕鱼和贸易社群。上乌班吉河沿岸的市场汇集两岸居民，交换食物、鱼、铁和其他货物。桑戈语起初是莫巴耶一带河岸居民的语言，后来成为沿河贸易中交流的工具。

english:
Mobile stands at the head of a broad bay on the northern Gulf of Mexico, where the Mobile River carries the waters of the Alabama and Tombigbee toward the sea. The bay and river gave a port here access to the interior as well as to the Gulf. Indigenous communities inhabited the surrounding country long before French colonists established their foothold on the river.

In 1702 the French founded Fort Louis and a town upriver, making Mobile the capital of Louisiana. Flooding and other difficulties prompted the settlers to move downriver to the head of the bay in 1711. Fort Condé guarded the new town; after France ceded the colony to Britain in 1763, the fort was renamed Charlotte. In 1780 the Spanish governor Bernardo de Gálvez besieged it and forced its British garrison to surrender. Spain held Mobile until American forces took possession in 1813. During the following decades, its port grew with the expansion of cotton agriculture and enslaved labour in the interior.
simp_chinese:
莫比尔位于墨西哥湾北岸一片宽阔海湾的顶端，莫比尔河在此将阿拉巴马河与汤比格比河的水送向大海。港口既可通往海湾，也能沿河深入内陆。早在法国殖民者于河畔立足以前，原住民社群便已生活在周围地区。

1702年，法国人在上游建立路易堡和城镇，以莫比尔为路易斯安那的首府。洪水与其他困难促使居民于1711年迁往下游的海湾顶端。孔代堡守卫着新城；1763年法国将殖民地割让给英国后，堡垒改名夏洛特。1780年，西班牙总督贝尔纳多·德·加尔韦斯围攻堡垒，迫使英军守备部队投降。西班牙一直占有莫比尔，直到1813年美军接管。此后数十年，随着内陆棉花种植和奴役劳动的扩张，港口也逐渐成长。

english:
Mobile Bay is a broad, shallow inlet on the northern Gulf of Mexico. The Mobile and Tensaw rivers flow into its upper end through a maze of wetlands and channels, while barrier islands guard the entrance from the sea. Its waters connect the interior river system with the Gulf coast.

In 1702 French colonists established Fort Louis on the Mobile River upstream of the bay, making it an early capital of Louisiana. Dauphin Island near the bay’s entrance served ships that could not easily navigate the shallow water farther inland. After floods affected the first settlement, the French moved Mobile to the head of the bay in 1711. The bay remained a meeting place for Indigenous peoples, colonists and ships from across the Gulf.
simp_chinese:
莫比尔湾是墨西哥湾北岸宽阔而水浅的海湾。莫比尔河与滕索河穿过迷宫般的湿地和水道，流入海湾北端；沙障岛则守护着通向外海的入口。海湾将内陆河网与墨西哥湾海岸连接起来。

1702年，法国殖民者在海湾上游的莫比尔河畔建立路易堡，将其作为路易斯安那早期首府。海湾入口附近的多芬岛为难以驶入更浅内陆水域的船只提供港口。洪水影响最初聚落后，法国人于1711年将莫比尔迁至湾顶。海湾一直是原住民、殖民者及来自墨西哥湾各地船只的相遇之处。

english:
Moca lies in the fertile Cibao region of northern Hispaniola, among rivers and farmland south of the northern mountain range. At the time of Spanish conquest the area belonged to the Indigenous chiefdom of Maguá. The name appears in colonial records by 1737, when farms at Moca and neighboring places were mentioned in connection with provisions for new settlers at Puerto Plata on the northern coast.

The later city of San Francisco de Macorís lies here.
simp_chinese:
莫卡位于伊斯帕尼奥拉北部肥沃的锡瓦奥地区，北方山脉以南分布着河流与农田。西班牙征服时，这片土地属于原住民的马瓜酋邦。到1737年，殖民记录已提及莫卡及邻近地点的农庄，涉及为北岸普拉塔港新移民提供粮食的事务。

后来的圣弗朗西斯科-德马科里斯即位于此地。

english:
The Mocama were Timucua-speaking peoples of the Atlantic coast, from southeastern Georgia to northeastern Florida. Their villages occupied islands, river mouths and the neighbouring mainland. At the time of European contact, the principal chiefdoms included the Saturiwa near the St Johns River and the Tacatacuru on Cumberland Island.

French explorers met the coastal peoples in the 1560s. After Spain established itself at St Augustine, Franciscan missionaries founded San Pedro de Mocama on Cumberland Island in 1587, making it a centre for missions serving nearby communities. Disease, warfare and raids from the north reduced the mission towns during the seventeenth century. Survivors moved south toward St Augustine, and in 1763 some descendants of Mocama and Guale people left Florida for Cuba with the departing Spanish.
simp_chinese:
莫卡马人是大西洋沿岸讲蒂穆夸语的族群，分布于佐治亚东南部至佛罗里达东北部。他们的村落坐落在岛屿、河口及邻近大陆上。欧洲人到来时，主要酋邦包括圣约翰斯河附近的萨图里瓦和坎伯兰岛上的塔卡塔库鲁。

法国探险者于十六世纪六十年代与沿海居民相遇。西班牙人在圣奥古斯丁立足后，方济各会传教士于1587年在坎伯兰岛建立圣佩德罗·德莫卡马传教站，作为服务邻近社群的传教中心。十七世纪，疾病、战争和来自北方的袭击使传教村镇人口减少。幸存者向南迁往圣奥古斯丁附近；1763年，一些莫卡马和瓜莱人的后裔随撤离的西班牙人离开佛罗里达，前往古巴。

english: Along the southwestern coast of Africa, the Namib Desert stretches between the Atlantic and the rising inland escarpment. Its northern reaches are known as the Moçâmedes Desert. Gravel plains, dunes and dry riverbeds lie under a climate of scant rain, while fog from the cold Atlantic brings moisture to the coast. Among the desert's remarkable plants is the welwitschia, whose two long leaves continue to grow throughout its long life.
simp_chinese: 非洲西南海岸的纳米布沙漠绵延于大西洋与不断升高的内陆陡崖之间，北段被称为莫卡梅德斯沙漠。砾石平原、沙丘和干河床所在的地区降雨稀少，寒冷大西洋上的雾却为海岸带来水分。沙漠中有一种奇特植物百岁兰，它的两片长叶在漫长的一生中持续生长。

english: The Mokaná inhabited the Caribbean lowlands between the Magdalena River and the coast. Their territory included the country around Juan de Acosta, west of the river mouth, and other settlements across the coastal plain. Streams, dry hills and the sea gave this region a character distinct from the great wetlands farther inland. The Mokaná remained part of the history of the coast as Spanish settlement and colonial rule transformed the region.
simp_chinese: 莫卡纳人居住在马格达莱纳河与加勒比海岸之间的低地，领地包括河口以西的胡安德阿科斯塔一带及海岸平原上的其他聚落。溪流、干燥丘陵和海洋使这里不同于更内陆的广大湿地。西班牙聚居和殖民统治改变地区的过程中，莫卡纳人仍是海岸历史的一部分。

english: Moce is an island of Fiji's southern Lau group, surrounded by Pacific waters. Its people are known for navigation and voyaging among the islands of Lau and beyond. These sea routes form part of a long history of connections across eastern Fiji, where island communities maintained relationships through movement by canoe.
simp_chinese: 莫塞是斐济南劳群岛中的一座岛，四周为太平洋环绕。当地人以航海和往来劳群岛内外而闻名。这些海路属于斐济东部长久交往历史的一部分，岛屿社群通过独木舟航行维持彼此关系。

english: Moce is an island in Fiji’s Lau group, with reef-fringed shores facing the Pacific. In 1792 William Bligh met islanders near Moce who exchanged coconuts for axes and nails. Their recognition of Tongatapu pointed to connections between Fiji and Tonga across these waters.
simp_chinese: 莫塞是斐济劳群岛的一座岛屿，有珊瑚礁环绕的海岸面向太平洋。1792年，威廉·布莱在莫塞附近遇见岛民，他们用椰子交换斧头和钉子。他们认得汤加塔布，显示斐济与汤加之间跨海的联系。

english: Moch is a low island in the Mortlock group southeast of Chuuk, surrounded by coral reef and Pacific waters. Its inhabitants belonged to a wider Caroline Islands world of canoe travel and exchange. Chuuk’s lagoon islands to the northwest were charted by Louis Duperrey’s expedition in 1824.
simp_chinese: 莫奇是楚克东南方莫特洛克群岛的一座低岛，四周有珊瑚礁和太平洋水域。居民属于加罗林群岛更广阔的独木舟航行和交换世界。1824年，路易·迪佩雷的船队绘制了西北方楚克潟湖岛屿的海图。

english:
Mocoa lies where the eastern slopes of the Andes descend towards the forests of the upper Amazon basin. The town stands between the Mocoa and Mulato rivers, in a district once contested by Indigenous peoples and Spanish colonists. Its position placed it between the Andean settlements of Popayán and the forested country farther east, across the eastern foothills and their numerous rivers.

Spanish accounts place a foundation by Gonzalo de Avendaño in 1563, under the name San Miguel de Ágreda de Mocoa. The settlement fell under the governor of Popayán and the bishop of Quito. In 1683 the Andaquí attacked and burned it, and the town was moved to its later site between the two rivers. Difficult communications continued to constrain the colonial settlement.
simp_chinese:
莫科阿位于安第斯山东坡向亚马孙上游森林下降之处，城镇坐落在莫科阿河与穆拉托河之间，所在地区曾是原住民与西班牙殖民者争夺的地方。它的位置连接波帕扬一带的安第斯聚落与更东面的森林地带，沿途穿越东麓及其众多河流。

西班牙记载称，贡萨洛·德·阿文达尼奥于1563年建立圣米格尔德阿格雷达德莫科阿。聚落在行政上隶属波帕扬总督，在教务上归基多主教管辖。1683年，安达基人袭击并焚毁城镇，此后城镇迁至两河之间的所在地。艰难的交通继续限制着殖民聚落的发展。

english:
Mocozo was an Indigenous chiefdom near Tampa Bay in the sixteenth century. Estuaries, coastal waters and inland areas supplied communities with fish, shellfish, game and plants. Canoes connected settlements across bays and rivers, while leaders maintained relationships through exchange, kinship and alliances.

Spanish expeditions reached the Florida coast in the sixteenth century, encountering societies with their own territories and rivalries. Meetings could involve diplomacy, violence and demands for supplies. Disease and later colonial pressures profoundly disrupted Indigenous communities, while local knowledge of coastal resources and seasonal conditions remained important to daily life.
simp_chinese:
莫科佐是十六世纪坦帕湾附近的一个原住民酋邦。河口、沿海水域和内陆提供鱼、贝类、猎物和植物等资源。独木舟沿海湾与河流连接聚落，地方领袖则通过交换、亲属关系和联盟维持往来。

十六世纪，西班牙远征队抵达佛罗里达海岸，遇到拥有各自领地与竞争关系的原住民社会。接触可能涉及外交、暴力和补给要求。疾病以及后来的殖民压力深刻冲击这些社群，而对沿海资源和季节变化的了解仍是日常生活的重要基础。

english: Modasa lies in northeastern Gujarat, near the hills that lead towards Rajasthan. The town stands in a country of cultivated plains and seasonal rivers, on routes between the Gujarat lowlands and the uplands to the north. It belonged to a region shaped by the Gujarat sultanate and later the Mughal province, whose rulers relied on towns and local chiefs to govern the countryside between their larger centres.
simp_chinese: 莫达萨位于古吉拉特东北部，靠近通往拉贾斯坦的丘陵。城镇坐落在耕作平原与季节性河流交错的地区，处于古吉拉特低地和北方高地之间的道路上。这一带曾受到古吉拉特苏丹国及后来的莫卧儿行省统治，统治者依靠城镇与地方首领治理各大中心之间的乡野。

english:
Modena stands on the southern side of the Po Valley, on the course of the ancient Via Aemilia. The Roman colony of Mutina was founded here in 183 BC. Its medieval successor grew around the bishop's seat, and its cathedral, civic tower and great square formed the heart of a city that later became the capital of the Este dukes.

The Este secured lasting control of Modena in 1336, and the city became a duchy under Borso d'Este. When the family lost Ferrara to the papacy in 1598, Modena became the seat of its court. The ducal palace housed the military academy founded by Francesco III in 1757 to train officers for the Este army. The city's university, founded in the twelfth century, was enlarged under Francesco II in 1686.
simp_chinese:
摩德纳坐落在波河平原南侧，位于古代埃米利亚大道沿线。罗马殖民城穆蒂纳于公元前183年在此建立。中世纪的城市在主教驻地周围发展起来；主教座堂、市政塔楼与大广场构成了城市的中心，后来这里又成为埃斯特公爵的都城。

埃斯特家族于1336年确立了对摩德纳的持久统治，博尔索·德斯特在位时，此地升为公国。1598年家族失去费拉拉、该城归教廷后，摩德纳成为其宫廷所在地。弗朗切斯科三世于1757年创办军事学院，在公爵宫内为埃斯特军队培养军官。城市的大学创立于十二世纪，1686年在弗朗切斯科二世治下得到扩充。

english:
Modica fills a pair of ravines in the Hyblaean hills of southeastern Sicily, where two streams join to form the Modicano, whose water turned twenty-three mills between the sixteenth and nineteenth centuries. For centuries it was the capital of the county of Modica, one of the most powerful lordships on the island. Under the Chiaramonte the county grew, and in 1361 Frederick IV of Sicily gave it a Gran Corte with supreme criminal jurisdiction like that of Palermo.

In 1392 Martin I invested the Cabrera, and Modica gained such judicial independence that it was called a kingdom within the kingdom. On 15 August 1474 a mob stormed the Jewish quarter of Cartellone shouting 'Long live Mary and death to the Jews', and killed about 360 people. After the Cabrera died out the county passed to the Enríquez-Cabrera, and later to the Alvarez de Toledo and the Fitz-James Stuart. Earthquakes in 1542 and 1613 and above all the great quake of 1693 destroyed much of the city. The rebuilt San Giorgio cathedral, whose tower façade began rising in 1702, became the finest monument of Sicilian Baroque in the south-east. The feudal order was abolished in 1812 and the county dissolved in 1816.
simp_chinese:
莫迪卡填满了西西里东南部伊布利亚山区的一对峡谷，两条溪流在这里汇成莫迪卡诺河，16至19世纪，河水推动了二十三座水磨。数百年里它是莫迪卡伯爵领的首府，那是岛上最有势力的领地之一。在基亚拉蒙特家族治下伯爵领不断扩大，1361年西西里的腓特烈四世赐给它大法庭（Gran Corte），掌握与巴勒莫相当的最高刑事管辖权。

1392年，马丁一世册封卡夫雷拉家族，莫迪卡获得极大的司法独立，被称为“王国中的王国”。1474年8月15日，暴徒冲进卡尔泰洛内犹太区，高喊“圣母万岁，犹太人去死”，杀害了约360人。卡夫雷拉家族绝嗣后，伯爵领转给恩里克斯-卡夫雷拉家族，后来又传到阿尔瓦雷斯·德·托莱多和菲茨詹姆斯·斯图尔特家族手中。1542年、1613年的地震，尤其是1693年的大地震，毁掉了城市的大部分。重建后的圣乔治主教座堂，塔式立面从1702年起建造，成为西西里东南部巴洛克建筑的杰作。封建制度于1812年废除，伯爵领在1816年解散。

english:
Modigliana lies in the hills of Romagna and was an important seat of the Guidi counts. Its association with the family reached back to the tenth century, when Tegrimo Guidi married Ingelrada of Ravenna. In 1271 the counts made agreements with its inhabitants that recognized the community's municipal government. The town freed itself from their rule in 1377 and came under the influence of Florence.

Modigliana remained linked to the Florentine state and later to the Grand Duchy of Tuscany. It became the seat of an independent podestà in 1510. Local institutions established under Tuscan rule included the literary Accademia degli Incamminati, founded in 1660, and the Spedale dei poveri di Cristo, founded in 1722. During the French occupation, the town served as a sub-prefecture of the Arno department.
simp_chinese:
莫迪利亚纳坐落在罗马涅的丘陵中，曾是圭迪伯爵家族的重要驻地。它与家族的联系可追溯至十世纪，当时泰格里莫·圭迪与拉韦纳的因盖尔拉达结婚。1271年，伯爵与居民订立协议，承认当地公社的成立。1377年，城镇摆脱伯爵统治，转而进入佛罗伦萨的势力范围。

莫迪利亚纳此后与佛罗伦萨国家、继而与托斯卡纳大公国保持联系。1510年，它成为独立执政官的驻地。托斯卡纳统治时期创立的地方机构包括1660年的因卡米纳蒂文学学会，以及1722年的基督贫民医院。法国占领期间，此城成为阿尔诺省的副省治所。

english:
Modipe Hill rises south of Mochudi, above a landscape of old stone-walled settlements. Tradition remembers the Kwena chief Motshodi bringing his people east from Sokwane, on the edge of the Kalahari, in the late sixteenth or early seventeenth century. He settled near Mochudi and later moved to Modipe. Pottery, grinding stones and the remains of houses also bear witness to settlement around the hill in the eighteenth century.

The later city of Mochudi lies here.
simp_chinese:
莫迪佩山耸立在莫丘迪以南，周围散布着古老石墙聚落。相传十六世纪末或十七世纪初，克韦纳首领莫乔迪率领族人从卡拉哈里边缘的索夸内东迁，先在莫丘迪附近定居，后来迁往莫迪佩。陶片、磨石和房屋遗迹也见证了十八世纪山丘周围的聚落生活。

后来的莫丘迪即位于此地。

english: The Modoc lived among the lakes and wetlands of the southern Klamath Basin. Their settlements stood along Tule Lake, the Lost River and Clear Lake, as well as in nearby valleys. Fish and waterfowl supplied food from the waters, while people hunted game and gathered seeds and bulbs on the surrounding ground. Winter villages lay close to the lakes and rivers, linking the people to fishing places and the rich marshes of their homeland.
simp_chinese: 莫多克人生活在克拉马斯盆地南部的湖泊和湿地之间。他们的聚落分布在图利湖、洛斯特河、克利尔湖以及邻近谷地。水域提供鱼和水鸟，居民也在周围土地狩猎，采集种子与鳞茎。冬季村落靠近湖泊与河流，使人们能够利用家园中的渔场与丰饶沼泽。

english:
Methoni, known to the Venetians as Modon, guards a harbour on the southwestern coast of the Morea. Offshore islands shelter its anchorage, and the great castle projects into the sea. For ships travelling between Venice and the eastern Mediterranean, the port was a welcome stopping place; pilgrims bound for the Holy Land left many accounts of their visits.

Venice acquired Methoni and neighbouring Koroni in the early thirteenth century. Under Venetian rule the town prospered through trade with Egypt and the Levant, and Greeks, Latins, Jews and Albanians lived within its walls. In 1500 Sultan Bayezid II besieged and captured the fortress; its inhabitants were killed or sold into slavery. Venice recovered it in 1686, but lost it again in 1715. During the Greek War of Independence, Methoni remained an Ottoman stronghold and served as a base for Ibrahim Pasha's campaign until a French expedition took it in 1828.
simp_chinese:
梅索尼位于摩里亚西南海岸，威尼斯人的名字是莫东。近海岛屿为港湾遮挡风浪，巨大的城堡伸入海中。往返威尼斯与东地中海的船只常在此停靠，前往圣地的朝圣者也留下了许多关于港口的记述。

十三世纪初，威尼斯取得梅索尼和邻近的科罗尼。城镇凭借与埃及、黎凡特的贸易日益繁荣，希腊人、拉丁人、犹太人和阿尔巴尼亚人共同生活在城墙内。1500年，苏丹巴耶济德二世围攻并夺取要塞，居民遭到屠杀或被卖为奴隶。威尼斯于1686年收复此地，1715年又再次失去。希腊独立战争期间，梅索尼仍是奥斯曼据点，成为易卜拉欣帕夏征战的基地，直到1828年法国远征军将其攻下。

english: Modoš lies on the Banat plain beside the Tamiš River, whose floods have long shaped the surrounding fields. The settlement appears in fourteenth-century records under forms of its name including Modos and Modoš. During Ottoman rule, a register associated with the monastery of Peć recorded Serbian inhabitants here, including two priests. In 1717, after the Habsburg conquest of the Banat, the village was counted in the district of Bečkerek with fifty households. Serbian families later moved to the Military Frontier, and German settlers came to the village.
simp_chinese: 莫多什位于巴纳特平原的蒂米什河畔，河水泛滥长期影响着周围的田地。十四世纪的文献以莫多斯、莫多什等名称记载此地。奥斯曼统治期间，与佩奇修道院有关的一份登记册记下了当地塞尔维亚居民的名字，其中包括两名神父。哈布斯堡征服巴纳特后，1717年的记录将这座五十户人家的村庄列入贝切克雷克区。此后，一些塞尔维亚家庭迁往军事边疆，德意志移民来到村里。

english: Moehe’yoe is a recorded name for the Yellowstone River, which flows from the mountains of Wyoming across Montana to the Missouri. Its course links mountain headwaters with a long valley through the northern Plains. The English name translates an older designation referring to yellow rock. In 1806 William Clark followed the river eastward during the return journey of the Lewis and Clark expedition.
simp_chinese: 莫赫约是黄石河的一个记载名称。这条河从怀俄明的群山流出，横贯蒙大拿，注入密苏里河，将山中源头与北部平原漫长的河谷相连。英文名称译自一个指黄色岩石的旧称。1806年，威廉·克拉克在刘易斯与克拉克探险队的返程中沿河向东行进。

english: Moena Kalengo lies in the Angolan highlands near the headwaters of the Cuando. The river rises on the slopes of Mount Tembo and travels southeast through a broad marshy corridor. Much farther downstream it passes through the Linyanti swamps and joins the Zambezi as the Chobe.
simp_chinese: 莫埃纳卡伦戈位于安哥拉高地，靠近宽多河源头。宽多河发源于滕博山山坡，向东南流经宽阔的沼泽地带。远在下游，河水穿过林扬蒂沼泽，以乔贝河之名汇入赞比西河。

english: The Yampa River runs west through the valleys of the northern Colorado mountains towards the Green River. This country was home to Ute communities, including the Yampatika. Families spent warmer months in high mountain parks and wintered in lower valleys along the river, hunting and gathering as the seasons changed. Their journeys joined the river country to the surrounding uplands and to other Ute communities across the mountains.
simp_chinese: 扬帕河向西流过科罗拉多北部山地谷地，奔向绿河。这片土地是尤特社群的家园，其中包括扬帕提卡人。温暖季节，家庭在高山盆地活动；冬季则在河边较低的谷地过冬，随季节狩猎和采集。他们的旅程将河流地区与周围高地，以及山脉各处的其他尤特社群联系起来。

english:
Mogador, now Essaouira, lies on Morocco's Atlantic coast, where an island-protected anchorage faces windswept sea routes. Fishing and local agriculture support communities, while inland roads connect the harbour with the southern Moroccan hinterland. Safe access and reliable supplies give the port value for merchants travelling between Atlantic and regional markets. The surrounding coast combines commercial opportunity with the practical challenges of wind, surf and limited shelter.

The Portuguese briefly maintained a fortress here in the early sixteenth century. In the eighteenth century Sultan Muhammad ibn Abdallah developed Essaouira as a fortified royal port and centre for overseas trade. Known as a gateway to Timbuktu, it linked Morocco and its Saharan hinterland with European markets. Its planned streets and defences reflect both Moroccan and European influences.
simp_chinese:
摩加多尔即今索维拉，位于摩洛哥大西洋岸，受岛屿保护的锚地面向强风海路。捕鱼和地方农业支持社群，内陆道路把港口同摩洛哥南部腹地连接。安全通行及可靠补给，使港口对往返大西洋和区域市场的商人有价值。海岸兼具商业机会，以及风、浪和有限庇护的实际挑战。

十六世纪初，葡萄牙人在此短暂设立堡垒。十八世纪，苏丹穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜拉将索维拉建设为设防王家港口和对外贸易中心。这里被称为通往廷巴克图的门户，连接摩洛哥、撒哈拉腹地与欧洲市场。规划街道及防御设施体现了摩洛哥和欧洲的共同影响。

english: The Mogas were an Indigenous group of the Ambargasta hills, north of the Córdoba ranges and near the great salt flats. They are counted among the peoples known as Comechingones, whose communities inhabited the hills of central Argentina. Cultivation and pottery formed part of life in the region before Spanish conquest. Mountain streams, dry plains and salt basins meet in the country surrounding the Mogas homeland.
simp_chinese: 莫加斯人是安巴尔加斯塔山地的原住民群体，居住在科尔多瓦山脉以北、大片盐沼附近。他们属于被称作科梅钦贡人的诸民族，其社群分布于阿根廷中部山地。西班牙征服之前，耕作与制陶已经是当地生活的一部分。山间溪流、干燥平原和盐盆地在莫加斯故土周围相接。

english: The Moghwachi, or Muache, were a Southern Ute people whose country extended along the eastern slopes of the Rocky Mountains into northern New Mexico. They traded with Pueblo communities, especially Taos, and were known to some as the Taos Utes. Horses brought new possibilities for travel and hunting. The Muache and their Jicarilla Apache allies ranged southeast towards the plains, carrying relationships between mountain homelands and more distant grasslands.
simp_chinese: 莫格瓦奇人也称穆阿奇人，是南部尤特人的一支，其地域沿落基山脉东坡延伸至新墨西哥北部。他们与普韦布洛社群交易，尤其与陶斯人往来，因而也被一些人称为陶斯尤特人。马匹为旅行与狩猎带来新的可能；穆阿奇人和他们的希卡里利亚阿帕奇盟友向东南活动，联系山地家园与更远的草原。

english: Mogi das Cruzes lies on the upper Tietê in the wooded hills east of São Paulo. Its name preserves an Indigenous word associated with the river, while crosses placed along the route gave the settlement its later Portuguese name. Gaspar Vaz opened a path from São Paulo into this country, where a colonial community developed in the early seventeenth century and became a town in 1611.
simp_chinese: 莫吉达斯克鲁济斯位于圣保罗以东、蒂耶特河上游的森林丘陵中。地名保留了与河流有关的原住民语词汇，而道路上设置的十字架为聚落带来了后来的葡萄牙名称。加斯帕尔·瓦斯从圣保罗开辟道路通往这一带，殖民社区在十七世纪初发展，并于1611年成为镇。

english: The Serra do Mar rises steeply above the coast near Mogi, separating the Atlantic shore from the Brazilian plateau. Its humid slopes carry dense Atlantic Forest, with tall trees, palms and streams descending through narrow valleys. The broken ground and thick vegetation form a striking barrier between the coastal lowlands and the higher country beyond, while the mountain forests shelter a wide variety of plants and animals.
simp_chinese: 海岸山脉在莫吉附近陡然升起，将大西洋海岸与巴西高原分隔开来。湿润的山坡上生长着茂密的大西洋森林，高大树木与棕榈之间，溪流沿狭窄山谷而下。崎岖地形和浓密植被在海岸低地与内陆高地之间构成显著屏障，山林也为众多动植物提供栖身之所。

english: Mogi Mirim lies on the inland plateau of São Paulo, along routes that carried travellers toward the goldfields of Goiás. Its name comes from an Indigenous designation for the river and distinguishes it from the larger Mogi Guaçu. A settlement developed on the road through the interior and became the town of Mogi Mirim in 1769, as colonial farms and traffic spread across the region.
simp_chinese: 莫吉米林位于圣保罗内陆高原，坐落在通往戈亚斯金矿的道路上。它的名字源自河流的原住民语名称，用以区别较大的莫吉瓜苏河。随着殖民农场和交通向这一地区扩展，内陆道路旁逐渐形成聚落，并于1769年成为莫吉米林镇。

english:
Mogilev stands on the Dnieper in eastern Belarus, where river navigation and overland routes connect the surrounding countryside with larger commercial networks. Agricultural produce, woodland resources, and craft goods support markets and urban livelihoods. The river provides transport while requiring attention to crossings and seasonal conditions. Town institutions, religious communities, and local elites organize social life in a place whose influence extends into a substantial rural hinterland.

Mogilev was part of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and later the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. In 1577 Stephen Báthory granted the town Magdeburg rights. War between Russia and the Commonwealth brought occupation and sieges in the seventeenth century; residents rose against the Russian garrison in 1661. The first partition of Poland placed the city under Russian rule in 1772.
simp_chinese:
莫吉廖夫位于白俄罗斯东部第聂伯河旁，河运陆路把周围乡村连接到广大商业网络。农产品、林地资源和手工业品，支持市场及城市生计。河流提供运输，也要求关注渡口季节条件。城镇机构、宗教社区和地方上层组织社会生活，使地点影响延伸到广大农村腹地。生产、贸易和公共制度因此共同构成城市作用，也使居民面对外部政治变化。

莫吉廖夫属于立陶宛大公国，后来进入波兰—立陶宛联邦。1577年，斯特凡·巴托里授予城市马格德堡法权。十七世纪俄国与联邦的战争带来占领和围攻；1661年居民反抗俄国驻军。1772年第一次瓜分波兰后，城市归于俄国。

english:
Mogilno lies near the historical border of Greater Poland and Kuyavia, beside a lake. A Benedictine abbey founded in the eleventh century became the focus of a settlement to its north. King Władysław II Jagiełło granted the town its charter in 1398; Mogilno remained abbey property until 1773.

The abbey church preserves parts of its Romanesque structure, although it was rebuilt in later centuries, including the sixteenth and eighteenth. After the First Partition of Poland in 1772, Mogilno passed to Prussia. It was included in the Duchy of Warsaw after 1806 and returned to Prussia in 1815.
simp_chinese:
莫吉尔诺位于大波兰和库亚维历史区域的交界附近，濒临湖泊。11世纪建立的本笃会修道院成为其北侧聚落的中心。国王瓦迪斯瓦夫二世·雅盖沃于1398年授予城镇特许状；莫吉尔诺直到1773年仍属修道院财产。

修道院教堂保留了部分罗马式结构，后来曾多次重建，包括16和18世纪的改建。1772年波兰第一次瓜分后，莫吉尔诺归普鲁士；1806年后被纳入华沙公国，1815年再次归属普鲁士。

english: The Mogot rises in the Stanovoy Range and flows through mountain valleys to join the Gilyuy. Its upper waters run southwest between wooded ridges, turning south after receiving the Lapri. The Gilyuy carries its waters onward toward the Zeya and the Amur. This is a country of forested heights and long winters, where streams cut passages between the mountains and feed the great river system of the northeast.
simp_chinese: 莫戈特河发源于外兴安岭，流经山间谷地，汇入吉柳伊河。上游河水在林木山脊之间向西南流淌，接纳拉普里河后转向南方；吉柳伊河再将它的水送往精奇里江和黑龙江。这片土地山高林密、冬季漫长，溪流切开山地，滋养东北的大河水系。

english:
Mohács stands on the Danube in southern Hungary and belonged to the medieval county of Baranya. On 29 August 1526, an Ottoman army under Suleiman defeated the Hungarian royal army near the town; King Louis II died in the aftermath. The defeat opened a succession struggle and contributed to the later division of the Hungarian kingdom.

Under Ottoman rule Mohács served as the seat of a sanjak. Allied forces took the town in 1686, and in 1687 another battle, later called the second battle of Mohács, was fought near Harsány. The imperial victory formed part of the campaign that displaced Ottoman rule in much of Hungary.
simp_chinese:
莫哈奇位于匈牙利南部多瑙河畔，中世纪属于鲍劳尼奥郡。1526年8月29日，苏莱曼率领的奥斯曼军队在城镇附近击败匈牙利王军，国王拉约什二世在战后遇难。战败引发王位争夺，并促成匈牙利王国后来的分裂。

奥斯曼统治期间，莫哈奇是一个桑贾克的行政中心。1686年联军占领城镇；1687年，哈绍尼附近又发生一场后来被称为第二次莫哈奇战役的交战。帝国军的胜利是夺取匈牙利大片奥斯曼领地的战役进程之一。

english:
Mohan belongs to the Rewa Kantha country of eastern Gujarat, where river valleys and wooded hills connected farming communities with routes across western India. Households cultivated crops according to local water and soils, while livestock, forest resources, and crafts supplemented production. Markets brought goods from different environments into exchange, and paths linked villages with larger towns. Difficult terrain could make transport demanding and gave local knowledge practical importance.

During the late medieval and early modern centuries, local chiefs and communities in the broader region had changing relationships with Gujarat's larger powers. Sultanate, Mughal, and later regional authorities sought revenue, loyalty, and military support. Local intermediaries helped negotiate these obligations, while religious and social traditions remained diverse. Commerce connected rural households with wider networks of exchange.
simp_chinese:
莫汉属于古吉拉特东部的雷瓦坎塔地区，河谷与林木覆盖的丘陵将农业社群同印度西部的道路连接起来。家庭根据水源和土壤种植作物，以牲畜、森林资源和手工业补充生计。市场促进不同地区的产品交换，小路连接村庄和较大城镇。复杂地形增加了运输困难，也使地方道路知识十分重要。

中世纪后期与近代早期，这一更广阔地区的地方首领和社群同古吉拉特各大势力的关系不断变化。苏丹国、莫卧儿及后来的区域政权要求收入、效忠与军事支持。地方中间人帮助协商这些义务，宗教和社会传统仍然多样。商业则把乡村家庭同更广的交换网络联系起来。

english: Mohe lies in the northern forests south of the Amur, in a country of long winters and winding rivers. During the Qing campaigns against the Russian fort of Albazin, the need to send troops and supplies across this difficult region led to the construction of a military relay road. In 1685 soldiers cut a route from Mergen through the Greater Khingan toward the mouth of the Emur. Its stations carried messages and provisions between the inland garrisons and the Amur frontier.
simp_chinese: 漠河位于黑龙江以南的北方森林，河流曲折，冬季漫长。清军进攻俄军据守的雅克萨时，需要穿过这片艰险地区运送军队与物资，因此修建军事驿道。1685年，官兵从墨尔根开辟道路，穿越大兴安岭，通向额穆尔河口。沿途驿站在内地驻防地与黑龙江边疆之间传递军报和供给。

english:
Moheli belongs to the Comoro Islands in the northern Mozambique Channel, where volcanic land and surrounding seas connected communities with both agriculture and maritime resources. Gardens, trees, fishing grounds, and coastal landings supported households in a tropical environment. Boats carried people and goods between islands and toward neighboring coasts. Monsoon winds and knowledge of currents shaped the opportunities and risks of these journeys.

The Comoros formed part of Indian Ocean networks linking East Africa, Madagascar, Arabia and other shores. Mohéli was subject to the sultanate of Anjouan before 1830, when Ramanetaka led migrants from Madagascar to the island and established his rule there. He later took the name Abderemane. The island's political history thus reflects connections across the Mozambique Channel as well as relationships among the Comoros themselves.
simp_chinese:
莫埃利岛属于莫桑比克海峡北部科摩罗群岛，火山陆地和周围海洋，使社区同时利用农业与海洋资源。园圃、树木、渔场和沿岸泊地支持热带家庭生活，船只在岛际及邻近海岸运送人员货物。季风和海流知识影响旅程机会及风险，地方生计同航海联系紧密结合。

科摩罗群岛参与连接东非、马达加斯加、阿拉伯及其他海岸的印度洋网络。1830年前莫埃利受昂儒昂苏丹国统治；那一年，拉马内塔卡率马达加斯加移民抵岛并建立自己的统治，后来改名阿卜杜勒拉赫曼。岛屿政治史因此既体现科摩罗岛际关系，也反映跨越莫桑比克海峡的联系。

english: The Mohetan were an Indigenous people of the mountain river country west of Virginia's coastal settlements, often associated with the Moneton of the Kanawha valley. In 1671 an English expedition led by Thomas Batte and Robert Hallom reached the upper New River with Indigenous guides. Their journal records meeting a representative of the Mehetan, who had sought news of the strangers among the Totero. The encounter took place as Virginia traders and explorers sought routes beyond the mountains into the western watersheds.
simp_chinese: 莫赫坦人是弗吉尼亚海岸殖民聚落以西山地河流地区的原住民，常被认为与卡诺瓦河谷的莫内顿人有关。1671年，托马斯·巴特和罗伯特·哈勒姆率领英国远征队，在原住民向导带领下到达新河上游。旅程记录称，他们会见了一名梅赫坦人的代表；此人曾向托特罗人打听这些陌生人的消息。当时，弗吉尼亚的商人和探险者正寻找越过山脉、进入西方流域的道路。

english: Möhkö lies beside the Koitajoki and its rapids in the forest country of eastern Ilomantsi. It was originally part of the village of Nuorajärvi, which occupied the shores of the lake into which the river flows. The name of Möhkö and the nearby hill Möhkönvaara is related to a word for a lump or rounded hill. Here the river threads through the wooded borderland of North Karelia, connecting the lake with the country farther upstream.
simp_chinese: 默赫克位于伊洛曼齐东部的森林地带，坐落在科伊塔约基河及其急流旁。这里原是努奥拉耶尔维村的一部分，村庄分布在河流注入的同名湖岸。默赫克和附近默赫肯瓦拉山的名称与表示块状物或圆丘的词语有关。河流穿过北卡累利阿林木覆盖的边地，将湖泊与上游地区连接起来。

english: Mohotani lies among the volcanic Marquesas Islands of eastern Polynesia. Polynesian communities inhabited the archipelago long before European ships arrived. In 1595 Álvaro de Mendaña's expedition reached the southern Marquesas while sailing west from Peru; its encounter with islanders was marked by violence.
simp_chinese: 莫霍塔尼位于东波利尼西亚的马克萨斯火山群岛之中。欧洲船只到来之前很久，波利尼西亚社区已在群岛生活。1595年，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚的远征队从秘鲁向西航行时抵达马克萨斯南部，与岛民的相遇伴随着暴力。

english:
Mohyliv stands on the Dniester opposite the Moldavian bank, where a crossing links Podolia with the lands to the south. The town grew on the site of the older village of Ivankivtsi and took its name from the Moldavian ruler Ieremia Movilă. In 1595 the estate passed to the Polish Potocki family through the marriage of his daughter.

Its position on a contested frontier exposed Mohyliv to the conflicts of the seventeenth century. Cossack forces fought for the town, and it later fell under Ottoman rule before returning to the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. In 1793 the second partition of Poland brought Mohyliv into the Russian Empire. Its population included Ukrainians, Poles, Moldavians and Jews, whose communities reflected the town's place between neighbouring lands.
simp_chinese:
莫希利夫坐落在德涅斯特河畔，与摩尔达维亚河岸相对；这里的渡口将波多利亚与南方诸地相连。城镇兴起于更早的伊万基夫齐村旧址，以摩尔达维亚统治者伊耶雷米亚·莫维勒命名。1595年，他的女儿出嫁后，地产转入波兰波托茨基家族之手。

这座城镇处在争夺激烈的边境，十七世纪屡受战乱影响。哥萨克军队曾为争夺此城而战，此后它落入奥斯曼人手中，后来重归波兰立陶宛联邦。1793年第二次瓜分波兰时，莫希利夫并入俄罗斯帝国。当地居民包括乌克兰人、波兰人、摩尔达维亚人和犹太人，他们的社群反映出城镇处于各地交汇之处。

english:
Moi is a Papuan language of the western Bird’s Head Peninsula in New Guinea. Forested lowlands and hills extend behind the coastal waters facing Raja Ampat. The Moi language belongs to a different group from the Austronesian languages spoken on some neighbouring shores and islands, reflecting the peninsula’s great linguistic diversity.

The later city of Sorong lies here.
simp_chinese:
莫伊语是新几内亚鸟头半岛西部的一种巴布亚语言。森林低地和山丘在面向拉贾安帕特的海岸水域后方延伸。莫伊语不同于部分邻近海岸与岛屿使用的南岛语言，反映出半岛丰富的语言多样性。

后来的索龙即位于此地。

english: Moi-Urusta lies near the Elgenya, a left tributary of the Kolyma in the mountain country of northeastern Siberia. The stream from which the place takes its name belongs to a landscape of forested valleys and high ridges. The Elgenya winds around the Bolshoy Anngachak massif before joining the larger river. The Kolyma carries these waters northward through the interior toward the East Siberian Sea.
simp_chinese: 莫伊乌鲁斯塔位于埃尔根尼亚河附近，地处西伯利亚东北部山地；埃尔根尼亚河是科雷马河的一条左岸支流。此地得名的溪流流经森林河谷和高山脊交错的地区。埃尔根尼亚河绕过大安加恰克山体后汇入大河，科雷马河将这些水流向北送往东西伯利亚海。

english: The Moingwena were a people of the Illinois confederacy, known to French travellers in the Mississippi valley. In 1673 Jacques Marquette and Louis Jolliet encountered Illinois people west of the Mississippi near the mouth of the Des Moines River. Marquette learned of the Moingwena living farther up a river in the interior, and their name appeared on subsequent maps. French mapmakers applied it to the river itself, contributing to the name Des Moines. Their villages formed part of a wider Illinois world linked by language, kinship and exchange.
simp_chinese: 莫因格韦纳人是伊利诺伊联盟的成员，密西西比河谷的法国旅行者曾记述他们。1673年，雅克·马凯特和路易·若利埃在得梅因河口附近的密西西比河西岸遇到伊利诺伊人。马凯特得知莫因格韦纳人住在内陆一条河的上游，后来地图上也出现了他们的名称。法国制图者用这一名称指称河流，得梅因河之名即与之有关。莫因格韦纳村落属于更广大的伊利诺伊世界，各社群以语言、亲属和交换联系。

english: Moira lies on the plateau west of Serenje, in Lala-speaking country near the headwaters of the Luombwa. Lala oral history remembers a time when the region was divided among clan territories and their leaders. Before the nineteenth century the Nyendwa clan gained prominence in Ilala, the central Lala country; its chiefs established neighbouring chiefdoms as a protective belt around their homeland.
simp_chinese: 莫伊拉位于塞伦杰以西的高原，处在卢翁布瓦河源头附近的拉拉语地区。拉拉人的口述历史记得，这里曾分为不同氏族领地，由各自的领袖统领。十九世纪以前，年德瓦氏族在拉拉人的中心地区伊拉拉取得优势；其首领又在周边建立首领领地，作为保卫家园的屏障。

english: Mois Waar lies among the islands of Cenderawasih Bay, off northern New Guinea. The bay’s island and coastal communities maintained maritime connections long before European maps. Oral traditions describe Biak-speaking people moving west from the bay toward Raja Ampat and trading networks involving Tidore.
simp_chinese: 莫伊斯瓦尔位于新几内亚北部仙德拉瓦西湾的岛屿之间。欧洲海图出现之前，海湾的岛屿和沿岸社群已维持海上联系。口述传统讲述说比亚克语的人从海湾向西迁往拉贾安帕特，以及涉及蒂多雷的贸易网络。

english: Moïssala lies on the Bahr Sara, the river known upstream as the Ouham, in the homeland of the Mbay people. The river bends northward towards the Chari, carrying the waters of the southern country towards Lake Chad. The Mbay speak a language related to those of neighbouring Sara communities, whose villages share many customs while retaining their own local identities.
simp_chinese: 穆瓦萨拉位于巴尔萨拉河畔，处在姆拜人的家乡；这条河的上游称为瓦姆河。河水向北弯曲流向沙里河，将南方地区的水带往乍得湖。姆拜人的语言与邻近萨拉社群的语言相近，各村既有许多共同习俗，也保留着各自的地方身份。

english: Moito lies in the Sahelian country east of Massakory and south of Moussoro. Sandy dunes alternate with low ground where clay retains the seasonal rains. Around the eastern side of Lake Chad, grasses grow on the dunes, while acacias and desert dates take root in the depressions.
simp_chinese: 莫伊托位于马萨科里以东、穆苏罗以南的萨赫勒地带。沙丘与低地交错分布，低地的黏土能够保留季节性雨水。乍得湖东侧的沙丘上生长着禾草，金合欢与沙漠枣则在洼地扎根。

english: The sands of the Moiynkum stretch across the Chu-Talas depression, between the Chu River and the northern slopes of the Karatau and Kyrgyz Ala-Too. Ridges and low dunes cover much of this dry country, where saxaul grows among the sands and grasses are more common towards the south. The Chu and Talas lose themselves in the lowlands bordering the desert, their waters dwindling before they can reach a distant sea.
simp_chinese: 莫因库姆的沙地铺展在楚河与卡拉套山、吉尔吉斯阿拉套山北麓之间，属于楚河—塔拉斯河洼地。低矮的沙丘和沙垄覆盖着大片干旱土地，梭梭生长于沙间，南部则有更多草本植物。楚河与塔拉斯河流入沙漠边缘的低地后水量渐减，最终消散，无法抵达遥远的海洋。

english: The Moiynty is a small steppe river flowing south from the Kazakh uplands toward Lake Balkhash, along the eastern edge of the Betpak-Dala desert. Fed chiefly by melting snow, it carries most of its water in spring; in dry months the lower channel breaks into separate pools. Its basin belongs to a broad expanse of low hills and arid steppe, where seasonal streams make their way southward toward the inland drainage of Balkhash.
simp_chinese: 莫因特是一条小型草原河流，从哈萨克丘陵向南流向巴尔喀什湖，沿途经过别特帕克达拉沙漠东缘。河水主要来自融雪，春季流量最大；干旱月份里，下游河道断成一段段水潭。其流域是一片辽阔的低丘与干旱草原，季节性河流向南汇入巴尔喀什内流区。

english: Mojácar rises above the Mediterranean coast of eastern Granada, its houses clustered on a defensible hill. In 1488 the town passed to the Catholic Monarchs as their armies took the surrounding region. The Muslim inhabitants and their descendants remained through a period of profound change, until the Morisco uprising of 1568 and its defeat led to the removal of communities from the region in 1570.
simp_chinese: 莫哈卡尔位于格拉纳达东部地中海沿岸，房屋聚集在易于防守的山丘上。1488年，天主教双王的军队占领周边地区，城镇也归入他们的统治。穆斯林居民及其后裔在剧变中继续生活于此，直到1568年莫里斯科人起义失败，1570年当地社群被迁离。

english: Mojenga lies east of the Cubango River, among the broad sandy plains of southern Angola. The Cubango rises on the central plateau and runs south before turning east towards the Okavango Delta. On its eastern side, tributaries including the Cuebe and Cuatir descend from the interior, their courses generally running parallel from north to south.
simp_chinese: 莫延加位于库邦戈河以东、安哥拉南部宽广的沙质平原上。库邦戈河发源于中央高原，向南流后转向东方，通往奥卡万戈三角洲。河流东侧的奎贝河、夸蒂尔河等支流从内陆流下，河道大致平行地由北向南延伸。

english: Macaé lies where the river of the same name meets the Atlantic coast of Rio de Janeiro. In the seventeenth century Jesuits established a presence here, including a chapel, college and estate, while Indigenous people were settled along the river. The estate supplied provisions to Rio de Janeiro. The community became the town of São João de Macaé in 1813, taking its name from the river.
simp_chinese: 马卡埃位于同名河流注入里约热内卢大西洋海岸之处。十七世纪，耶稣会在此建立了小教堂、学院和庄园，并将原住民安置在河沿岸。庄园向里约热内卢供应粮食。1813年，这处社区成为圣若昂迪马卡埃镇，名字取自河流。

english:
Rising in the central Sierra Nevada, the Mokelumne River flows west towards the Sacramento–San Joaquin River Delta. Its basin was home to Miwok, Yokuts and Wintun peoples, with many villages along the lower river between the foothills and the delta. The name Mokelumne comes from Plains Miwok words for a fish net and a people, while another Miwok name for the river was Wakalumitch.

Spanish military expeditions probably reached the river in the late eighteenth or early nineteenth century. In 1817 the missionary Narciso Durán recorded the name Muquelumnes. French fur trappers established an outpost at Happy Valley in 1830, near what would become Mokelumne Hill. Their arrival introduced a new presence into a watershed long inhabited by its Indigenous communities.
simp_chinese:
莫克勒姆尼河发源于内华达山脉中段，向西流往萨克拉门托—圣华金三角洲。米沃克人、约库茨人和温顿人居住在流域内；从山麓到三角洲之间的下游地带分布着许多村庄。莫克勒姆尼之名出自平原米沃克语中鱼网和人群的词语，米沃克人还称这条河为瓦卡卢米奇。

西班牙军事探险队可能在十八世纪末或十九世纪初抵达此河。1817年，传教士纳西索·杜兰记下了“穆克卢姆内斯”这一名称。1830年，法国捕皮者在快乐谷建立据点，地点靠近后来兴起的莫克勒姆尼山镇。他们的到来，使这个原住民世代居住的流域出现了新的外来者。

english:
Mokhcha, also known as Mukhsha, was a town of the Golden Horde on the upper Moksha, near the later settlement of Narovchat. It stood in a region inhabited by Mordvin communities and became the centre of a northern ulus. Archaeological remains reveal brick buildings, baths and Muslim mausoleums, evidence of a substantial town beyond the great Volga cities of the south.

Coins were struck at Mukhsha from 1313 to 1367. During the struggles that divided the Horde, the town was seized by the beg Taghay in 1362. It was apparently devastated by Timur's forces in 1395 and declined in the early fifteenth century. Its ruins remained beneath the later settlement, preserving traces of the buildings and burials of a frontier centre of the Horde.
simp_chinese:
莫赫恰又称穆赫沙，是金帐汗国在莫克沙河上游的一座城镇，位于后来纳罗夫恰特聚落附近。这里地处莫尔多瓦社群的居地，曾是北方一个兀鲁思的中心。砖砌建筑、浴室和穆斯林陵墓的遗迹表明，伏尔加河沿岸大城之外也存在颇具规模的城市。

穆赫沙在1313至1367年间铸造钱币。金帐汗国内争期间，别克塔盖于1362年占据此城。1395年它显然遭到帖木儿军队破坏，15世纪初逐渐衰落。遗址留在后来的聚落地下，保存了这个汗国边地中心的建筑和墓葬痕迹。

english: Mokil, or Mwoakilloa, is an inhabited atoll east of Pohnpei, with three low islands around a lagoon. In 1815 the Marquis of Wellington probably sighted it on a voyage to Canton. In 1824 Duperrey’s Coquille lay off Mokil, and islanders came out in canoes to trade with the French ship.
simp_chinese: 莫基尔又称姆沃阿基洛阿，是波纳佩以东有人居住的环礁，三座低岛环绕潟湖。1815年，威灵顿侯爵号驶往广州途中可能望见此地。1824年，迪佩雷的贝壳号停在莫基尔外海，岛民划独木舟出海，与法国船只交易。

english: Mokil is a low coral atoll east of Pohnpei, with islets surrounding a lagoon in the Pacific. Its inhabitants maintained connections with neighbouring island communities before European contact. On Pohnpei, the Saudeleur rulers held their ceremonial centre at Nan Madol until a later change in political authority.
simp_chinese: 莫基尔是波纳佩以东的一座低矮珊瑚环礁，太平洋中的小岛环绕潟湖。与欧洲人接触之前，居民已与邻近岛屿社群维持联系。在波纳佩，绍德雷尔统治者曾以南马都尔为祭祀中心，直到后来政治权力发生变化。

english: Mokowan is a Blackfoot word associated with the Belly River, which rises in the Rocky Mountains and flows northeast across southern Alberta. Its name has been interpreted as “stomach,” giving rise to the English river name. The Belly joins the St. Mary River and then the Oldman, carrying mountain water into the prairie. Its valleys and the surrounding grasslands were part of the homeland of the Blackfoot peoples, who followed bison across the plains.
simp_chinese: 莫科万是与贝利河有关的黑脚语词，河水发源于落基山脉，向东北穿过艾伯塔南部。这个名称被解释为“胃”，由此产生了英语河名。贝利河汇入圣玛丽河，再流入奥德曼河，把山中水流带入草原。河谷与周围草地属于黑脚族诸部的家园，他们追随野牛群穿行于平原。

english: The open country around Mokrous lies east of the Volga, between the river's meadow bank and the dry interior steppe. Before the later settlement was founded, the grasslands belonged to a wider landscape of seasonal grazing and movement between the Volga and Ural. In the eighteenth century Russian settlement expanded eastward from the great river, while pastoral peoples continued to use the plains beyond the growing line of villages. Shallow valleys and salt-bearing soils mark this part of the Trans-Volga country.
simp_chinese: 莫克鲁斯周围的开阔地带位于伏尔加河以东，介于河流草地岸与干燥的内陆草原之间。后来的聚落建立之前，这片草地属于伏尔加河与乌拉尔河之间更广阔的季节性放牧和迁徙地区。十八世纪，俄罗斯定居活动从大河向东扩展，牧民仍在不断增长的村庄带之外使用平原。浅谷与含盐土壤是这片外伏尔加地区的特点。

english: Mokshan grew beside the river from which it took its name, in the country north of Penza. A fortress was founded here in 1679 as part of the network of defensive lines protecting the Russian state's southeastern border. These lines combined fortified towns with barriers across the approaches from the steppe, and their construction encouraged the settlement of the surrounding lands. The Moksha, one of the two principal Mordvin peoples, had long inhabited the wider region before the advance of Muscovite fortifications.
simp_chinese: 莫克山兴起于奔萨以北的同名河流畔。1679年，此地建立了一座堡垒，成为保护俄罗斯国家东南边疆的防线网络的一部分。这些防线以设防城镇和横跨草原通道的障碍物相配合，其修建推动了周围土地的开发和定居。在莫斯科防御工事向此前进之前，莫尔多瓦人的两大分支之一莫克沙人早已居住在更广阔的地区。

english:
Moksobo was a village in the dry plain north of Ava, later transformed into the royal city of Shwebo. Its story is inseparable from Aung Zeya, the local leader who became King Alaungpaya and founded the Konbaung dynasty. Walls, moats and a palace enclosure marked the rise of a royal capital from the village, while the surrounding fields supplied its people and armies.

In 1752 the forces of Hanthawaddy captured Ava. Aung Zeya rallied neighbouring villages at Moksobo and resisted their advance, taking the title Alaungpaya. He built up his home as a fortified capital and led campaigns that carried his power down the Irrawaddy. Ava was recovered and, by 1757, Pegu had fallen. After his death in 1760 his successors continued to rule from Moksobo for a time; the court later moved to Ava, but the old capital remained closely associated with the dynasty's beginnings.
simp_chinese:
木各具是阿瓦以北干燥平原上的村庄，后来发展为王都瑞波。它的历史与地方领袖昂觉耶密不可分；他即雍笈牙王，贡榜王朝的建立者。城墙、壕沟和宫城见证了村庄成为王都的过程，周围田野则供应居民与军队。

1752年，汉达瓦底军队攻陷阿瓦。昂觉耶在木各具召集邻近村落抵抗，采用雍笈牙的称号。他将故乡建成设防王都，率军沿伊洛瓦底江向南扩张；阿瓦被夺回，勃固也于1757年陷落。1760年他去世后，继承者仍在木各具统治了一段时间。宫廷后来迁往阿瓦，但旧都始终与王朝的起源紧密相连。

sources.title: The Imperial Gazetteer of India Volume XXII - 1908.pdf

english: Mokumanamana is a small rocky island northwest of the main Hawaiian Islands. Its dry slopes contain an unusually dense collection of Hawaiian shrines and other stone structures. Hawaiians voyaged here before European contact, probably for religious purposes as well as to use the island’s resources. In 1787 La Pérouse briefly surveyed the island.
simp_chinese: 莫库马纳马纳是夏威夷主岛西北方的一座小岩岛。干燥山坡上有密集的夏威夷神龛和其他石构遗迹。欧洲人接触之前，夏威夷人已航行至此，可能出于宗教目的，也利用岛上资源。1787年，拉佩鲁兹短暂测绘了此岛。

english: Mokumanamana is a small basalt island northwest of Nihoa, surrounded by the Pacific. Hawaiians built religious structures on its steep land and made stone images and fishing tools there. In 1786 the French navigator La Pérouse visited the island and named it Necker after a French finance minister.
simp_chinese: 莫库马纳马纳是尼霍阿岛西北方的一座小玄武岩岛，四周为太平洋环绕。夏威夷人在陡峭的岛上修建宗教建筑，制作石像和捕鱼工具。1786年，法国航海家拉佩鲁兹到访，将它以法国财政大臣之名命名为内克尔岛。

english: The coast of Mokumanamana borders a small rocky island in the northwestern Hawaiian chain. Its ancient Hawaiian sites include religious structures and carved stone images, as well as evidence of fishing. The French explorer La Pérouse visited in 1786 and named the island for Jacques Necker.
simp_chinese: 莫库马纳马纳海岸环绕夏威夷西北列岛中的一座岩石小岛。岛上的古夏威夷遗址包括宗教建筑、雕刻石像和捕鱼活动的遗迹。法国探险家拉佩鲁兹于1786年到访，以雅克·内克尔之名为岛屿命名。

english:
Mokwa was one of the seats of the rulers of Nupe, whose kingdom grew among the peoples of the middle Niger. Nupe was governed from a succession of towns, among them Nupeko, Gbara, Jima and Mokwa. Mokwa was also an early trading centre, situated in a region where political authority and commerce were closely entwined.

Nupe tradition credits Tsoede, also called Edegi, with bringing several communities under one ruler. His successors occupied different centres over the centuries; Mokwa was among the towns chosen as a royal seat. The reasons for such moves remain a subject of debate, though changes in trade routes and struggles within the ruling house may both have played a part. At times rival claimants could rule from separate centres.
simp_chinese:
莫克瓦曾是努佩统治者的驻地之一。努佩王国兴起于尼日尔河中游诸族之间，其君主并不始终居于同一座都城，而曾先后驻在努佩科、格巴拉、吉马和莫克瓦等地。莫克瓦也是一处早期贸易中心，地方政治与商业在此交织。

努佩传统将多个社群的统一归功于措埃德，又称埃德吉。他的继承者在随后的几个世纪中迁居不同的中心，莫克瓦便是选作王室驻地的城镇之一。迁都的原因仍有争议，贸易路线的变化与王室内部的争斗都可能有所影响；有时相互竞争的王位继承者会分别驻于不同的中心。

english: Molangur is a hill fort in the Telangana country east of Karimnagar. Its ruined walls follow the rocky height, where wells and waterworks helped sustain the people within the defences. Tradition associates its construction with a commander of the Kakatiya ruler Prataparudra. A shrine to Molang Shah Wali and the remains of older Shiva temples show the different religious traditions attached to the site over time.
simp_chinese: 莫兰古尔是卡里姆讷格尔以东特伦甘纳地区的一座山堡。残存城墙沿岩石高地延伸，井和蓄水设施曾帮助维持防御工事内的人们生活。传统认为堡垒由卡卡提亚统治者普拉塔帕鲁德拉麾下的一位将领建造。莫兰沙阿·瓦利圣祠和较早的湿婆神庙遗迹，显示出不同时期与此地相联系的宗教传统。

english: Molchanovo stands on the high left bank of the Ob, in the forested river country north of Tomsk. The village is dated to 1702. Its position beside the great river placed it in a landscape of channels, lakes and floodplains, where the course of the Ob has long affected the settlement’s bank. The wider district included indigenous communities as well as Russian villages established during the settlement of the region.
simp_chinese: 莫尔恰诺沃位于托木斯克以北的森林河谷地带，坐落在鄂毕河较高的左岸。村庄的建立可追溯至1702年。它临近大河，周围分布着河汊、湖泊和泛滥平原；鄂毕河的水流长期影响着聚落所在的河岸。广大地区既有原住民社群，也有该地区移民定居时期建立的俄国村庄。

sources.title: Историческая география пространства человека, человек в пространстве.pdf

english:
Molde lies on the northern shore of Romsdalsfjord, looking across the water towards the mountains of Romsdal. A landing place grew here around 1600 on land belonging to the farms of Molde and Reknes. Timber and herring drew merchants to the harbour, including Dutch traders who carried Norwegian products across the North Sea, as well as merchants from England, Scotland and Portugal.

Molde was recorded as a trading place under Trondheim in 1614, but lost its trading and customs rights in 1660. Its struggle for independent status continued into the following century. In 1742 it received a royal charter as a town with its own customs house, establishing it as a separate commercial centre for the surrounding fjord country and its many scattered settlements.
simp_chinese:
莫尔德位于鲁姆斯达尔峡湾北岸，隔水眺望南面的群山。约1600年，莫尔德和雷克内斯两座农场的土地上出现了一处港口。木材与鲱鱼吸引商人前来，包括把挪威货品运过北海的荷兰商人，以及来自英格兰、苏格兰和葡萄牙的商人。

1614年的记载将莫尔德列为特隆赫姆辖下的贸易港，但1660年它失去了贸易与海关权利。争取独立地位的努力延续到下个世纪。1742年，莫尔德获得皇家城市特许和自己的海关，成为周围峡湾地区及分散聚落独立的商业中心。

english: Molevon gave its name to a district of Armenian Cilicia between the lordships of Lampron and Bardzraberd. Its fortress was remembered as a great and inaccessible stronghold in the Taurus, one of the castles through which Armenian lords held the mountain approaches to the plain. Molevon was also associated with an Armenian bishopric and the monastery of Grner, linking the fortified district to the religious life of the kingdom.
simp_chinese: 莫莱冯为奇里乞亚亚美尼亚的一处地区命名，该地位于兰普龙与巴尔兹拉贝尔德领地之间。它的堡垒被记为托罗斯山中一座宏伟而难以攻取的要塞，是亚美尼亚领主管理通往平原的山路所依靠的城堡之一。莫莱冯也与一处亚美尼亚主教区及格尔纳修道院有关，使设防地区与王国的宗教生活相连。

sources.title: Catolicosado de la Gran Casa de Cilicia

english: Molina de Aragón occupies the valley of the Gallo beneath a vast castle, on ground contested between Castile and Aragon. The town and its surrounding lordship possessed their own fueros. In 1369 its inhabitants rejected a new lord and placed themselves under the Crown of Aragon; they returned to Castilian allegiance a few years later, but retained the name Molina de Aragón. During the Peninsular War French troops sacked and burned the town in 1810 before local fighters, aided by the guerrilla leader El Empecinado, drove them away.
simp_chinese: 莫利纳德阿拉贡坐落在加略河谷，巨大城堡俯瞰镇子；这里曾是卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡争夺的边地。城镇及周围领地拥有自己的特许法。1369年，居民拒绝接受新领主，转而归附阿拉贡王冠；数年后他们重归卡斯蒂利亚，但保留了莫利纳德阿拉贡的名称。半岛战争期间，法军于1810年劫掠并焚烧城镇，后来当地武装在游击队首领“顽固者”协助下将其逐走。

english:
Moulins, on the Allier, became the capital of the dukes of Bourbon. Their castle and collegiate church gave form to a court that attracted artists and craftsmen, while the town grew into the centre of their extensive lands in central France. The dukes embellished their residence with some of the earliest Renaissance architecture in France.

The court's patronage reached a high point under Pierre II of Bourbon and Anne of France. They appear as donors in the celebrated triptych of the Master of Moulins, kneeling beneath the protection of their patron saints. The painting, made around the beginning of the sixteenth century for the collegiate church, joined the splendour of the ducal court to the devotional life of its church.
simp_chinese:
穆兰坐落在阿列河畔，曾是波旁公爵的首府。公爵城堡和协同教堂构成宫廷的中心，吸引了艺术家与工匠；城镇也成为公爵在法国中部广大领地的核心。公爵们装饰自己的住所，在此留下了法国最早的一批文艺复兴建筑。

波旁公爵皮埃尔二世和法兰西的安妮统治时，宫廷的艺术赞助达到高峰。著名的《穆兰大师三联画》将夫妇二人作为捐赠者，描绘成跪在各自主保圣人庇护下的形象。这幅约作于十六世纪初、为协同教堂绘制的画，将公爵宫廷的华彩与教堂的虔敬生活结合起来。

english: Mollyguajeck Lake lies in the wooded interior of Newfoundland, along the course of the Terra Nova River. Its name has been explained as a lake of low growth. Water passes through the lake and then Terra Nova Lake before reaching Alexander Bay on the island's eastern coast. The river system supports Atlantic salmon and brook trout, as well as eels and other fish that inhabit its fresh waters.
simp_chinese: 莫利瓜杰克湖位于纽芬兰森林内陆，坐落在特拉诺瓦河的水路上。湖名曾被解释为低矮植被环绕的湖泊。水流经过此湖，再穿过特拉诺瓦湖，最后抵达岛屿东岸的亚历山大湾。河系中有大西洋鲑鱼、溪鳟、鳗鱼及其他淡水鱼类。

english: The Molodo flows east from the northeastern edge of the Central Siberian Plateau to join the Lena from the left. It is one of the great tributaries of the lower Lena, entering the river hundreds of kilometres above its mouth. The Syungyude is its largest tributary. Forested valleys and numerous waterways lie between the plateau and the great river, in a region of long winters and brief summers.
simp_chinese: 穆奥拉达河从中西伯利亚高原东北缘向东流去，从左岸汇入勒拿河。它是勒拿河下游的重要支流之一，在距勒拿河口数百公里处汇合；松居德河是它最大的支流。高原与大河之间分布着森林河谷和众多水道，这里的冬季漫长，夏季短暂。

english: Molodoi Tud lies on the left bank of the Tudovka in the country southwest of Rzhev. The village arose in the late fourteenth century and was formerly known as Spasskoye. During the Time of Troubles a Lithuanian fortification stood here; after the disturbances it acquired the name Molodoi Tud in 1613. From 1689 the village belonged to Boris Sheremetev and his descendants, while part later passed to the Panin family. In the eighteenth century it was known as a substantial village of craftsmen.
simp_chinese: 莫洛多伊图德位于勒热夫西南的图多夫卡河左岸。村庄兴起于十四世纪末，旧称斯帕斯科耶。混乱时期，此地曾有立陶宛人的防御工事；动乱结束后，村庄于1613年取得莫洛多伊图德之名。1689年起，村庄归鲍里斯·谢列梅捷夫及其后代所有，后来一部分又归帕宁家族。十八世纪时，这里已是一座规模可观的手工业村庄。

english:
Mologa stood at the meeting of the Mologa and Volga rivers. It belonged first to the principality of Rostov and then to Yaroslavl, before becoming the center of an independent principality in 1321. Ivan III later brought it under Moscow's rule. The former ruling family moved to Moscow, where its descendants became known as the princes Prozorovsky and Shakhovskoy. The diplomat Sigismund von Herberstein recorded a fortress at Mologa.

In the late fifteenth century a fair was transferred here from Kholopiy Gorodok farther north. Mologa consequently developed into an important trading center for exchange with Asian countries. After the turmoil of the early seventeenth century it prospered as a trading sloboda. Its place on the Volga later acquired another advantage with the Tikhvin water system, which connected the Volga basin to the Baltic Sea and made Mologa a staging point on the route.
simp_chinese:
莫洛加坐落在莫洛加河与伏尔加河交汇处。它先后属于罗斯托夫和雅罗斯拉夫尔公国，1321年成为独立公国的中心，后来被伊凡三世并入莫斯科。原来的统治家族迁往莫斯科，其后裔以普罗佐罗夫斯基和沙霍夫斯科伊诸公爵之名为人所知。外交官西吉斯蒙德·冯·赫贝尔施泰因记载，这里有一座堡垒。

十五世纪末，北方霍洛皮戈罗多克的一处集市迁至莫洛加，城镇因此发展成为与亚洲诸地交易的重要中心。十七世纪初混乱时期过后，它作为贸易聚落继续繁荣。后来，连接伏尔加河流域与波罗的海的季赫温水系又为其伏尔加河畔的位置增添了优势，莫洛加成为这条水路上的中转站。

english:
Molokaʻi lies between Oʻahu and Maui in the central Hawaiian chain, its volcanic land bordered by steep northern cliffs and a long southern coral barrier reef along its coast. Hawaiian communities cultivated its valleys and coastal lands under their chiefs, maintaining connections with neighboring islands across the channels.

During the struggles for the Hawaiian Islands, Kamehameha’s campaigns reached Molokaʻi as well as Maui and Lānaʻi. The campaign was part of a longer contest between powerful chiefs of Hawaiʻi and Maui. In 1795 he took the island before crossing to Oʻahu, where victory at Nuʻuanu brought most of the main islands under his authority. Kauaʻi’s ruler accepted his supremacy in 1810, completing the kingdom’s unification.
simp_chinese:
莫洛凯位于夏威夷岛链中部的瓦胡与毛伊之间，火山岛陆北侧是陡峭的峭壁，南岸有延伸的珊瑚堡礁。夏威夷社群在首领统治下耕种山谷与海岸，并越过海峡与邻岛保持联系。

在争夺夏威夷群岛的战争中，卡美哈美哈的远征抵达莫洛凯、毛伊和拉奈。这次征战是夏威夷岛与毛伊强大首领之间长期争夺的一部分。1795年，他占领莫洛凯后渡海前往瓦胡，在努乌阿努获胜，使大部分主要岛屿归于其统治。1810年考艾统治者接受其宗主权，王国统一由此完成。

english: Molomo lies in the country near the Cuebe River and Caiundo. The Cuebe joins the Cubango, which flows south from the Angolan highlands towards the Okavango Delta. Unlike rivers that reach the Atlantic, the Cubango's waters spread across an inland basin in the Kalahari.
simp_chinese: 莫洛莫位于奎贝河和卡永多附近。奎贝河汇入库邦戈河，后者从安哥拉高地向南流向奥卡万戈三角洲。库邦戈河不同于流入大西洋的河流，其水在卡拉哈里内陆盆地中散开。

english: Moloskovitsy lay in western Ingria, where a Lutheran community was established under Swedish rule in the 1630s. A stone church built in 1632 became the center of its parish. Its white limestone gave it the popular name of the White Church, or Valkeakirkko. The village appears as Moloskowits on a map compiled from Swedish material of 1676; a later map of 1770 used the name Belaya Kirka, also referring to the white church. In 1834 Moloskovitsy was mapped with twenty-nine peasant households beside the church settlement.
simp_chinese: 莫洛斯科维齐位于西英格里亚。瑞典统治时期，这里在1630年代建立了路德宗社群。1632年建成的石教堂成为本教区的中心，其白色石灰岩墙体使它得到了“白教堂”的俗称。根据1676年瑞典资料编绘的地图以莫洛斯科维茨记载该村；1770年的地图则使用同样意为白教堂的别拉亚基尔卡之名。1834年的地图在教堂聚落旁标出了有二十九户农家的莫洛斯科维齐村。

english: Molsemtekw lies on the south shore of the St. Lawrence near Trois-Pistoles. Offshore, Île aux Basques served as a base for Basque whalers between about 1584 and 1637. They built furnaces on the island to render whale blubber into oil; archaeological remains also show Indigenous encampments on the island in the following period.
simp_chinese: 莫尔森特克位于圣劳伦斯河南岸，靠近特鲁瓦皮斯托勒。约1584至1637年间，近岸的巴斯克岛是巴斯克捕鲸者的基地。他们在岛上建炉，把鲸脂熬成油；考古遗存也显示，此后原住民曾在岛上扎营。

english: Molson Lake lies northeast of the northern end of Lake Winnipeg, in a country of forest and interconnected waters. The Molson and Keepeewiskawakun rivers enter from the south, while the Hayes flows out to the north and continues towards Hudson Bay. A local Indigenous name recorded for the lake was Winnipegosis Sakahigan, or little muddy-water lake. The Hayes route later became a major artery of the fur trade between York Factory and the interior.
simp_chinese: 莫尔森湖位于温尼伯湖北端的东北方，周围森林广布，水道相连。莫尔森河和基佩维斯卡瓦昆河从南面注入，海斯河则从北端流出，向哈德孙湾而去。当地记载的原住民湖名为Winnipegosis Sakahigan，意为小浑水湖。海斯河路线后来成为约克工厂与内陆之间毛皮贸易的重要通道。

english: The Molucca Sea lies between Sulawesi to the west and Halmahera to the east, with the Sula Islands to the south. Volcanic islands including Ternate and Tidore stand near Halmahera's western coast. These waters linked the clove-producing islands of Maluku with traders from across Asia and, later, European vessels seeking the valuable spice.
simp_chinese: 马鲁古海位于西面的苏拉威西与东面的哈马黑拉之间，南面是苏拉群岛。特尔纳特、蒂多雷等火山岛坐落在哈马黑拉西岸附近。这片水域将马鲁古的丁香产地与亚洲各地商人联系起来，后来也有欧洲船只前来寻找这种珍贵香料。

english: Molumbo lies in the upper Luangwa country, southwest of the Mafinga Hills. The Luangwa rises in the hills and flows down a broad valley towards the southwest, swelling in the rainy season and falling during the dry months. Miombo woodland covers the lower slopes of the Mafingas, with mountain grassland and patches of riverside forest higher among the rocky gullies.
simp_chinese: 莫隆博位于马芬加山地西南方的卢安瓜河上游地区。卢安瓜河发源于山中，沿宽阔河谷向西南流去，雨季水涨，旱季则回落。马芬加山地的低坡覆盖着米翁博疏林，较高的岩石沟谷间分布着山地草原和河岸森林。

english: Molundu lies west of the marshy Upemba Depression, a basin dotted with lakes along the Lualaba. Lake Kisale receives the Lufira, which comes from the highlands to the south. Archaeological sites in the depression record long settlement and metalworking, and the Luba kingdom arose in this lake country.
simp_chinese: 莫伦杜位于沼泽遍布的乌彭巴洼地以西。卢阿拉巴河流过洼地，沿途湖泊星罗棋布；其中基萨莱湖接纳了从南方高地流来的卢菲拉河。洼地的考古遗址记录了漫长的定居和金属加工历史，卢巴王国便兴起于这片湖区。

english: The Molvo, also called the Molbo, flows along the northeastern edge of the Patom Highlands to join the Chara from the left. Its course crosses a remote landscape of wooded ridges and mountain valleys. The Chara continues to the Olyokma, and the Olyokma to the Lena. These rivers carry water from the southern Siberian highlands toward the Arctic, freezing through the long winter and opening again in the warmer season.
simp_chinese: 莫尔沃河又称莫尔博河，沿帕托姆高地东北缘流淌，从左岸汇入恰拉河。河道穿过森林山脊与山谷构成的偏远景观。恰拉河继续流入厄廖克马河，后者又汇入勒拿河。这些河流将西伯利亚南部高地的水流送往北极，漫长冬季冰封，暖季才重新开放。

english: On the northern coast of Lesbos, Molyvos occupies the site of ancient Methymna, once the island's prosperous second city. In antiquity its vineyards were celebrated by Roman writers, and its rivalry with Mytilene shaped its alliances during the Peloponnesian War. Its fortifications protected the town through later centuries: in 1335 the Genoese lord of Phokaia seized much of Lesbos but failed to take Methymna. It passed to the Genoese Gattilusi family in 1355, and came under Ottoman control in the 15th century.
simp_chinese: 莫利沃斯位于莱斯博斯岛北岸，是古代梅西姆纳的所在地；后者曾是岛上繁荣的第二大城。古代罗马作家赞颂这里的葡萄园，而城邦与米蒂利尼的竞争影响了它在伯罗奔尼撒战争中的结盟选择。此后的几个世纪，城防保护着这座城镇：1335年，热那亚的福西亚领主占领莱斯博斯大部，却未能攻下梅西姆纳。1355年，此地转归热那亚的加蒂卢西奥家族，15世纪落入奥斯曼之手。

english: Moma lies near a river mouth on the northern Mozambique coast, south of the island of Angoche. Its sheltered waters connected a coastal community with both the interior and the Indian Ocean. Moma was among the settlements associated with the sultanate of Angoche, whose influence extended through a network of islands and mainland communities. Merchants used these coastal waterways to exchange inland products and imported goods.
simp_chinese: 莫马位于莫桑比克北部海岸的河口附近，在安戈谢岛以南。避风水域将海岸社群与内陆及印度洋连接起来。莫马是与安戈谢苏丹国相关的聚落之一，该政权的影响通过岛屿和大陆社群网络延伸。商人利用沿海水道交换内陆出产和进口货物。

english: Moma Katwoi lies south of Pepa on the high Marungu plateau, west of Lake Tanganyika. Grasslands cover much of the open high country, while miombo woodland grows on lower ground. Streams cut valleys through the plateau towards the great lake. Near Pepa, woodland and grassy clearings stand above the steep country descending towards Kapulo.
simp_chinese: 莫马卡托伊位于坦噶尼喀湖以西、佩帕以南的马龙古高原。开阔的高地上大多是草原，较低的地带生长着米翁博疏林。溪流在高原上切出河谷，流向大湖。佩帕附近的林地与草地之下，地势陡然下降，通往卡普洛一带。

sources.title: Pepa, Democratic Republic of the Congo

english: Moma Moamba lies on the Muchinga escarpment above the northern Luangwa valley. The Lufila and Mwaleshi descend through gorges and waterfalls to reach the Luangwa, retaining clear water in the dry season. Before 1720, Bisa communities moving east from the Luapula established themselves in the Mpika country; their settlements later extended towards the western bank of the Luangwa.
simp_chinese: 莫马莫安巴位于卢安瓜河谷北段上方的穆钦加陡崖。卢菲拉河与姆瓦莱希河穿过峡谷和瀑布，流入卢安瓜河，旱季仍保持清澈的水流。1720年以前，从卢阿普拉一带向东迁移的比萨人已在姆皮卡地区定居；后来他们的聚落扩展到卢安瓜河西岸附近。

english: Mombasa occupies an island beside a sheltered harbour on the East African coast. Its Swahili merchants traded across the Indian Ocean, connecting the mainland with Arabia, India and other ports. In the 1590s the Portuguese built Fort Jesus on a coral-rock spur to defend their position at the harbour. Omani forces captured the fort in 1698 after a long siege, changing the balance of power along the coast.
simp_chinese: 蒙巴萨位于东非海岸一座岛上，旁有避风港湾。斯瓦希里商人横渡印度洋贸易，将大陆与阿拉伯、印度及其他港口相连。1590年代，葡萄牙人在珊瑚岩岬上修建耶稣堡，保卫其港口据点。1698年，阿曼军队经过漫长围攻夺取堡垒，改变了沿海的力量格局。

english:
Mombote lies near the Koukouya and Djambala plateaus, in the uplands of the Téké country. The Koukouya had their own ruler, the Monkoko, within the wider realm associated with the Makoko. By 1600, people of that kingdom exchanged slaves and tobacco with the Vili to the west.

The later city of Djambala lies here.
simp_chinese:
蒙博特靠近库库亚和贾姆巴拉高原，位于泰凯人的高地。库库亚人拥有自己的统治者蒙科科，同时也属于与马科科相联系的更广大王国。到1600年，这个王国的居民已与西方的维利人交换奴隶和烟草。

后来的兼巴拉即位于此地。

english:
Santa Cruz de Mompox grew on the Magdalena River in the wet lowlands of northern Colombia. Founded by the Spanish around 1540, it became a river port on the principal route between the Caribbean coast and the interior. Its position near the Magdalena and Cauca river systems made it an important point for the movement of people, supplies and trade.

During the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries Mompox developed along the riverbank, with churches, houses and public spaces reflecting its colonial role. Indigenous labor under the encomienda system was part of the early colonial order. In 1810 local leaders established a governing junta amid the independence crisis; accounts differ over the precise dating of the subsequent declaration of independence.
simp_chinese:
圣克鲁斯德蒙波斯位于哥伦比亚北部湿地的马格达莱纳河畔。西班牙人约于1540年建城后，它成为加勒比海岸通往内陆的主要水路上的河港。靠近马格达莱纳与考卡河水系的位置，使这里成为人员、物资和贸易的重要中转点。

17至18世纪，蒙波斯沿河岸发展，教堂、住宅和公共空间体现了它的殖民时期地位。监护征贡制度下的原住民劳动是早期殖民秩序的一部分。1810年独立危机中，当地领袖成立政府委员会；关于随后宣布独立的确切日期，资料有不同说法。

english: The Mon River rises among the forested ridges of the southern Chin hills and descends eastward towards the dry country of central Burma. Its upper valleys belong to a mountain landscape of steep slopes, streams and dispersed settlements. The Chinme people lived around the headwaters of the eastern Mon, where the highlands give way to the lower river country. The river provides a natural line through terrain otherwise divided by successive mountain ridges.
simp_chinese: 孟河发源于钦丘陵南部森林覆盖的山脊间，向东流向缅甸中部干燥的低地。上游河谷由陡坡、溪流和分散的聚落组成。钦梅人居住在东孟河的源头一带，高地在这里逐渐过渡为较低的河流地区。河流穿过一道道山脊分割的地形，形成一条天然通道。

english: The Mon coast faces the Gulf of Martaban, an arm of the Andaman Sea into which the Salween and Sittaung rivers flow. Its waters are strongly affected by tides and sediment brought down from inland. At the mouth of the Salween stood Martaban, a port known to traders across the Indian Ocean. The large glazed jars shipped from the port became so closely associated with it that they were called Martaban jars.
simp_chinese: 孟人海岸面向马都八湾，这片安达曼海的海湾接纳萨尔温江和锡当河的水流。潮汐和内陆河流携来的泥沙对湾中水域影响显著。萨尔温江口的马都八是印度洋商人熟悉的港口；从这里运出的上釉大陶罐与港口的联系如此密切，以至于被称作马都八罐。

english:
Mona Island lies between Hispaniola and Puerto Rico, at the meeting of major Caribbean sea routes. Its limestone landscape, caves and limited fresh water created opportunities and constraints for settlement. Indigenous inhabitants used island resources and participated in wider maritime connections, with canoe travel linking communities across surrounding passages. Fishing, cultivation where possible and the gathering of local products helped sustain life, while knowledge of safe landings and water sources was essential to visitors and residents alike.

Spanish expansion from the end of the fifteenth century brought Mona into the colonial world developing around the Greater Antilles. Nearby sea routes carried ships, supplies and people between the larger islands, making the island relevant to navigation and provisioning. Colonial demands and disease disrupted Indigenous communities across the region, while changing political and commercial interests altered the uses of smaller islands.
simp_chinese:
莫纳岛位于伊斯帕尼奥拉与波多黎各之间，处在重要加勒比航路交会地区。石灰岩地形、洞穴和有限淡水，为聚居创造机会，也造成限制。原住民利用岛上资源，并参与较广海洋联系，独木舟跨越周围水道连接社区。捕鱼、条件许可处的耕作及地方产品采集支持生活，安全登陆点和水源知识，对来访者、居民同样重要。小岛因此拥有早于欧洲殖民的生产及社会历史。

十五世纪末以来的西班牙扩张，将莫纳纳入大安的列斯群岛周围发展的殖民世界。邻近航路在较大岛屿之间运送船只、补给和人口，使莫纳成为航行和补给相关的地点。殖民要求与疾病破坏了区域原住民社群，不断变化的政治和商业利益也改变了小岛的用途。

english: The Mona Passage separates western Puerto Rico from eastern Hispaniola and connects the Atlantic with the Caribbean Sea. Mona and Monito islands stand within the passage, their cliffs providing landmarks to ships crossing between the larger islands. To the west, the low-lying shores around Saona require particular care. The channel formed one of the approaches by which vessels entered the Caribbean from the open ocean.
simp_chinese: 莫纳海峡位于波多黎各西端与伊斯帕尼奥拉东端之间，连接大西洋和加勒比海。莫纳岛与莫尼托岛坐落在海峡中，岛上的崖壁为航行于两座大岛之间的船只提供地标。西侧萨奥纳岛附近的低平海岸则需要格外小心。这条水道是船只从大洋进入加勒比海的通道之一。

english:
Monadnock rises alone above the wooded hills of southern New Hampshire. Its name may come from an Abenaki word for a smooth or isolated mountain, and its exposed summit stands far above the surrounding country. The mountain's solitary shape later gave geologists a name for similar isolated peaks.

In 1725 Captain Samuel Willard and fourteen rangers climbed the mountain and camped on its summit, using it as a lookout while patrolling for Indigenous people. Settlers set a fire on its slopes in 1800 to clear pasture, and another fire between 1810 and 1820 burned for weeks. Farmers had set the latter blaze believing wolves were sheltering among fallen trees. The fires destroyed forest and soil on the upper mountain, leaving the rocky summit largely bare.
simp_chinese:
莫纳德诺克山孤立地耸立在新罕布什尔南部的森林丘陵之上。山名可能来自阿贝纳基语中“平滑的山”或“孤山”的说法，裸露的山顶远高于周围地区。它独立的形态后来使地质学家以其名称称呼类似的孤立山峰。

1725年，塞缪尔·威拉德上尉率十四名游骑兵登山，在山顶扎营，以此为瞭望点巡查原住民。1800年，定居者在山坡放火开辟牧场；1810至1820年间，另一场火灾燃烧了数周。这次放火的农民认为狼藏在倒木之间。大火毁掉高处的森林和土壤，使岩石山顶大面积裸露。

english: Monaghan lies among the low hills and lakes of the old Gaelic territory of Oriel. The MacMahons ruled this country through the later Middle Ages, and the settlement grew in a landscape shaped by their lordship and by conflict with neighbouring powers. In the early seventeenth century changes to landholding and the arrival of settlers transformed the town. A charter of 1613 established Monaghan as a borough, and its market and streets developed as a centre for the surrounding farms. The new town retained a name rooted in the older Gaelic landscape.
simp_chinese: 莫纳亨位于古代盖尔奥里尔地区的低丘与湖泊之间。中世纪后期，麦克马洪家族统治这片土地，聚落在他们的领地及与邻近势力的冲突中发展。十七世纪初，土地占有关系的变化与移民到来改变了城镇。1613年的特许状使莫纳亨成为自治市，市集和街道发展为周围农场的中心。新镇仍保留着源于更古老盖尔地貌的名字。

english: The forests and wetlands of the lower Orinoco extend towards the vast delta where the river reaches the Atlantic. Branching channels pass between wooded islands, palms and mangroves. The Warao inhabit the delta and use its waterways to move through a landscape shaped by flooding and tides. Farther west, the Guarapiche flows through the plains around Maturín towards the lower Orinoco country.
simp_chinese: 奥里诺科河下游的森林与湿地延伸至大河注入大西洋的广阔三角洲。分流水道穿行于林木覆盖的岛屿、棕榈和红树林之间。瓦劳人居住在三角洲，沿水道穿过受洪水和潮汐塑造的土地。更西面，瓜拉皮切河流经马图林周围平原，通向奥里诺科河下游地区。

english: Monahassanugh was a town in the upper James River country, upstream from the Monacan centre at Rassawek. Its people, later known as the Nahyssan or Tutelo, were closely related to the Monacan and paid tribute to them. In the seventeenth century, war and colonial encroachment brought movement among the peoples of the Virginia interior. By the 1670s some Nahyssan had settled on an island at the meeting of the Staunton and Dan rivers, above the country of the Occaneechi.
simp_chinese: 莫纳哈萨努是詹姆斯河上游的一座城镇，位于莫纳坎人中心拉萨维克的上游。当地居民后来被称为纳希桑人或图特洛人，与莫纳坎人关系密切，并向他们纳贡。十七世纪，战争与殖民侵占使弗吉尼亚内陆的居民迁徙流散。到1670年代，一些纳希桑人在斯汤顿河与丹河交汇处的一座岛上定居，位于奥卡尼奇人领地的上游。

english: In the northern interior, the Cariboo Mountains rise within the great bend of the Fraser River. Their wooded valleys and high slopes form part of a country where caribou ranged through the mountains. The traditional territory of the Northern Secwépemc extends toward the upper Fraser and the mountains in the northeast, linking this high country with the river valleys farther west.
simp_chinese: 在北方内陆，卡里布山脉耸立于弗雷泽河的大河湾内。林木覆盖的河谷与高山坡地属于驯鹿出没的山地地区。北方塞克韦佩姆克人的传统土地向弗雷泽河上游及东北方的山脉延伸，将这些高地与更西面的河谷连接起来。

english: Monastir stands on a peninsula of the Tunisian coast between Sousse and Mahdia. Its ribat, a fortified religious settlement overlooking the sea, was founded in 796 and enlarged under the Aghlabids. It housed men devoted to prayer and the defense of the coast, and became a place of pilgrimage. The fortress formed part of a chain of coastal strongholds protecting early Islamic Ifriqiya.
simp_chinese: 莫纳斯提尔坐落在突尼斯海岸苏塞与马赫迪耶之间的半岛上。俯瞰海洋的里巴特是一处设防宗教聚落，建于796年，并在阿格拉布王朝时期扩建。居住于此的人们从事祈祷和海岸防卫，这里也成为朝圣地。堡垒是保护早期伊斯兰伊夫里基叶的一系列沿岸据点之一。

english: Monastyrshchina lies at the meeting of the Vikhra and Zheleznyak rivers, between Smolensk and Mstsislaw. Its name is associated with monastic lands and an early hermitage in the district. The settlement belonged to the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth from 1619. In the neighbouring village of Andrusovo, Russian and Commonwealth envoys concluded the truce of 1667, ending a long war and assigning Smolensk to Russia.
simp_chinese: 莫纳斯特尔希纳位于维赫拉河与热列兹尼亚克河的交汇处，处在斯摩棱斯克与姆斯季斯拉夫之间。地名与修道院土地及当地早期的一处隐修所有关。1619年起，这处聚落属于波兰立陶宛联邦。1667年，俄罗斯与联邦使节在附近的安德鲁索沃村缔结停战协定，结束了漫长的战争，并将斯摩棱斯克划给俄罗斯。

english:
Monasukapanough was a Monacan village on the Rivanna River in Virginia's interior. It was among five Monacan towns recorded by name on John Smith's 1612 map of Virginia. Rivers and wooded uplands supported communities distinct from the coastal societies encountered by early English settlers, and river valleys connected settlements across the Piedmont. This was an inhabited political landscape with its own history before colonial mapping.
